title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 USD


The backend serves both a consumer-facing onboarding app and an internal admin operations dashboard.


Current Backend Stack:

  • GraphQL API server (single endpoint) likely built with NestJS + TypeGraphQL or similar Node.js/TypeScript framework
  • AWS Cognito for user authentication (SRP protocol, email + phone login, token refresh)
  • PostgreSQL database with relational schema (users, payments, vehicle loans, agreements, stage transitions)
  • Hosted on AWS (us-east-1 region)
  • Integrations: Plaid (bank linking), ACH payment processor, KYC/identity verification, PDF generation, e-sign


Backend Responsibilities:

  • 30+ GraphQL queries and 20+ mutations covering user lifecycle, payments, onboarding, and financial reporting
  • Multi-stage onboarding pipeline (11 stages):
  • signup → identity → bank link → cash flow → admin review → approval → micro-deposits → auto loan link → disclosure → payment setup → active
  • Payment scheduling, debt collection, refund processing
  • FBO (For Benefit Of) sub-ledger tracking
  • Credit line management and daily contribution calculations


Required Skills:

  • TypeScript / Node.js primary language
  • GraphQL schema design, resolvers, input validation (NestJS GraphQL module or Apollo Server)
  • PostgreSQL complex queries, migrations, enum types, indexing
  • AWS Cognito (SRP auth protocol), deployment (ECS / Lambda / AppSync)
  • Plaid API Link tokens, bank account verification, micro-deposits
  • ACH / Payment processing understanding of payment lifecycles, failed payment handling, refund flows (currently using Spinwheel.io)


Preferred Experience:

  • Fintech or payments industry background
  • FBO accounting / sub-ledger reconciliation
  • KYC / AML compliance workflows
  • E-sign / digital agreement flows
  • Multi-channel communications (SMS via Twilio, email via Resend)


Scope of Work:

  • Along with our partner, we are seeking someone to quickly modify and rewrite the onboarding process to reduce friction and delays. You will implement new features through the Plaid API and other onboarding processes to eliminate drop-off and improve customer experience.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to build core systems at a fast-growing fintech company.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays



*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Senior Developer in Spyglass
description:
Senior Developer with primary focus on Spyglass Event Configuration Management


Responsibilities


  • Design and implement Event Correlation Rules within Spyglass to aggregate disparate logs and metrics into meaningful business events;
  • Configure Event Policies Suppression Rules and Deduplication logic to reduce alert fatigue for L1/L2 support teams
  • Build and maintain Spyglass Dashboards that provide real time visibility into the health of the FMCG application landscape
  • Experience Engineering Mobile and Emerging Tech
  • Integrate Spyglass with diverse data sources Azure Monitor GCP Cloud Logging AWS CloudWatch and ELKFalcon LogScale
  • Manage the lifecycle of an event from ingestion and normalization to correlation alerting and archival
  • Proactive Monitoring SRE Integration
  • Develop Thresholdbased and Anomaly detection alerts to identify performance degradation before it impacts the consumer experience
  • Implement Service Level Objective SLO monitoring within Spyglass to track the reliability of critical business paths, eg OrdertoCash, Checkout flows
  • Automate the creation of incidents in ITSM tools, eg ServiceNow, based on Spyglass event triggers
  • Build Situation Rooms or high level executive views within Spyglass for major promotional events or seasonal peaks
  • Ensure seamless event ingestion from hyperscaler hosted microservices AKSGKE and serverless functions
  • Support the monitoring of Integration Platforms Boomi APIM by capturing and correlating middleware execution events
  • Collaborate with the Cloud Infrastructure team to monitor network latency and connectivity events across the global AzureGCP backbone


Senior Developer Specifics

  • Lead the architectural design of the Global Event Management Strategy
  • Define enterprise standards for event metadata severity levels and correlation patterns
  • Mentor junior developers in eventdriven observability and AIOps principles
  • Conduct PostMortem analysis of major incidents to refine Spyglass correlation rules and prevent recurrence


Must have

  • Spyglass Event Management Expert level, proficiency in Spyglass configuration rule writing and dashboarding
  • Event Correlation Deep understanding of event patterns deduplication and suppression logic
  • Observability Integration Hands on experience connecting Spyglass to Azure Monitor, GCP Stackdriver or ELK
  • ITSM Integration
  • Proven experience integrating event platforms with ServiceNow or similar tools
  • Data Normalization, Ability to parse and normalize logs events from heterogeneous sources JSON, XML, Syslog

title: Quality Assurence

  • Uso obrigatório de BDD com Gherkin para criação e manutenção de cenários.

Diferenciais

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer


Our Client is hiring a designer to support a high-output marketing team. This is not a brand-from-scratch role. The design system exists, and the job is to execute consistently, extend it intelligently, and keep things moving without hand-holding.


You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels.


What you’ll do

  • You’ll be responsible for a wide range of design work tied directly to pipeline-driving campaigns
  • Create graphics for social, paid campaigns, email, and web
  • Design and iterate on landing pages in Webflow
  • Produce visual assets for webinars, virtual events, and campaigns
  • Design print collateral and occasional physical assets (including SWAG)
  • Create GIFs, motion elements, and lightweight animations
  • Edit video for social distribution and website use
  • Support ongoing campaign launches with fast-turn creative
  • This is a volume role, and you’ll be expected to make good decisions quickly and maintain quality under pace.


What matters in this role

  • You can operate inside an existing brand system without needing constant direction
  • You understand how design actually shows up in B2B marketing, not just how it looks in a portfolio
  • You’re comfortable moving between formats. Static, motion, web, video. No one is handing off perfect briefs every time
  • You have strong judgment about what’s “good enough to ship” vs what needs refinement
  • You can manage your own workflow and keep projects moving without bottlenecks


Requirements

  • 4+ years in a design role, ideally supporting marketing or growth teams
  • Strong portfolio that shows real campaign work, not just one-off visuals
  • Experience designing in Webflow (not just Figma concepts)
  • Experience with motion design and basic animation (GIFs, short-form video)
  • Video editing experience for social and web content
  • Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite


Context for the work

Our client sells to B2B marketing teams running webinars and virtual events as part of pipeline generation. That means the creative you produce will be tied directly to:

  • Driving registrations and product demos
  • Increasing engagement
  • Supporting sales follow-up
  • Reinforcing brand credibility with senior marketing leaders

The output needs to feel polished, but it has to perform, not just look good.


What this is not

  • Not a pure brand exploration role
  • Not a pixel-perfect, weeks-per-project environment
  • Not isolated design work handed over a wall


You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you.


If that sounds like your kind of environment, this will be a good fit.

title: Direct Response Creative Strategist
description:
Direct Response Creative Strategist (Meta Ads Focus)


Company:

Penrose Skin

Location: Fully Remote

Compensation: $50,000 to $72,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure

Job Type: Full-time


The Opportunity

Own the creative engine behind a DTC brand currently spending nearly $700K per month on Meta Ads with a target to scale to $2-3M per month in ad spend this year. You will write the scripts, build the strategy, and drive the ads that take Penrose Skin to the next level. This is a high-impact role for an elite direct response creative strategist who operates with extreme autonomy, understands deep consumer psychology, and wants a direct line to the founders.


About Penrose Skin

We are a premium direct-to-consumer grooming brand known for luxury, pheromone-infused body butters inspired by designer fragrances. From a niche disruptor, we have grown rapidly through viral digital marketing into a highly sought-after grooming essential. With a strong DTC presence and ambitious product launches ahead, this role sits at the absolute center of our next phase of aggressive scaling.


What You Will Do

Scale the Account: Push our Meta ad spend from its current $700K per month toward $2-3M per month while maintaining or improving ROAS through relentless creative testing and iteration.

Deep Psychological Strategy: Build concepts based on deep customer personas and match specific marketing frameworks (unaware, problem-aware, solution-aware) to those personas and their desires.

High-Volume Output: Produce a high volume of quality concepts weekly, working seamlessly with our graphic designers and leveraging AI tools (like nanobanana pro) to build statics on your own.

Scientific Iteration: Run \"learnings\" on every single creative. Form a hypothesis, test it, analyze why it worked or failed, and iterate on the winners relentlessly.

UGC and Content Mastery: Build and improve systems to source UGC, brief creators, manage AI video creatives, and oversee the production of high-converting assets.


What We Are Looking For

Proven Scale: You have a documented track record of managing creative strategy for Meta ad accounts spending $500K+ per month and have helped scale ad spend to $1M+ per month.

Extreme Autonomy: You do not wait for instructions. You get things done, build systems, and take full ownership of the creative pipeline without being asked.

Psychology Expert: You deeply understand consumer awareness stages, emotional hooks, personas, and how to write copy that converts cold traffic for specific audience segments.

AI and Format Fluent: You are up-to-date with the latest AI tech for ad creation (statics, video, AI-generated content) and know how to design listicles, advertorials, and hybrid MOF/BOF ads.

Obsessive Learner: You are addicted to learning, improving, and analyzing data to beat your own control ads. You stay on top of every new tool and trend in the space.


Our Culture

We are not a corporate 9-to-5. We are a small, obsessive team that plays to win.

We believe discipline beats motivation, every single day. We go all in, execute relentlessly, and hold ourselves to excruciatingly high standards because great is simply not good enough. We take full responsibility for our results. No excuses, no blame, no waiting to be saved.

We stay focused. We eliminate distractions. We embrace resistance because the sword can only be forged under fire.

We are radically honest, delusionally optimistic, and deeply grateful, but never satisfied.

If that sounds exhausting, this is not for you. If it sounds like home, we want to talk.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.

title: Performance Video Editor - Meta Ads (Remote)
description:
Creative Video Editor - DTC Brand


Location: Fully Remote (must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Create scroll-stopping content for a scaling DTC brand. We need a performance-focused video editor who can turn raw footage into high-converting ads and social content - with creative freedom and direct feedback loops on what's working.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, eco-friendly pet care brand expanding across major retailers like Walmart, Target, and Chewy. Our marketing team is scaling rapidly, and we're looking for a video editor who wants to grow their skills in performance marketing while building a long-term role with a mission-driven company.


The Role

You'll be our go-to editor for short-form video content that drives sales—think Facebook/Instagram ads, TikTok content, and social clips. You'll work with a steady flow of creator and product footage, turning it into thumb-stopping content that performs. This isn't agency churn-and-burn; you'll see what converts, iterate based on data, and refine your craft with real-time feedback.


What You'll Do

Video Editing & Production

  • Create high-performing Facebook/Instagram ad creatives and social media clips
  • Edit short-form content optimized for platform-specific formats
  • Source and organize B-roll and stock footage using the provided subscriptions
  • Manage creator content in Frame.io and maintain organized asset libraries

Graphic Design & Assets

  • Design marketing images, thumbnails, and social graphics
  • Create on-brand visual assets using Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva

Project Management

  • Track assignments and status updates in ClickUp
  • Follow naming conventions and file organization protocols
  • Communicate proactively about timelines, blockers, and questions


Requirements

  • 3-5+ years of video editing experience, specializing in short-form content
  • Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills (required)
  • Proven experience creating or editing Facebook/Instagram ads
  • Mid-level proficiency with Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva
  • Strong fundamentals in typography, color theory, composition, and motion graphics
  • Fluent English — excellent written and verbal communication
  • Self-managed — strong time management and ability to meet daily/weekly deadlines
  • Proactive communicator — asks questions early, flags issues before they become problems
  • Portfolio required — you must submit a portfolio showcasing your video editing work. Applications without portfolios will not be considered.


Nice to Have

  • Background in DTC or e-commerce brands
  • Experience with remote collaboration tools (Slack, ClickUp, Frame.io, Notion)
  • Familiarity with performance marketing metrics and what makes ads convert


Tech Requirements

Computer: i7 processor (or equivalent) with 16GB RAM minimum

Internet: 100 Mbps download speed minimum

Schedule

Monday-Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST (1-hour break)

Required: Weekly team meeting on Thursdays at 10:00 AM EST



Benefits & Perks

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire.
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business


Ready to Apply?

If you love creating high-performing video content and have a portfolio that showcases your work, we want to see it. Apply now.

Note: Applications without portfolio samples will not be reviewed.

title: Principal Recruiter
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Principal Recruiter based in Latin America with 5+ years of experience in full-cycle recruiting and proven leadership capabilities. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of recruiters while owning end-to-end talent delivery strategy and execution across multiple roles.


You will partner closely with Sourcing, Client Success, and leadership to deliver high-quality talent, improve recruiting performance, and scale talent operations. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines execution, strategy, and team development.



Responsibilities



Lead & Develop the Recruiting Team

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of recruiters
  • Set clear performance expectations and talent quality standards
  • Provide structured feedback, training, and mentorship
  • Foster a high-performance, accountable, and collaborative team culture
  • Conduct regular 1:1s and support career growth of team members


Own Full-Cycle Recruiting Execution

  • Manage end-to-end recruiting processes from intake to offer
  • Screen, interview, and evaluate candidates for technical and non-technical roles
  • Ensure a high-quality candidate experience throughout the process
  • Partner with sourcing to ensure strong pipeline conversion
  • Oversee offer process and ensure smooth handoff to onboarding

Drive Recruiting Strategy & Client Partnership

  • Lead role intake and align on requirements with stakeholders
  • Translate business needs into structured recruiting strategies
  • Partner with Client Success and Resource Managers to meet talent delivery goals
  • Anticipate challenges and adjust strategies proactively
  • Ensure alignment between client expectations and recruiting execution


Elevate Candidate Evaluation & Talent Quality

  • Define and refine candidate assessment frameworks
  • Implement and oversee technical testing and evaluation processes
  • Ensure consistent and objective candidate selection across roles
  • Maintain high standards for candidate quality and role fit


Drive Operational Excellence

  • Improve recruiting workflows, processes, and documentation
  • Ensure consistency, speed, and quality across talent pipelines
  • Identify bottlenecks and implement process improvements
  • Manage referral programs and internal recruiting initiatives


Leverage Data & Continuous Improvement

  • Track and analyze recruiting metrics (e.g., time to fill, conversion rates)
  • Use data to improve talent delivery outcomes and team performance
  • Identify trends and opportunities for optimization
  • Continuously improve recruiting strategies, tools, and practices



Required Experience



  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in full-cycle recruiting and at least 3+ in a leadership position
  • Experience leading or mentoring recruiters
  • Strong interviewing and candidate evaluation skills
  • Experience managing multiple roles and stakeholders simultaneously
  • Ability to translate business needs into effective talent strategies
  • Familiarity with ATS platforms and recruiting tools
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively


Desired Experience



  • Experience recruiting for technical roles
  • Experience working with North American clients or companies
  • Experience in agency, consulting, or nearshore/offshore recruiting environments
  • Exposure to recruiting analytics, reporting, or process optimization
  • Experience in growth-stage or startup environments


Additional Information



  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let’s learn from them. Be transparent!

title: Cloud Systems Engineer/DevOps
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Overview

We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration; you must be capable of building architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.


The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role’s primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

strategy.


Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN , pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter


Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)


Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Data Engineer, EDM III BRL
description:
Job Title: Data Engineer, EDM III BRL- 10 Years

Location : Brazil remote

Project Duration: 6 months



Job description:

Primary Skills

SQL, Python, Pyspark, Airflow, AWS, MLOPs

Secondary Skills

Communication, leadership, project management

Position Overview

The BMP (Business Model and Pricing) Analytics team is seeking an experienced Data Engineer to support business performance management and strategic decision-making through scalable data infrastructure and engineering solutions. The team partners closely with leadership, finance, operations, and business stakeholders to enable reliable, high-quality data access, support advanced analytics, and drive data-informed actions across the organization.

The Data Engineer will play a critical role in designing, building, and maintaining robust data pipelines, data models, and foundational data assets that power analytics, reporting, and emerging AI/ML capabilities. This role requires strong engineering rigor, a deep understanding of data systems, and the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record of building scalable data solutions in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment and is comfortable balancing foundational data platform work with evolving analytics and AI-driven initiatives.


What you will do

You have a strong engineering and problem-solving mindset. You translate business and analytical needs into scalable, reliable data solutions and architectures.

You design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data models that support business performance monitoring, analytics, and reporting, while contributing to the development of the BMP Data Foundation across Hive, Snowflake and data lake environments.


You support the buildout of data products and applications, including contributing to Streamlit-based pipelines and the development of chatbot capabilities to enhance data access and user interaction.

You collaborate closely with analytics, data science, and business teams to ensure data availability, quality, and usability for dashboards, reporting, and advanced analyses.

You enable and support the buildout of advanced analytics, machine learning and AI capabilities, ensuring the necessary data infrastructure, pipelines, and environments are in place to support model development and deployment.

You contribute to the design and evolution of the data and ML ecosystem, helping establish the infrastructure, processes, and foundations required to scale AI/ML initiatives across the organization.


Minimum Qualifications

• Master’s degree in computer science, Data Engineering, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

• 5+ years of experience in data engineering, data platform development, or related roles.

• Strong experience with SQL and at least one programming language (Python or equivalent).

• Familiarity with big data and distributed processing frameworks (e.g., Spark / PySpark).

• Experience building and maintaining data pipelines and working with modern data architectures.

• Experience with orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow) and pipeline automation.

• Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., AWS) and data warehousing solutions (e.g., Snowflake).

• Strong understanding of data modeling, data quality, and data governance principles.

• Experience with version control systems (Git) and collaborative development workflows.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work with ambiguous requirements.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Fluent in English.



Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working with data lake architectures and hybrid data environments.

• Experience supporting machine learning pipelines and infrastructure.

• Exposure to data applications (e.g., Streamlit) and conversational interfaces (chatbots).

• Experience with AI-assisted development tools and practices.

• Experience contributing to documentation and knowledge-sharing platforms (e.g., Confluence).

• Experience working in a matrixed, global organization.

title: BDR (Business Development Representative)
description:
About Foundey

Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting SaaS, AI, and tech startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with founders to deliver high-impact design solutions—from MVP design sprints to full-scale product interface design and UX audits.


The Opportunity

We’re looking for a proactive, hands on and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand Foundey’s pipeline of high-quality startup clients. In this role, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers—primarily founders and decision-makers in SaaS, AI, and tech companies.

You’ll play a critical role in connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys building relationships from the ground up.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and research potential clients within SaaS, AI, and tech startup ecosystems

  • Track activities and performance using CRM tools

Qualifications

  • 3 years+ of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in SaaS or agency environments)

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. Certificações

title: Brazil Senior Condition Intelligence (CI & PM)
description:
Company Description

Dingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world’s largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities.

Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey.


Role Description

As a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime.

In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo’s advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results.

With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo’s reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.


Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality.

Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life.

Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics.

Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities.

Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality.

Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records.

Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes.

Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences.

Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management.


Qualifications

Experience – Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments; OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable.

Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes.

Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies.

Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions.

Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders.

Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

title: Virtual Assistant Team Manager - Independent Contractor
description:
Job description: Talent Manager(Independent Contractor)

**Must send resume in English**



Overview:

The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.


Key Responsibilities:


Relationship Management

  • Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Build and maintain professional, trust-based relationships with Virtual Assistants while encouraging open, honest dialogue.
  • Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up.
  • Identify, document, and escalate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes.
  • Create a supportive and open communication environment with VAs, clients, and management.
  • Detect subtle communication cues and potential challenges, log observations, and alert management when appropriate.



Administrative

  • Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time.
  • Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
  • Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
  • Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.
  • Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation.
  • Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement.
  • Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions.
  • Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processing


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management
  • Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information
  • Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills
  • Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy)
  • Proven ability to multitask (conversing while documenting)


Technical Requirements:

  • Fully remote position
  • High-speed, stable internet connection
  • Professional-grade webcam
  • High-quality speakerphone or headset
  • Modern computer with reliable performance
  • Proficiency with video conferencing tools and spreadsheet software


Personal Attributes:

  • Empathetic and active listener
  • Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment
  • Quick thinking and adaptable communication style
  • Patient and persistent in building relationships
  • Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individuals



Note: This is an independent contractor position. Candidates must provide their own equipment and manage their own taxes and benefits.

title: Consultor SAP Datasphere
description:
A Atos é uma empresa líder mundial em transformação digital, oferecendo serviços de transação de alta tecnologia, consultoria, integração de sistemas, cloud e serviços gerenciados. Além disso, anunciada como parceira mundial de TI nos Jogos Olímpicos e Paraolímpicos!


Presente em mais de 70 países e com aproximadamente 100.000 especialistas ao redor do mundo, nossa empresa está no novo ranking Digital 100 da Forbes, uma lista das principais empresas de capital aberto que moldam o mundo digital nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (TI), hardware, mídia, e-commerce e telecomunicações.


Objetivo da Função

Atuar como especialista em SAP Datasphere em contrato temporário de 2 meses, apoiando o cliente na integração, preparação, modelagem e disponibilização de dados com governança e performance, garantindo a entrega de modelos e pipelines confiáveis para consumo analítico.



Escopo de Atuação (Principais Responsabilidades)

  • Desenhar e implementar integrações de dados via conexões (Connections) com fontes SAP e não-SAP, em ambientes cloud e/ou híbridos.
  • Configurar e operar pipelines de aquisição de dados (ex.: replication flows e data flows), com cargas iniciais e delta quando aplicável.
  • Modelar e organizar objetos no SAP Datasphere (Data Builder e Business Builder), criando visões/modelos com semântica de negócio.
  • Definir e aplicar padrões de governança e segurança no nível de Spaces, papéis e autorizações, garantindo acesso controlado e rastreabilidade.
  • Realizar troubleshooting e otimização de performance (cargas, visões, consultas), atuando em incidentes e ajustes de capacidade.
  • Documentar soluções (arquitetura, dicionário de dados, fluxos, runbook) e orientar o time do cliente/Atos em melhores práticas.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida com SAP Datasphere: Spaces, Connections, Data Builder e Business Builder.
  • Experiência com integração de dados e orquestração de cargas (replication flows/data flows), incluindo estratégias de delta quando suportadas.
  • Conhecimento de modelagem de dados (dimensional/relacional), conceitos de DW e semântica analítica.
  • SQL (preferencialmente SQL em SAP HANA/HANA Cloud) e boas práticas de performance.
  • Experiência com ambientes SAP (ex.: SAP S/4HANA ou ECC) e/ou ecossistema analítico (BW/BW/4HANA/BW bridge).
  • Conhecimentos de segurança/governança: papéis, autorização por space, controle de acesso e boas práticas de segregação.

title: Product Designer Lead (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required for evaluation ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.


About Us

Publicity For Good (PFG) is a US-based, female-founded public relations agency that partners with impact-driven, heart-centered leaders and purpose-driven CPG brands (Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty). We are an all-female team dedicated to amplifying brands that make a difference through meaningful visibility and measurable growth. We operate in a fun, fast-paced environment where collaboration creates magic.


Role

This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms.


As a Lead Generation Specialist , you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality.


Responsibilities

  • Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads).
  • Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems.
  • Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics.
  • Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects.
  • Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns.
  • Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns.
  • Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized.
  • Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence.
  • Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows.
  • Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions.
  • Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations.
  • Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings.
  • Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources.
  • Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
  • Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates.
  • Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly.


Results

  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets.
  • Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads).
  • Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status.
  • Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context.
  • Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns.
  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation.
  • Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality.
  • Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks.
  • Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation.


Requirements

  • Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting of at least 2 years.
  • Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns.
  • Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems.
  • Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs.
  • Ability to handle high-volume communication while maintaining quality and personalization.
  • Professional, persistent, and positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information.
  • Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously.


The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite:

FirstIgnite builds best-in-class software that accelerates commercialization and innovation by connecting scientific research with industry partners. We support universities, national labs, and research hospitals worldwide with tools that simplify complex science and identify real partnership opportunities.


Role Overview:

The Data Engineer will lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data systems that integrate diverse datasets. This role includes deploying AI and machine learning solutions to enhance insights, manage complex data relationships, and drive actionable intelligence for FirstIgnite’s platform. You will mentor and manage a team of data engineers while working cross-functionally to innovate and deliver impactful AI-driven solutions.


Responsibilities :

  • Lead the architecture, development, and optimization of scalable data pipelines for patents, grants, clinical trials, publications, labs, and firmographic sources.
  • Build and maintain ETL workflows on AWS using Glue (PySpark), Lambda, S3, and RDS PostgreSQL.
  • Explore and implement complementary data storage solutions as needed.
  • Apply machine learning and LLM-based techniques to extract, structure, and enrich data at scale.
  • Ensure data integrity, security, accuracy, and governance across all systems.
  • Implement tools for data exploration, visualization, and actionable insights.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to drive AI-driven innovation.
  • Evaluate emerging AI/ML techniques and tools to enhance platform capabilities.
  • Maintain version control, CI/CD pipelines, and reproducible workflows for the data engineering team.


Requirements :

  • Strong programming expertise in Python, with experience building production data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS data services (Glue/PySpark, Lambda, S3, RDS PostgreSQL, SSM) or equivalent cloud data stacks.
  • Familiarity with RESTful and GraphQL APIs, ETL processes, and data integration strategies.
  • Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI-enhanced data applications.
  • Strong analytical skills, including evaluating trade-offs of data ingestion and storage methods.
  • Leadership experience managing data engineering or AI teams in SaaS or tech environments.
  • Solid knowledge of version control (Git) and CI/CD practices.
  • Exposure to data science / ML libraries (Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch) and managed ML platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI) is a plus.
  • Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills in cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and drive projects from conception to deployment.


Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience with web scraping at scale (Firecrawl or similar).
  • LLM-based data extraction and prompt engineering for structured output.
  • Data quality instrumentation and observability for pipelines.

title: Media Arts Teacher – IB MYP (Secondary School)
description:
Join Our Team as a Media Arts Teacher – IB MYP (Secondary School) at St. Nicholas Pinheiros!


We are seeking a dynamic and innovative Media Arts Teacher to join our Arts team, teaching as a member of the Secondary School team at our Pinheiros campus . Media Arts engages students with a range of digital media forms—including video, animation, and audio production—to develop their creativity, critical thinking, and communication skills. The course emphasises investigating, creating, and reflecting on media, and understanding how media communicates ideas, emotions, and cultural perspectives.


The successful candidate will actively contribute to interdisciplinary learning across the MYP, collaborating with colleagues to strengthen connections between Media Arts and other subject groups. The role also includes supporting the Personal Project, leading a tutor group and providing pastoral support to students, and contributing to the life of the school through clubs and activities.


Core Responsibilities


  • Teach Media Arts across the MYP.
  • Guide students through projects involving video production, animation, sound design, and digital storytelling.
  • Foster creativity, critical thinking, and reflective practice in students.
  • Maintain an inclusive, safe, and engaging learning environment.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to plan and deliver Arts and Interdisciplinary learning.
  • Support broader school initiatives and community projects as required.


Qualifications


  • A teaching degree in Media Arts, Digital Arts, Film, Animation, Visual Arts, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience with video editing, animation tools, and audio production software.
  • Strong communication skills and effective classroom management.


What We Offer:


  • Brazilian CLT work contract;
  • Comprehensive medical and dental plans for your well-being;
  • Life insurance coverage;
  • Delicious meals with lunch provided at our restaurant;
  • Up to three paid days off per year as per our personal day policy.


**Please note that occasional Saturday work may be required to support school programs.**


Join us in creating a nurturing and enriching environment where every child thrives.

Apply now and be a part of the St. Nicholas' family! We look forward to welcoming you to our team!


Our school is dedicated to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all students. We prioritise creating a safe, supportive, and inclusive environment. All applicants will undergo comprehensive background checks to ensure the highest standards of safety and care for our community.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

Suporte a ambientes críticos e de alta disponibilidade

Experiência sólida com Kubernetes

Acreditamos na troca de experiências e valorizamos as relações através do Regime Remoto.

title: Artwork Controller
description:
Artwork Controller


We are hiring a Artwork Controller to support and manage the end-to-end packaging and labeling artwork process within a global regulated environment. This role requires strong coordination across multiple stakeholders and ensures delivery of high-quality, compliant, and timely artwork across regional markets.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end artwork development process (brief to final release)
  • Ensure all packaging and labeling artwork meets global regulatory and quality standards
  • Act as a key liaison between internal teams and external vendors/agencies
  • Validate project briefs and resolve gaps or discrepancies with stakeholders
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects with strict timelines
  • Coordinate review and approval workflows in PLM/electronic systems
  • Support RCA (Root Cause Analysis) and implement CAPA actions
  • Maintain issue logs and support escalation management
  • Participate in content lock and alignment meetings
  • Ensure design-to-print feasibility (CMYK, Pantone, dielines, bleed, etc.)
  • Track project progress, risks, and key milestones
  • Support process improvement and digital tool optimization initiatives
  • Provide training and guidance to junior team members when required

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Business, Packaging Technology, or related field
  • 10+ years of experience in artwork / labeling / packaging / regulatory / proofreading roles
  • Strong experience in pharma / medical devices / consumer health industry
  • Hands-on experience with PLM systems (Agile, Veeva, Loftware, GLAMS, Veraciti, etc.)
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop, Acrobat Pro)
  • Strong understanding of pre-press and print processes (CMYK, Pantone, dielines, bleed)
  • Experience with proofreading tools (GlobalVision, TVT, InformCC)
  • Strong project management, communication, and stakeholder handling skills

title: Performance Video Editor - Meta Ads (Remote)
description:
Creative Video Editor - DTC Brand


Location: Fully Remote (must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Create scroll-stopping content for a scaling DTC brand. We need a performance-focused video editor who can turn raw footage into high-converting ads and social content - with creative freedom and direct feedback loops on what's working.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, eco-friendly pet care brand expanding across major retailers like Walmart, Target, and Chewy. Our marketing team is scaling rapidly, and we're looking for a video editor who wants to grow their skills in performance marketing while building a long-term role with a mission-driven company.


The Role

You'll be our go-to editor for short-form video content that drives sales—think Facebook/Instagram ads, TikTok content, and social clips. You'll work with a steady flow of creator and product footage, turning it into thumb-stopping content that performs. This isn't agency churn-and-burn; you'll see what converts, iterate based on data, and refine your craft with real-time feedback.


What You'll Do

Video Editing & Production

  • Create high-performing Facebook/Instagram ad creatives and social media clips
  • Edit short-form content optimized for platform-specific formats
  • Source and organize B-roll and stock footage using the provided subscriptions
  • Manage creator content in Frame.io and maintain organized asset libraries

Graphic Design & Assets

  • Design marketing images, thumbnails, and social graphics
  • Create on-brand visual assets using Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva

Project Management

  • Track assignments and status updates in ClickUp
  • Follow naming conventions and file organization protocols
  • Communicate proactively about timelines, blockers, and questions


Requirements

  • 3-5+ years of video editing experience, specializing in short-form content
  • Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills (required)
  • Proven experience creating or editing Facebook/Instagram ads
  • Mid-level proficiency with Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva
  • Strong fundamentals in typography, color theory, composition, and motion graphics
  • Fluent English — excellent written and verbal communication
  • Self-managed — strong time management and ability to meet daily/weekly deadlines
  • Proactive communicator — asks questions early, flags issues before they become problems
  • Portfolio required — you must submit a portfolio showcasing your video editing work. Applications without portfolios will not be considered.


Nice to Have

  • Background in DTC or e-commerce brands
  • Experience with remote collaboration tools (Slack, ClickUp, Frame.io, Notion)
  • Familiarity with performance marketing metrics and what makes ads convert


Tech Requirements

Computer: i7 processor (or equivalent) with 16GB RAM minimum

Internet: 100 Mbps download speed minimum

Schedule

Monday-Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST (1-hour break)

Required: Weekly team meeting on Thursdays at 10:00 AM EST



Benefits & Perks

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire.
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business


Ready to Apply?

If you love creating high-performing video content and have a portfolio that showcases your work, we want to see it. Apply now.

Note: Applications without portfolio samples will not be reviewed.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

Sua missão é liderar a transição tecnológica da nossa inteligência:


• O Agora (Execução e Precisão):

  • Refinar e otimizar modelos em produção (AWS Bedrock), elevando constantemente os níveis de acurácia e performance.
  • Garantir precisão absoluta \"batendo\" dados e regras manualmente; em saúde, a qualidade do dado é inegociável.
  • Monitorar padrões de negativas (denials) e implementar loops de correção imediatos para que o sistema aprenda em tempo real.


• O Futuro (Escala e Arquitetura):

  • Evoluir nossa infraestrutura para um ecossistema robusto de RAGs e bancos vetoriais .
  • Migrar de uma solução centralizada para uma malha de modelos especializados por contexto e seguradora.

O QUE BUSCAMOS:

  • Curiosidade Investigativa: Desejo genuíno de aprender e decifrar as regras complexas do faturamento médico. Você não precisa vir da saúde, mas precisa querer dominá-la.
  • Atitude e Senso de Urgência: Valorizamos a velocidade e a proatividade. Em nosso contexto de negócio, a capacidade de entrega rápida é vital.
  • Mão no Código: Experiência prática sólida com Python ou Go e APIs de LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock).
  • Mentalidade de Builder: Capacidade de construir sistemas robustos do zero e obsessão pelo detalhe (não descansa enquanto a automação não reflete a regra de negócio com precisão cirúrgica).


O QUE OFERECEMOS

  • Oportunidade em Estágio Inicial: Chance de ser um dos primeiros membros de uma empresa em rápida expansão, com impacto direto na arquitetura e cultura.
  • Desafio Técnico de Alto Nível: Resolver problemas reais usando o estado da arte em IA Generativa.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer / Senior Data Engineer

Location: Costa Rica, Brazil or Mexico

Focus: Digital & Customer Experience Applications


Role Summary

We are seeking a Data Engineer / Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and operate scalable data pipelines and curated datasets. This role is pivotal in enabling Digital and Customer Experience applications across our global enterprise. You will work hands-on with Python, PySpark, and Databricks, championing modern engineering practices through Git-based workflows, CI/CD, and Azure DevOps to ensure high-quality data delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pipeline Development: Design and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines using Databricks and PySpark to transform and serve data for digital customer journeys.
  • Data Modeling: Build performant SQL transformations and curated dimensional data layers for downstream analytics and application consumption.
  • Engineering Excellence: Implement best practices for Databricks (notebooks vs. repos), modular code, cluster configuration, and cost-aware performance tuning.
  • Automation & Scripting: Utilize Python for data validation, orchestration helpers, and the creation of reusable libraries.
  • DevOps & CI/CD: * Manage source control via Git (GitHub/Bitbucket), enforcing strict PR reviews and branching strategies.
  • Build and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines to automate testing, packaging, and deployment across environments.
  • Quality & Reliability: Ensure data integrity through automated reconciliation checks, monitoring, and detailed operational runbooks.
  • Collaboration: Partner with product teams, analysts, and platform engineers to translate complex requirements into scalable data products.
  • Leadership (Senior Level): Lead module-level design, mentor junior engineers, and take ownership of critical pipeline delivery and enterprise code standards.


Technical Skills

Primary (Must-Have)

  • Advanced Data Engineering: Expert-level Python , PySpark , and SQL (advanced querying and optimization).
  • Databricks Ecosystem: Proficiency in Databricks jobs, workflows, clusters, and repos.
  • Version Control: Strong experience with Git (GitHub and/or Bitbucket) and enterprise branching workflows.
  • Azure DevOps: Hands-on experience with Boards, Repos, and Pipelines for build/release automation in data workloads.

Secondary (Good-to-Have)

  • Orchestration: Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF) for ingestion and scheduling patterns.
  • Data Visualization: Understanding of Power BI datasets, measures, and refresh patterns to support analytics enablement.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer / Senior Data Engineer

Location: Costa Rica, Brazil or Mexico

Focus: Digital & Customer Experience Applications


Role Summary

We are seeking a Data Engineer / Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and operate scalable data pipelines and curated datasets. This role is pivotal in enabling Digital and Customer Experience applications across our global enterprise. You will work hands-on with Python, PySpark, and Databricks, championing modern engineering practices through Git-based workflows, CI/CD, and Azure DevOps to ensure high-quality data delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pipeline Development: Design and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines using Databricks and PySpark to transform and serve data for digital customer journeys.
  • Data Modeling: Build performant SQL transformations and curated dimensional data layers for downstream analytics and application consumption.
  • Engineering Excellence: Implement best practices for Databricks (notebooks vs. repos), modular code, cluster configuration, and cost-aware performance tuning.
  • Automation & Scripting: Utilize Python for data validation, orchestration helpers, and the creation of reusable libraries.
  • DevOps & CI/CD: * Manage source control via Git (GitHub/Bitbucket), enforcing strict PR reviews and branching strategies.
  • Build and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines to automate testing, packaging, and deployment across environments.
  • Quality & Reliability: Ensure data integrity through automated reconciliation checks, monitoring, and detailed operational runbooks.
  • Collaboration: Partner with product teams, analysts, and platform engineers to translate complex requirements into scalable data products.
  • Leadership (Senior Level): Lead module-level design, mentor junior engineers, and take ownership of critical pipeline delivery and enterprise code standards.


Technical Skills

Primary (Must-Have)

  • Advanced Data Engineering: Expert-level Python , PySpark , and SQL (advanced querying and optimization).
  • Databricks Ecosystem: Proficiency in Databricks jobs, workflows, clusters, and repos.
  • Version Control: Strong experience with Git (GitHub and/or Bitbucket) and enterprise branching workflows.
  • Azure DevOps: Hands-on experience with Boards, Repos, and Pipelines for build/release automation in data workloads.

Secondary (Good-to-Have)

  • Orchestration: Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF) for ingestion and scheduling patterns.
  • Data Visualization: Understanding of Power BI datasets, measures, and refresh patterns to support analytics enablement.

title: Direct Response Creative Strategist
description:
Direct Response Creative Strategist (Meta Ads Focus)


Company:

Penrose Skin

Location: Fully Remote

Compensation: $50,000 to $72,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure

Job Type: Full-time


The Opportunity

Own the creative engine behind a DTC brand currently spending nearly $700K per month on Meta Ads with a target to scale to $2-3M per month in ad spend this year. You will write the scripts, build the strategy, and drive the ads that take Penrose Skin to the next level. This is a high-impact role for an elite direct response creative strategist who operates with extreme autonomy, understands deep consumer psychology, and wants a direct line to the founders.


About Penrose Skin

We are a premium direct-to-consumer grooming brand known for luxury, pheromone-infused body butters inspired by designer fragrances. From a niche disruptor, we have grown rapidly through viral digital marketing into a highly sought-after grooming essential. With a strong DTC presence and ambitious product launches ahead, this role sits at the absolute center of our next phase of aggressive scaling.


What You Will Do

Scale the Account: Push our Meta ad spend from its current $700K per month toward $2-3M per month while maintaining or improving ROAS through relentless creative testing and iteration.

Deep Psychological Strategy: Build concepts based on deep customer personas and match specific marketing frameworks (unaware, problem-aware, solution-aware) to those personas and their desires.

High-Volume Output: Produce a high volume of quality concepts weekly, working seamlessly with our graphic designers and leveraging AI tools (like nanobanana pro) to build statics on your own.

Scientific Iteration: Run \"learnings\" on every single creative. Form a hypothesis, test it, analyze why it worked or failed, and iterate on the winners relentlessly.

UGC and Content Mastery: Build and improve systems to source UGC, brief creators, manage AI video creatives, and oversee the production of high-converting assets.


What We Are Looking For

Proven Scale: You have a documented track record of managing creative strategy for Meta ad accounts spending $500K+ per month and have helped scale ad spend to $1M+ per month.

Extreme Autonomy: You do not wait for instructions. You get things done, build systems, and take full ownership of the creative pipeline without being asked.

Psychology Expert: You deeply understand consumer awareness stages, emotional hooks, personas, and how to write copy that converts cold traffic for specific audience segments.

AI and Format Fluent: You are up-to-date with the latest AI tech for ad creation (statics, video, AI-generated content) and know how to design listicles, advertorials, and hybrid MOF/BOF ads.

Obsessive Learner: You are addicted to learning, improving, and analyzing data to beat your own control ads. You stay on top of every new tool and trend in the space.


Our Culture

We are not a corporate 9-to-5. We are a small, obsessive team that plays to win.

We believe discipline beats motivation, every single day. We go all in, execute relentlessly, and hold ourselves to excruciatingly high standards because great is simply not good enough. We take full responsibility for our results. No excuses, no blame, no waiting to be saved.

description:

O(a) profissional será responsável por padronizar processos, impulsionar melhorias, desenvolver e realizar treinamentos, monitorar KPIs para

Visão estratégica e foco em resultados;

Desejável experiência na área de logística;

description:

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Sólida experiência com Databricks e modelagem relacional (PostgreSQL )

Domínio de Python, SQL e processamento distribuído (Spark)

Experiência com AWS (plataformas de dados)

Autonomia, proatividade e forte senso de dono

Estruturar a fundação de dados (governança, acessos, catálogo e controle de custos)

Preparar dados para modelagem estatística e jurimetria

Garantir integração entre dados capturados (ex: crawlers) e camada analítica

Evoluir arquitetura de Data Lake para Lakehouse

Implementar melhorias em monitoramento, observabilidade e confiabilidade

Fortalecer a camada Gold para consumo analítico



Modelo 100% home office

CLT pela BRQ + Pacote de benefícios

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions
