title: Content Creator
description:
Localização:  Remoto

Tipo:  Freelance / Contrato

Remuneração:  R$350–R$450 por semana (de acordo com o nível) + bônus (com base em visualizações)

Período de teste:  2 semanas, pago R$250 / semana


Sobre o Pure

O Pure é um aplicativo de namoro global e ousado que está redefinindo a forma como as pessoas se conectam. Acreditamos que o namoro deve ser honesto, divertido e livre de julgamentos — um espaço para explorar confiança, química e autoexpressão.

Estamos construindo uma comunidade de criadores UGC para ajudar a contar essa história.


Sobre a Comunidade de Criadores UGC

Estamos procurando criadores de conteúdo para redes sociais para se juntarem à nossa Comunidade de Criadores UGC do Pure — um grupo que produz vídeos curtos (TikTok / Instagram) sobre temas como namoro, confiança, amor-próprio, entre outros.

Como criador, você terá a oportunidade de colaborar com o nosso time, desenvolver sua marca pessoal e ser pago para criar conteúdos autênticos e envolventes que desafiam a forma como as pessoas enxergam o namoro.


O que você vai fazer
  • Criar e postar 7 vídeos curtos por semana (TikTok / Instagram Reels / YouTube Shorts, etc.)
  • Desenvolver conteúdos inspirados em namoro, conexões e autoexpressão
  • Direcionar pessoas para o app
  • Participar de briefings criativos, tendências e campanhas
  • Receber feedback e orientação para melhorar sua performance
  • Colaborar com o time em ideias de storytelling e estratégias sociais


O que buscamos
  • Você deve estar baseado no Brasil e ser fluente em português
  • Paixão por storytelling, redes sociais e cultura contemporânea
  • Familiaridade com tendências do TikTok, formatos de Reels e conteúdo UGC
  • Boa presença em frente às câmeras e habilidades de edição
  • Consistência e capacidade de cumprir metas semanais de conteúdo
  • Mente aberta e conforto para criar conteúdos sobre namoro e relacionamentos


Estrutura de pagamento
  • Estrutura por níveis com pagamento semanal
  • Bônus por visualizações (a partir de 100 mil views)
  • Bônus por registros
  • Pagamentos realizados semanalmente
Por que se juntar a nós
  • Seja pago para criar conteúdo autêntico sobre namoro e autoexpressão
  • Acesso a orientação criativa, briefings e uma rede global de criadores
  • Construa seu portfólio enquanto colabora com a gente
  • Liberdade criativa — seu estilo, sua história, sua perspectiva

    • Como se candidatar

    Envie sua carta de apresentação e conte um pouco sobre você, incluindo por que gostaria de trabalhar com o app Pure.

    Você será convidado para uma call de onboarding em grupo e receberá uma tarefa para criar um vídeo de teste.

    Depois disso, você entrará em um período de teste de 2 semanas e, se for aprovado, será totalmente integrado ao programa.

    As candidaturas são analisadas de forma contínua.

title: Analista de Identidades Pleno com Hashicorp Vault
description:
Sobre a vaga

Nosso cliente busca um profissional para atuar na implementação, configuração e suporte de soluções de IAM, envolvendo práticas de IGA, PAM, CIAM e MFA.

É imprescindível experiência prática em projetos envolvendo a ferramenta HashiCorp Vault.

Descrição das responsabilidades:
  • Participar de implantações dos sistemas de IAM, abrangendo todo o ciclo (Requisitos, Desenvolvimento/Configurações, Testes, Homologações e Suporte).
  • Customizar integrações entre os sistemas (APIs, Json, XMLs, SWAGGER, Etc).
  • Desenvolver scripts (Java, Phyton, Etc) para customizações das soluções.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica atualizada (blueprints, procedimentos operacionais)
  • Apoiar em atualizações e upgrades das ferramentas
  • Monitorar status e progresso da resolução de chamados.
  • Garantir atendimento dentro do SLA contratado.
  • Escalar incidentes de alto impacto para os níveis apropriados.
  • Manter clientes informados sobre o status e progresso dos atendimentos.
  • Buscar constantemente novas tecnologias e metodologias de melhoria.
Requisitos técnicos obrigatórios:
  • SOs: Conhecimentos básicos em microinformática tais como Linux e Windows Server, redes, segurança;
  • Java: compreender, desenvolver e ajustar códigos na linguagem Java;
  • Linux: compreender e conhecer comandos básicos para servidores Linux;
  • LDAP: conhecimento de protocolos LDAP;
  • JDBC: conhecimentos em banco de dados SQLServer;
  • DevOps: conhecimento em ferramentas de DevOps e Observability (Exs:Terraform, Ansible, DataDog, Grafana).
  • Experiência prática em projetos envolvendo a ferramenta HashiCorp Vault
Diferenciais:
  • Estar cursando ou concluído algum curso de nível superior (bacharel/tecnólogo) na área de Tecnologia;
  • Ter conhecimentos básicos em gestão de identidade;
  • Inglês intermediário; 
  • Ter conhecimento básico em frameworks (Scrum; Kanban; ITIL; Cobit; NIST);
  • Conhecimento e Habilidades com ferramentas e conceitos de IA.
Informações para o candidato
  • Vaga remota
  • Salário compatível com o mercado;
  • Plano de saúde integral sem coparticipação SulAmérica;
  • Plano odontológico SulAmérica;
  • Bônus anual de até 3 salários, conforme a avaliação de desempenho;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Gympass/WellHub;
  • Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação (Valor de R$895,00 para distribuir entre os 2 cartões);
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Ajuda de custo de 50% mês para aula de inglês com professor via online.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Job Description: Full Stack Developer (2 Openings)

Location: Remote from Barzil & Mexico

Experience Level: Mid–Senior

One role will be .NET-heavy , and the other Angular-heavy , though both are full stack positions.

Role Overview

We are hiring two Full Stack Developers to support the Digital Signage & Clubs team, building and maintaining software that powers airport signage systems and United Club applications used by customers and employees across airport locations.

These roles focus on developing scalable, cloud-based applications that support real-time signage displays, premium services, and club access platforms.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain full stack applications supporting digital signage and club systems
  • Develop front-end experiences using Angular (role-dependent emphasis)
  • Build backend services using .NET Core (latest versions)
  • Integrate applications with NoSQL databases such as DynamoDB and DocumentDB
  • Deploy and support applications in AWS
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, UX, and infrastructure
  • Support ongoing enhancements, performance improvements, and new feature development

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong full stack development experience
  • Angular (front-end focus for one role)
  • .NET Core and modern .NET ecosystem (backend focus for one role)
  • Experience with AWS cloud services
  • Hands-on experience with NoSQL databases , including DynamoDB and/or DocumentDB
  • Experience building scalable, production-grade applications

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting digital signage, real-time display systems, or customer-facing platforms
  • Familiarity with applications used in high-traffic public environments
  • Experience working on systems supporting both customer and employee workflows

title: Consultor SAP BUILD WORK ZONE - SPOT
description:
O que procuramos?

Estamos em busca de um Especialista SAP Sênior com foco em SAP Build Work Zone para integrar uma operação estratégica de suporte direto da SAP. O perfil ideal deve possuir uma visão holística do ecossistema SAP, sendo capaz de transitar entre ambientes S/4HANA, BTP e versões On-Premise.

Buscamos um profissional resiliente, com perfil consultivo e alta capacidade analítica para atuar em um Centro de Serviços Compartilhados. Você será responsável por garantir a excelência na experiência do usuário final, centralizando processos e conteúdos em um ambiente híbrido e complexo durante um ciclo de projeto de 9 meses. A atuação do consultor se dará de forma SPOT, conforme foram aparecendo as demandas do módulo no cliente.


Atribuições principais:

  • Atuar no suporte especializado e sustentação de ambientes utilizando SAP Build Work Zone (Standard e Advanced editions);
  • Configurar e administrar portais corporativos, garantindo a integração fluida entre S/4HANA, sistemas On-Premise e serviços em nuvem;
  • Realizar o troubleshooting de alta complexidade em incidentes relacionados ao acesso, performance e integração da interface do usuário;
  • Desenvolver e manter workspaces, páginas, widgets e cartões de integração (UI Integration Cards);
  • Gerenciar permissões, papéis (roles) e a governança de conteúdo dentro do Business Technology Platform (BTP);
  • Colaborar com as equipes de infraestrutura e segurança para garantir a conectividade via Cloud Connector;
  • Documentar soluções técnicas e apoiar na transferência de conhecimento para a operação de suporte.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida e comprovada em SAP Build Work Zone (antigo SAP Launchpad Service e SAP Jam);
  • Domínio do ecossistema SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform);
  • Experiência prévia em suporte ou implementação de projetos envolvendo S/4HANA e versões SAP On-Premise;
  • Conhecimento profundo em integração de sistemas e conectividade (SAP Cloud Connector e Destinations);
  • Vivência em Centros de Suporte ou Centros de Serviços Compartilhados (CSC);
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma em um ambiente remoto, gerindo prioridades e prazos (SLA/OLA).


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em outras ferramentas da família SAP Build (Build Apps ou Build Process Automation);
  • Experiência com SAP Fiori / UI5 para customizações avançadas;
  • Certificações oficiais em SAP BTP ou SAP Extension Suite;
  • Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação e interação com suporte global da SAP.


Localidade da posição:

Remoto


Idioma:

Português - Nível: Fluente/Nativo


Por que construir sua carreira na Meta?

Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade de interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo o Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas que mais crescem no país há 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informática Hoje


Quais são nossos valores?

- Somos pessoas servindo pessoas

- Pensamos e agimos como donos

- Temos gana por performance

- Crescemos e aprendemos juntos

- Buscamos excelência e a simplicidade

- Temos inovação e criatividade no nosso DNA

Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas independentemente de sua condição, deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, aparência, idade ou afins. Queremos que você cresça conosco em um ambiente acolhedor e repleto de oportunidades.

Se identificou? Então, #VemSerMeta!

title: Quality Assurence
description:
Estamos buscando profissionais de QA com forte atuação funcional e suporte técnico em automação.


Buscamos profissionais para atuação em qualidade ponta a ponta , com foco em validação funcional, geração de evidências e rastreabilidade das entregas em um ecossistema com microserviços, integrações e múltiplos meios de pagamento .


Essa posição tem foco funcional, porém exige conhecimento obrigatório em JavaScript e Playwright , para apoiar validações técnicas, ajustes de fluxo e interpretações de respostas de APIs quando necessário.


Você fará parte de um time orientado à excelência em qualidade, atuando de forma próxima aos times de desenvolvimento, produto e operações.


Responsabilidades


  • Participar de refinamentos, entendimento de regras de negócio e definição de critérios de aceite.
  • Planejar, executar e evidenciar testes funcionais ponta a ponta.
  • Criar e manter cenários e casos de teste com rastreabilidade no Jira/Xray , utilizando BDD com Gherkin (uso obrigatório) .
  • Executar testes de regressão, testes exploratórios e suporte a UAT/homologação.
  • Validar integrações e fluxos críticos envolvendo APIs, microserviços, mensageria (SQS), ERP e meios de pagamento (Pix, Boleto e Cartão) .
  • Acompanhar incidentes/bugs, apoiar priorização e realizar retestes.
  • Garantir rastreabilidade entre requisito ↔ teste ↔ evidência ↔ defeito .
  • Implementar testes e ajustes utilizando Playwright .
  • Apoiar validações técnicas com JavaScript (ex.: lógica de validação, estruturação de payloads, análise de respostas de APIs, interpretação de objetos JSON e pequenos scripts de apoio).


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Experiência com testes funcionais e processos de qualidade em ambientes ágeis.
  • Vivência com sistemas distribuídos e integrações (APIs/microserviços).
  • Experiência com validação de APIs via Postman ou Insomnia .
  • Experiência com Jira e Xray .
  • Uso obrigatório de BDD com Gherkin para criação e manutenção de cenários.
  • Boa escrita de cenários, critérios de aceite e documentação de evidências.
  • Experiência com testes de regressão e priorização de cenários críticos.
  • Conhecimento obrigatório em JavaScript (não atuará como QE, mas precisa interpretar, ajustar e criar pequenos trechos de código).
  • Experiência sólida com Playwright (locators, interações, assertions, waits, screenshots e vídeos).
  • Experiência com CI/CD e execução de testes em pipelines (ex.: Jenkins) .
  • Conhecimento em Docker e ambientes conteinerizados.


Diferenciais


  • Noções de observabilidade (Dynatrace, Loki).
  • Experiência com jornadas de Checkout e Pagamentos (Pix, boleto, cartão) .
  • Noções de segurança/controles (ex.: PCI) aplicados a testes.
  • Conhecimento básico em AWS ou ambientes cloud (multi-account) .


Sobre a OSF Digital


A OSF Digital tem orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais, onde você pode ser você mesmo no trabalho. Junte-se a uma comunidade inclusiva e apaixonada de profissionais que ajudam a promover a transformação digital para empresas ao redor do mundo.

Na OSF Digital, acolhemos todas as pessoas e não discriminamos com base em identidade e expressão de gênero, raça, etnia, deficiência, orientação sexual, cor, religião, origem nacional, idade, estado civil ou qualquer outra categoria protegida em qualquer jurisdição onde atuamos.

title: Cloud Systems Engineer/DevOps
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Overview

We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration; you must be capable of building architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.


The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role’s primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

strategy.


Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN , pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter


Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)


Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.


The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.


What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.


Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.


This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

title: Senior Python Engineer
description:
SENIOR PYTHON ENGINEER

ScrumLaunch


Full-time | Remote | English CV


ABOUT ROLE:


We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our team and help drive and accelerate our growth. We offer a competitive salary and a fully remote work environment.


You will be working on a fintech platform focused on retirement savings, designed to simplify and improve how businesses offer retirement plans to their employees.


The platform helps companies — especially small and mid-sized businesses — provide accessible and well-structured retirement plans through modern technology. The solution automates investing, simplifies administration, and offers transparent pricing without hidden fees.


This project delivers a complete retirement plan solution with built-in compliance and regulatory support, making it easier for employers to offer strong financial benefits to their teams.


If you are passionate about building impactful financial technology and want to work in a fast-growing environment where your work directly improves financial well-being, this is a great opportunity to make a real difference.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Architect and scale our FinTech platform: Lead the design and evolution of our robust, cloud-based platform, ensuring scalability, security, and performance.
  • Work with high performing global teams: Collaborate with our Europe-based engineering counterparts, fostering a culture of timely, on-budget delivery and continuous improvement.
  • Demand operational excellence: Implement best practices across technical operations, ensuring reliability, efficiency, and seamless execution.
  • Ensure platform integrity and compliance: Conduct/lead code audits to guarantee adherence to compliance standards and mathematical precision in all calculations.
  • Champion AI-driven innovation: Identify and integrate cutting-edge AI solutions to enhance our platform offerings and optimize development processes.
  • Collaborate across the organization: Partner closely with business and client-facing teams to gather insights, define product specifications, and prioritize initiatives to align with business and customer goals.
  • Embody decisive leadership: Own critical decisions, demonstrate strong accountability and ethics, and inspire confidence through clear communication and unwavering commitment.


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • 6+ years of experience as a Backend Engineer or similar role.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and experience with modern Python development practices.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker (version 20 or higher) and Docker Compose for local development and deployment.
  • Experience with UV for Python package and environment management.
  • Solid understanding of database concepts and strong experience with PostgreSQL, including writing efficient queries and managing migrations with Alembic.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs based on OpenAPI specifications.
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks, particularly Pytest.
  • Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git).
  • Understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems (preferred).
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS) is a plus.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with a focus on creating efficient, maintainable, and well-documented code.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.


WOULD BE A PLUS

  • Experience with performance optimization and scaling distributed systems.
  • Knowledge of monitoring and logging tools.
  • Contributions to open-source projects.
  • Experience with CI/CD automation.


BENEFITS

  • Opportunities to work on diverse and challenging projects
  • A supportive and collaborative team environment
  • 12 vacation days per year
  • 5 sick days per year
  • English classes
  • Access to therapist and psychologist support for mental well-being

title: Cloud Systems Engineer/DevOps
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Overview

We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration; you must be capable of building architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.


The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role’s primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

strategy.


Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN , pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter


Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)


Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Account Manager
description:
As an Account Manager for Brazil , you'll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You'll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our content and product departments.


You'll be responsible for driving the entire sales and success cycle in the iGaming market, from initial engagement to maximizing long-term results. Managing key client relationships, driving sales growth, and ensuring customer satisfaction within these specific regions. This role requires a proactive approach to identifying opportunities, understanding client needs, and delivering tailored solutions that drive mutual success.


Specifically, your role will involve:


  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients, including sports betting operators, casinos, online gaming platforms, and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for key client accounts, managing all aspects of the client relationship and serving as their trusted advisor.
  • Understand clients' business objectives, market trends, and regulatory requirements specific to the English speaking markets to effectively position our gambling products and services.
  • Collaborate with internal sales, marketing, and product development teams to customize solutions and address client needs within these regions.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for upselling additional products/services and expanding client accounts.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations, proposals, and business cases to key clients within these regions.
  • Monitor and analyze sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth and optimization within key accounts.
  • Attend industry events, conferences, and trade shows worldwide to network with key clients and stay informed about industry insights and developments.
  • Provide timely and accurate reports on key account performance, sales activity, and revenue forecasts within these regions to management.
  • Stay up-to-date on gambling regulations, compliance standards, and responsible gaming practices to ensure adherence and mitigate risks.


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Brazilian Portuguese and English.
  • Understand gambling products, platforms, and regulations in specific regions.
  • Drive change and support accounts in the iGaming industry with your sales skills.
  • Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments.
  • Focus on exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth.
  • Bring experience in iGaming strategy, sales, or affiliate management.
  • Excel in building and maintaining strong relationships with partners.
  • Possess excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Show active listening, resilience, and persistence.
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination.
  • Excel in time management, organization, and planning.
  • Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously.
  • Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making.
  • Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.
  • Be open to occasional travel for client meetings and industry events.


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.


MoveUp Media

title: Senior Data Engineer (Colombia, Brazil and Costa Rica)
description:
Senior Data Engineer


We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer who can own the end-to-end delivery of complex data infrastructure and high-fidelity integrations. This role involves more custom coding and architectural design than a typical data engineer role as you will be building robust bridges between our internal microservices and external partner APIs in addition to data pipelines.


Minimum Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering with a strong foundation in system design.

• This is a coding heavy role. You must be able to write production-grade, modular Python code.

• Expert level proficiency in SQL, complex data modeling and Bigquery performance optimization.

• Deep experience with the Data stack of Google Cloud Platform (Bigquery, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Composer, Dataflow etc) is required.

• Proven success building integrations with API clients to fetch or send data and streaming platforms.

• Advanced hands-on experience with dbt (incremental models, testing and project organization).

• Active experience using AI coding tools to enhance productivity and code quality.

• Expert command of Git, CI/CD workflows and Docker/Kubernetes.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

  • Garantir que todas as soluções técnicas estejam alinhadas a estratégia do negócio e entender iniciativas relacionadas ao produto;
  • Ajudar o time no desenho de soluções com arquitetura evolutiva, além de investigar constantemente novas tecnologias e formas de trabalho;
  • Colaborar com a evolução das habilidades técnicas do time e esforços de melhoria contínua que impactam vários times;
  • Trabalhar em um ambiente colaborativo, em que práticas de pareamento, feedbacks e motivação para se desenvolver são comuns a todos os squads.


O que você precisa para essa posição no jogo:

  • Conhecimento avançado em desenvolvimento em Golang ou Typescript ;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de consumidores e produtores de eventos para Event Streaming (Kafka) ;
  • Conhecimento em Docker & Kubernetes ;
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade ;
  • Conhecimento sobre testes unitários e de integração;
  • Preocupação com a qualidade e desempenho das soluções propostas;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente multifuncional e colaborativo, de maneira autônoma;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento e implementação de APIs ;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de microsserviços distribuídos ;
  • Embasamento teórico, habilidade e preocupação com a excelência técnica e boas práticas de desenvolvimento (DDD, Arquitetura, Design de Código, Paradigmas, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis.


Seria legal se você conhecesse:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento em C# ;
  • Google Cloud Continuous Integration;
  • Continuous Delivery.

title: Lead Retention Strategist
description:
Company: No Limit Email

Location: Remote (US timezone overlap required)

Type: Full-time Contractor

Compensation: Competitive salary + performance bonuses


About Us

No Limit Email is a retention-focused agency helping DTC brands unlock revenue from their existing customers. We’ve worked with 200+ brands and generated over $80M in email-attributed revenue by focusing on what truly matters: retention, LTV, and repeat purchases.


The Role

We’re looking for a senior, strategic leader to manage high-value ecommerce clients ($10M–$100M/year) and mentor our team of strategists.

This is a strategy-first, client-facing leadership role—not execution-focused—working closely with copy, design, and tech teams.


What You’ll Do

  • Own retention strategy for 5+ high-value DTC clients
  • Build lifecycle roadmaps, testing plans, and performance insights
  • Lead client communication and monthly strategy calls
  • Analyze data (LTV, cohorts, retention, etc.) to drive decisions
  • Mentor and train junior strategists
  • Build and optimize AI workflows to improve team performance


What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years in lifecycle/email marketing (Klaviyo required)
  • Experience with brands doing $1M+/month
  • Strong client management and communication skills
  • Deep analytical mindset (LTV, cohorts, testing)
  • Experience leading or mentoring teams
  • Hands-on knowledge of retention tools and flows
  • Active use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.)


Bonus Points

  • Experience in agencies or high-growth DTC brands
  • Familiarity with tools like Recharge, Rebuy, Triple Whale, etc.
  • Experience building systems, processes, or training teams


100% remote role!

title: Brazil Senior Condition Intelligence (CI & PM)
description:
Company Description

Dingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world’s largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities.

Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey.


Role Description

As a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime.

In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo’s advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results.

With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo’s reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.


Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality.

Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life.

Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics.

Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities.

Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality.

Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records.

Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes.

Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences.

Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management.


Qualifications

Experience – Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments; OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable.

Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes.

Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies.

Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions.

Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders.

Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.


The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.


What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.


Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.


This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

description:

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce Sênior
description:
Se você busca novos desafios e deseja atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e inovador, essa oportunidade é para você! Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Salesforce apaixonado por tecnologia e soluções de CRM, que queira contribuir com seu conhecimento e crescer junto com a nossa equipe.


O que você vai fazer no dia a dia?

  • Desenvolver e apoiar atividades de modelagem de dados no ambiente Salesforce, incluindo criação de objetos, campos e processos automatizados (flows, workflows, validation rules, process builders);
  • Realizar desenvolvimento em Salesforce (classes, triggers, coberturas de código e serviços web para integração);
  • Apoiar a gestão de arquitetura de dados com interface ao Salesforce Marketing Cloud;
  • Definir, desenvolver, testar, documentar e implementar novas soluções e integrações, alinhadas à governança e regras de negócio;
  • Entender fluxos ponta a ponta envolvendo sistemas satélites e outros squads;
  • Implementar as melhores práticas de código, design patterns, orientação a objetos e otimização de performance;
  • Desenvolver código limpo, testável e de fácil manutenção;
  • Participar do processo de code review, garantindo qualidade e consistência do código;
  • Atuar com conhecimentos específicos da plataforma Salesforce, alinhado aos princípios de qualidade do CoE (Centro Operacional de Excelência em Salesforce) e políticas de governança;
  • Participar das cerimônias ágeis com o time (Daily, Review e Planning), aplicando metodologia ágil (SCRUM) no fluxo de trabalho.


O que esperamos de você?


Conhecimentos técnicos obrigatórios:

  • Requerida experiência de 2 anos com criação e manutenção de Apex, incluindo Triggers, Apex Batches, Schedulers, Test Classes, DataFactory, bem como com padrões de projeto (Service, Helper, TriggerHandler, Wrapper) e boas práticas.
  • Requerida experiência de 2 anos com Lightning Web Components, incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de componentes.
  • Requerida experiência de 2 anos com ferramentas declarativas, como Process Builder, Salesforce Flow, regras de validação, processos de aprovação, fluxos, gatilhos de fluxo e alertas de e-mail.
  • Requerida experiência de 2 anos com configuração de segurança e administração, abrangendo controle de segurança, criação de layouts, tipos de registros, perfis, painéis, relatórios, usuários, funções, grupos, filas, permission sets e permission sets groups, sempre seguindo boas práticas.
  • Requerida experiência de 2 anos com desenvolvimento end-to-end, incluindo levantamento de necessidades, implantação, implementação, testes e homologação.
  • Requerida experiência de 2 anos com Sales Cloud ou Service Cloud.
  • Requerida experiência com data modeling e data management no ambiente Salesforce.
  • Requerida experiência com ordem de execução de Triggers (Triggers and Orders of Execution).
  • Requerida experiência com debug logs e Developer Console.
  • Requerida experiência com Apex Testing.
  • Requerida experiência com integrações e desenvolvimento em Apex e .NET Basics.
  • Requerida experiência com Platform Development basics.
  • Requerida experiência com Lightning Experience Development.
  • Requerida experiência com alguma ferramenta de CI/CD (ex.: Flosum, Git).


Diferenciais que podem te destacar:

  • Ensino superior em Administração, Engenharia de sistemas ou Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Certificação Salesforce de Administrador/ Desenvolvedor/ Platform App Builder I;
  • Experiência com Salesforce e Salesforce Marketing Cloud;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Lean, Kanban, SAFe etc.);
  • Experiência com indicadores de CRM;
  • Experiência com modelo arquitetural REST/SOAP;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Experiência com o mercado Segurador, Previdenciário e/ou Financeiro.


Habilidades comportamentais que valorizamos:

  • Trabalho em equipe e colaboração;
  • Comprometimento e engajamento;
  • Comunicação eficaz e organização;
  • Disciplina e foco;
  • Raciocínio lógico e resolução de problemas;
  • Proatividade e aprendizado contínuo.


Por que se juntar ao nosso time?

  • Ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de aprendizado e desenvolvimento profissional;
  • Cultura de colaboração e crescimento conjunto;
  • Projetos desafiadores com tecnologias de ponta.

title: Artwork Controller
description:
Artwork Controller


We are hiring a Artwork Controller to support and manage the end-to-end packaging and labeling artwork process within a global regulated environment. This role requires strong coordination across multiple stakeholders and ensures delivery of high-quality, compliant, and timely artwork across regional markets.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end artwork development process (brief to final release)
  • Ensure all packaging and labeling artwork meets global regulatory and quality standards
  • Act as a key liaison between internal teams and external vendors/agencies
  • Validate project briefs and resolve gaps or discrepancies with stakeholders
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects with strict timelines
  • Coordinate review and approval workflows in PLM/electronic systems
  • Support RCA (Root Cause Analysis) and implement CAPA actions
  • Maintain issue logs and support escalation management
  • Participate in content lock and alignment meetings
  • Ensure design-to-print feasibility (CMYK, Pantone, dielines, bleed, etc.)
  • Track project progress, risks, and key milestones
  • Support process improvement and digital tool optimization initiatives
  • Provide training and guidance to junior team members when required

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Business, Packaging Technology, or related field
  • 10+ years of experience in artwork / labeling / packaging / regulatory / proofreading roles
  • Strong experience in pharma / medical devices / consumer health industry
  • Hands-on experience with PLM systems (Agile, Veeva, Loftware, GLAMS, Veraciti, etc.)
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop, Acrobat Pro)
  • Strong understanding of pre-press and print processes (CMYK, Pantone, dielines, bleed)
  • Experience with proofreading tools (GlobalVision, TVT, InformCC)
  • Strong project management, communication, and stakeholder handling skills

title: SAP Business data migration expert (Manufacturing)
description:
For one of our international clients, RED Global is looking for an experienced SAP Business Data Migration Consultant with expertise in Manufacturing and Procurement processes to support a global S/4 Hana template rollout.


This is a remote role with occasional travel to Brazil, will focus on managing data migration activities in the Manufacturing and Procurement areas, ensuring data readiness, cleansing, and integration across multiple systems to support a seamless deployment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage business data migration activities, aligning with the Client’s deployment plan and milestones.
  • Coordinate and complete Manufacturing data cleansing tasks, meeting deadlines and quality standards.
  • Oversee data collection for manual or construction objects, ensuring completeness and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with the Client’s IT to define and maintain value mappings between legacy and target systems.
  • Create and manage master data lists for assigned Commercial and Procurement objects.
  • Provide business insights to support data extraction and conversion from legacy systems.
  • Ensure Manufacturing data readiness throughout the migration lifecycle, including quality checks, validation, and defect remediation.
  • Verify data is suitable for intended Manufacturing processes, aligning with relevant stakeholders.


Desired Skills:

  • Minimum of 8+ years' experience in data migration and ERP implementations (S/4HANA)
  • Proven experience in SAP data migration, including data cleansing, mapping, and validation.
  • Strong understanding of Manufacturing, Commercial, and Procurement processes.
  • Experience in working with master data objects, including creation, management, and migration.
  • Experience in multi-country/global ERP deployment projects.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills for data analysis and reconciliation.

title: Analista de Negócios (Dados)
description:
Descrição:


• Conduzir estudos quantitativos de negócio de forma autônoma, desde a formulação de hipóteses até a extração de dados, modelagem e geração de recomendações estratégicas;

• Identificar oportunidades de crescimento no canal App por meio de análises estatísticas — correlações, segmentação de clientes, análise de propensão e modelos de regressão aplicados a comportamento de contratação;

• Acompanhar os indicadores de performance do canal digital (funil de conversão, ticket médio, volume de contratos), diagnosticando desvios e propondo ações corretivas com embasamento em dados;

• Contribuir na concepção de novas funcionalidades e jornadas, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia com visão orientada a dados;

• Construir e manter dashboards analíticos em Power BI ou ferramentas similares, garantindo visibilidade dos KPIs para a liderança;

• Agir proativamente na identificação e remoção de obstáculos ao desempenho da equipe, trazendo dados como base para a tomada de decisão.


Requisitos:


• Superior completo em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Ciência de Dados, Física ou áreas correlatas com forte base quantitativa;

• Experiência comprovada com análise estatística aplicada a negócio: correlação, regressão, testes de hipótese e significância estatística;

• Capacidade de extrair, processar e analisar dados de forma autônoma, sem dependência de time de dados dedicado;

• Domínio de SQL para consultas analíticas (incluindo joins complexos, agregações e subqueries);

• Conhecimento em Power BI e Excel avançado (modelagem de dados, DAX, tabelas dinâmicas, análises estatísticas);

• Experiência prévia em setor financeiro ou bancário, com compreensão de produtos de crédito, canais digitais ou comportamento do cliente em apps.


Desejáveis:


• Experiência com Python ou R para análise de dados e modelagem estatística;

• Conhecimento em Snowflake, BigQuery ou outro data warehouse moderno;

• Vivência com testes A/B — incluindo definição de significância estatística, tamanho de amostra e interpretação dos resultados;

• Atuação prévia com canais digitais de crédito consignado ou produtos bancários similares;

• Experiência com modelos de clusterização, propensão ou segmentação de clientes.

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.


About Us

Publicity For Good (PFG) is a US-based, female-founded public relations agency that partners with impact-driven, heart-centered leaders and purpose-driven CPG brands (Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty). We are an all-female team dedicated to amplifying brands that make a difference through meaningful visibility and measurable growth. We operate in a fun, fast-paced environment where collaboration creates magic.


Role

This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms.


As a Lead Generation Specialist , you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality.


Responsibilities

  • Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads).
  • Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems.
  • Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics.
  • Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects.
  • Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns.
  • Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns.
  • Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized.
  • Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence.
  • Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows.
  • Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions.
  • Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations.
  • Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings.
  • Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources.
  • Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
  • Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates.
  • Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly.


Results

  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets.
  • Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads).
  • Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status.
  • Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context.
  • Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns.
  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation.
  • Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality.
  • Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks.
  • Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation.


Requirements

  • Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting of at least 2 years.
  • Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns.
  • Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems.
  • Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs.
  • Ability to handle high-volume communication while maintaining quality and personalization.
  • Professional, persistent, and positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information.
  • Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously.


The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.

title: Accountant
description:
Company Description

Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency focused on SaaS, AI, and tech startups. We specialize in creating user experiences that align with business goals, driving growth and scalability for early-stage products. Our services include strategic UI/UX design, embedded design partnerships, UX audits, and MVP design sprints tailored for validation. Founders trust us for our deep understanding of startup challenges, combining cross-industry expertise in areas such as fintech and AI to deliver results that exceed design trends. We pride ourselves on being collaborative design partners who prioritize strategic thinking and customer impact.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for an Accountant at Foundey. The Accountant will handle daily operational accounting tasks, including processing financial transactions, managing accounts payable and receivable, overseeing budgeting and forecasting, and preparing financial statements. Responsibilities include monitoring compliance with financial regulations, reconciling accounts, managing payroll, and supporting financial audits. The Accountant will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure accurate reporting and will play a key role in optimizing financial processes.


Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Accounting, Bookkeeping, and Financial Reporting;
  • Knowledge of Tax Compliance, Budget Preparation, and Audit processes;
  • Experience with accounting software, and financial management tools such as WaveApp or Quickbooks;
  • Strong attention to detail, analytical skills, and ability to handle complex financial data;
  • Excellent organizational and time-management abilities;
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field;
  • Understanding of relevant laws and regulations, including GAAP or IFRS;
  • U.S. CPA or other professional accounting certifications are a plus;
  • Prior experience in compliance or governance-related roles is an advantage.
  • Full english fluency


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Account Manager
description:
As an Account Manager for Brazil , you'll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You'll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our content and product departments.


You'll be responsible for driving the entire sales and success cycle in the iGaming market, from initial engagement to maximizing long-term results. Managing key client relationships, driving sales growth, and ensuring customer satisfaction within these specific regions. This role requires a proactive approach to identifying opportunities, understanding client needs, and delivering tailored solutions that drive mutual success.


Specifically, your role will involve:


  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients, including sports betting operators, casinos, online gaming platforms, and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for key client accounts, managing all aspects of the client relationship and serving as their trusted advisor.
  • Understand clients' business objectives, market trends, and regulatory requirements specific to the English speaking markets to effectively position our gambling products and services.
  • Collaborate with internal sales, marketing, and product development teams to customize solutions and address client needs within these regions.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for upselling additional products/services and expanding client accounts.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations, proposals, and business cases to key clients within these regions.
  • Monitor and analyze sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth and optimization within key accounts.
  • Attend industry events, conferences, and trade shows worldwide to network with key clients and stay informed about industry insights and developments.
  • Provide timely and accurate reports on key account performance, sales activity, and revenue forecasts within these regions to management.
  • Stay up-to-date on gambling regulations, compliance standards, and responsible gaming practices to ensure adherence and mitigate risks.


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Brazilian Portuguese and English.
  • Understand gambling products, platforms, and regulations in specific regions.
  • Drive change and support accounts in the iGaming industry with your sales skills.
  • Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments.
  • Focus on exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth.
  • Bring experience in iGaming strategy, sales, or affiliate management.
  • Excel in building and maintaining strong relationships with partners.
  • Possess excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Show active listening, resilience, and persistence.
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination.
  • Excel in time management, organization, and planning.
  • Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously.
  • Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making.
  • Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.
  • Be open to occasional travel for client meetings and industry events.


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.


MoveUp Media

description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.

  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
