Test creation and validation

Code review and quality improvement

Critically evaluate, challenge, and refine AI-generated outputs to ensure production-grade quality

Contribute to evolving best practices for agent-assisted development within the team


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 8+ years of experience in back-end development using C#, .NET, Python, Node.js, or similar
  • Proven hands-on experience using agentic tools and development workflows in day-to-day software engineering
  • Experience building and maintaining SaaS platforms
  • Experience building modern web applications using Angular, React.js, or similar frameworks
  • Experience designing and supporting APIs, integrations, and service-to-service communication
  • Experience working with distributed systems, microservices, service-oriented architecture, or event-driven systems
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests, including unit and integration tests
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices
  • Experience using agents to support requirements clarification, solution design, code generation, refactoring, debugging, code review, and test creation
  • Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs
  • Experience applying test-driven development (TDD), test-first development, or similarly disciplined testing practices
  • Experience with event-driven development (EDD) or asynchronous system design, including messaging, event flows, and distributed system behavior
  • Strong commitment to code quality, maintainability, correctness, and attention to detail, including reviewing and improving agent-assisted output
  • Experience applying secure coding practices and working within engineering workflows that include quality and security controls
  • AI / Agentic
  • Proven hands-on experience using AI agents, orchestration tools, or structured LLM workflows in real development environments
  • Experience using agents to support:

Requirements clarification

Solution design

Code generation

Refactoring

Debugging

Code review

Test creation

  • Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs
  • Experience working with tools or frameworks such as: LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar

custom-built agent workflows

  • Strong understanding of limitations, failure modes, and trade-offs of LLM-based systems


Preferred Experience

  • Experience modernizing or untangling legacy web platforms
  • Experience with multi-tenant systems
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, observability tooling, and operational support in distributed systems
  • Experience in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments
  • Experience improving performance, stability, and operational maturity in customer-facing SaaS platforms
  • Experience applying TDD, test-first development, or similarly disciplined testing practices
  • Experience with event-driven development (EDD) or asynchronous system design
  • Strong commitment to code quality, maintainability, correctness, and attention to detail

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions.
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment.
  • Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;

title: UGC Content Creator
description:
Location: Remote

Type: Freelance / Contract

Compensation: R$350 –R$450 per week (based on tier) + bonuses (based on views)

Probation period: 2 weeks, paid R$250 / week


About Pure

Pure is a bold, global dating app redefining how people connect. We believe dating should be honest, fun, and free of judgment, a space to explore confidence, chemistry, and self-expression.

We’re building a UGC Creator Community of voices to help tell that story.


About the UGC Creator Community 

We’re looking for social media creators to join our UGC Pure Dating App Creator Community - a group of UGC content creators producing short-form videos (TikTok / Instagram) around themes like dating, confidence, self-love, etc.

As a creator, you’ll have the chance to collaborate with our team, build your personal brand, and get paid to create authentic, engaging content that challenges the way people see dating.


What You’ll Do

  • Create and post 7 short-form videos per week (TikTok / Instagram Reels / YouTube Shorts, etc)
  • Develop content inspired by dating, connection, and self-expression
  • Drive people to the app 
  • Participate in creative briefs, trend challenges, and campaigns
  • Receive feedback and coaching to grow your performance
  • Collaborate with our team on storytelling ideas and social strategies


What We’re Looking For

  • You must be based in Brazil and be fluent in Portuguese 
  • Passion for storytelling, social media, and modern culture
  • Familiarity with TikTok trends, Reels formats, and UGC-style videos
  • Strong on-camera presence and editing skills
  • Consistency and ability to meet weekly content goals
  • Open-minded and comfortable creating content about dating and relationships


Payment Structure

  • Tiered structure paid weekly
  • Bonuses for views (starting from 100K+ views)
  • Bonuses for registrations
  • Payments are made weekly


Why Join Us

  • Get paid to create authentic content about dating & self-expression
  • Access creative guidance, briefs, and a global network of creators
  • Build your portfolio while collaborating 
  • Enjoy creative freedom - your tone, your story, your perspective


How to Apply

Send us your cover letter and tell us a bit about yourself, including why you’d like to work with Pure app. 

You’ll be invited to join a group onboarding call and receive a task to create a test submission video. 

After that, you’ll enter a 2-week trial period, and if successful, you’ll be fully onboarded into the program.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

This role is critical in driving the optimization and enhancement of our Sales Cloud platform, ensuring seamless Salesforce migration , effective Salesforce administration , and robust system configuration and implementation . The Salesforce System Analyst will play a pivotal role in aligning our CRM capabilities with business goals, improving sales processes, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization.


Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage end-to-end Salesforce migration projects, ensuring data integrity and minimal disruption to business operations.
  • Perform comprehensive Salesforce administration tasks, including user management, security settings, and system maintenance.
  • Configure and customize Sales Cloud features to meet evolving business requirements, including workflows, validation rules, and custom objects.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze business processes, and translate them into scalable technical solutions within Salesforce .
  • Drive the implementation of new Salesforce functionalities and third-party integrations to enhance system capabilities.
  • Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues to maintain optimal platform efficiency.
  • Develop and maintain detailed documentation related to system configurations, processes, and best practices.
  • Provide training and support to end-users to maximize adoption and utilization of Salesforce tools.
  • Stay updated on the latest Salesforce releases and industry trends to recommend innovative solutions.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 5 to 10 years of proven experience as a Salesforce System Analyst or similar role.
  • Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Administrator (ADM 201) , Salesforce Platform App Builder , or relevant advanced certifications are highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of Sales Cloud functionalities and CRM best practices.
  • Demonstrated experience in Salesforce migration , administration, configuration , and implementation projects.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.


Tools and Technologies:

  • Salesforce Sales Cloud
  • Salesforce Administration tools and features
  • Salesforce Migration tools (e.g., Data Loader, Salesforce DX)
  • Salesforce Configuration and Customization tools (Workflows, Process Builder, Flow Builder)
  • Integration tools (e.g., MuleSoft, REST/SOAP APIs)
  • Reporting and Dashboard tools within Salesforce
  • Version control and collaboration platforms (e.g., Git, Jira)


Skills:

Sales Cloud, Salesforce migration, Salesforce administration, Configuration, Implementation

bout Turing:

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning.   • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.

  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer / Senior Data Engineer

Location: Costa Rica, Brazil or Mexico

Focus: Digital & Customer Experience Applications


Role Summary

We are seeking a Data Engineer / Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and operate scalable data pipelines and curated datasets. This role is pivotal in enabling Digital and Customer Experience applications across our global enterprise. You will work hands-on with Python, PySpark, and Databricks, championing modern engineering practices through Git-based workflows, CI/CD, and Azure DevOps to ensure high-quality data delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pipeline Development: Design and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines using Databricks and PySpark to transform and serve data for digital customer journeys.
  • Data Modeling: Build performant SQL transformations and curated dimensional data layers for downstream analytics and application consumption.
  • Engineering Excellence: Implement best practices for Databricks (notebooks vs. repos), modular code, cluster configuration, and cost-aware performance tuning.
  • Automation & Scripting: Utilize Python for data validation, orchestration helpers, and the creation of reusable libraries.
  • DevOps & CI/CD: * Manage source control via Git (GitHub/Bitbucket), enforcing strict PR reviews and branching strategies.
  • Build and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines to automate testing, packaging, and deployment across environments.
  • Quality & Reliability: Ensure data integrity through automated reconciliation checks, monitoring, and detailed operational runbooks.
  • Collaboration: Partner with product teams, analysts, and platform engineers to translate complex requirements into scalable data products.
  • Leadership (Senior Level): Lead module-level design, mentor junior engineers, and take ownership of critical pipeline delivery and enterprise code standards.


Technical Skills

Primary (Must-Have)

  • Advanced Data Engineering: Expert-level Python , PySpark , and SQL (advanced querying and optimization).
  • Databricks Ecosystem: Proficiency in Databricks jobs, workflows, clusters, and repos.
  • Version Control: Strong experience with Git (GitHub and/or Bitbucket) and enterprise branching workflows.
  • Azure DevOps: Hands-on experience with Boards, Repos, and Pipelines for build/release automation in data workloads.

Secondary (Good-to-Have)

  • Orchestration: Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF) for ingestion and scheduling patterns.
  • Data Visualization: Understanding of Power BI datasets, measures, and refresh patterns to support analytics enablement.

title: Virtual Assistant Team Manager - Independent Contractor
description:
Job description: Talent Manager(Independent Contractor)

**Must send resume in English**



Overview:

The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.


Key Responsibilities:


Relationship Management

  • Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time.

  • Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up.
  • Identify, document, and escalate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes.

Administrative

  • Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time.

  • Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
  • Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.
  • Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation.
  • Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement.
  • Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions.
  • Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processing


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management
  • Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information
  • Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills
  • Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy)
  • Proven ability to multitask (conversing while documenting)


Technical Requirements:

  • Fully remote position
  • High-speed, stable internet connection
  • Professional-grade webcam
  • High-quality speakerphone or headset
  • Modern computer with reliable performance
  • Proficiency with video conferencing tools and spreadsheet software


Personal Attributes:

  • Empathetic and active listener
  • Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment
  • Quick thinking and adaptable communication style
  • Patient and persistent in building relationships
  • Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individuals



Note: This is an independent contractor position. Candidates must provide their own equipment and manage their own taxes and benefits.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Estamos buscando profissionais de Quality Engineering (QE) com foco total em automação.


Você fará parte de um time orientado à inovação, excelência técnica e qualidade ponta a ponta, atuando em um ecossistema distribuído, com integrações, mensageria e pipelines CI/CD maduros.


Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver, executar e manter testes automatizados com foco em APIs e microserviços .
  • Especificar e implementar cenários em BDD com Gherkin (uso obrigatório) .
  • Registrar, organizar e rastrear cenários, evidências e resultados no Jira/Xray , garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta.
  • Garantir cobertura e eficácia aplicando técnicas de caixa preta e caixa branca .
  • Integrar automações aos pipelines de CI/CD (ex.: Jenkins) .
  • Executar smoke tests e identificar rapidamente falhas críticas.
  • Validar fluxos síncronos e assíncronos, incluindo cenários com mensageria (AWS SQS) .
  • Utilizar Docker para provisionamento de ambientes e execução em pipelines.
  • Apoiar investigação de falhas com ferramentas de observabilidade (logs, métricas, traces) .
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento, produto e operações assegurando qualidade ponta a ponta.


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Experiência sólida com Playwright (automação) .
  • Experiência com BDD + Gherkin (uso obrigatório) e Xray com cenários em Gherkin.
  • Domínio profundo de APIs (payloads, autenticação, contratos, timeouts, retries, tratamento de erros).
  • Experiência com CI/CD e execução de testes em pipelines (ex.: Jenkins) .
  • Conhecimento em Docker e ambientes conteinerizados.
  • Experiência em arquitetura distribuída / microserviços.
  • Domínio de técnicas de teste caixa preta e caixa branca .
  • Vivência com smoke testing .
  • Programação em JavaScript (eliminatório) – capacidade real de implementar, manter e evoluir código de automação.


Diferenciais


  • Experiência com validação de fluxos assíncronos e mensageria (SQS/DLQ/reprocessamento) .
  • Noções de Kubernetes/EKS para troubleshooting.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade (Dynatrace, OpenTelemetry, Grafana Loki).
  • Experiência com testes de performance e segurança.
  • Conhecimento em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) .
  • Noções de Terraform .



A OSF Digital tem orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais, onde você pode ser você mesmo no trabalho. Junte-se a uma comunidade inclusiva e apaixonada de profissionais que ajudam a promover a transformação digital para empresas ao redor do mundo.

Na OSF Digital, acolhemos todas as pessoas e não discriminamos com base em identidade e expressão de gênero, raça, etnia, deficiência, orientação sexual, cor, religião, origem nacional, idade, estado civil ou qualquer outra categoria protegida em qualquer jurisdição onde atuamos.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer


Our Client is hiring a designer to support a high-output marketing team. This is not a brand-from-scratch role. The design system exists, and the job is to execute consistently, extend it intelligently, and keep things moving without hand-holding.


You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels.


What you’ll do

  • You’ll be responsible for a wide range of design work tied directly to pipeline-driving campaigns
  • Create graphics for social, paid campaigns, email, and web
  • Design and iterate on landing pages in Webflow
  • Produce visual assets for webinars, virtual events, and campaigns
  • Design print collateral and occasional physical assets (including SWAG)
  • Create GIFs, motion elements, and lightweight animations
  • Edit video for social distribution and website use
  • Support ongoing campaign launches with fast-turn creative
  • This is a volume role, and you’ll be expected to make good decisions quickly and maintain quality under pace.


What matters in this role

  • You can operate inside an existing brand system without needing constant direction
  • You understand how design actually shows up in B2B marketing, not just how it looks in a portfolio
  • You’re comfortable moving between formats. Static, motion, web, video. No one is handing off perfect briefs every time
  • You have strong judgment about what’s “good enough to ship” vs what needs refinement
  • You can manage your own workflow and keep projects moving without bottlenecks


Requirements

  • 4+ years in a design role, ideally supporting marketing or growth teams
  • Strong portfolio that shows real campaign work, not just one-off visuals
  • Experience designing in Webflow (not just Figma concepts)
  • Experience with motion design and basic animation (GIFs, short-form video)
  • Video editing experience for social and web content
  • Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite


Context for the work

Our client sells to B2B marketing teams running webinars and virtual events as part of pipeline generation. That means the creative you produce will be tied directly to:

  • Driving registrations and product demos
  • Increasing engagement
  • Supporting sales follow-up
  • Reinforcing brand credibility with senior marketing leaders

The output needs to feel polished, but it has to perform, not just look good.


What this is not

  • Not a pure brand exploration role
  • Not a pixel-perfect, weeks-per-project environment
  • Not isolated design work handed over a wall


You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you.


If that sounds like your kind of environment, this will be a good fit.

title: Analista de Negócios

O DESAFIO


  • Levantar e documentar requisitos de negócio para novas funcionalidades e projetos.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer


Our Client is hiring a designer to support a high-output marketing team. This is not a brand-from-scratch role. The design system exists, and the job is to execute consistently, extend it intelligently, and keep things moving without hand-holding.


You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels.


What you’ll do

  • You’ll be responsible for a wide range of design work tied directly to pipeline-driving campaigns
  • Create graphics for social, paid campaigns, email, and web
  • Design and iterate on landing pages in Webflow
  • Produce visual assets for webinars, virtual events, and campaigns
  • Design print collateral and occasional physical assets (including SWAG)
  • Create GIFs, motion elements, and lightweight animations
  • Edit video for social distribution and website use
  • Support ongoing campaign launches with fast-turn creative
  • This is a volume role, and you’ll be expected to make good decisions quickly and maintain quality under pace.


What matters in this role

  • You can operate inside an existing brand system without needing constant direction
  • You understand how design actually shows up in B2B marketing, not just how it looks in a portfolio
  • You’re comfortable moving between formats. Static, motion, web, video. No one is handing off perfect briefs every time
  • You have strong judgment about what’s “good enough to ship” vs what needs refinement
  • You can manage your own workflow and keep projects moving without bottlenecks


Requirements

  • 4+ years in a design role, ideally supporting marketing or growth teams
  • Strong portfolio that shows real campaign work, not just one-off visuals
  • Experience designing in Webflow (not just Figma concepts)
  • Experience with motion design and basic animation (GIFs, short-form video)
  • Video editing experience for social and web content
  • Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite


Context for the work

Our client sells to B2B marketing teams running webinars and virtual events as part of pipeline generation. That means the creative you produce will be tied directly to:

  • Driving registrations and product demos
  • Increasing engagement
  • Supporting sales follow-up
  • Reinforcing brand credibility with senior marketing leaders

The output needs to feel polished, but it has to perform, not just look good.


What this is not

  • Not a pure brand exploration role
  • Not a pixel-perfect, weeks-per-project environment
  • Not isolated design work handed over a wall


You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you.


If that sounds like your kind of environment, this will be a good fit.

title: Consultor SAP Datasphere
description:

Objetivo da Função

Atuar como especialista em SAP Datasphere em contrato temporário de 2 meses, apoiando o cliente na integração, preparação, modelagem e disponibilização de dados com governança e performance, garantindo a entrega de modelos e pipelines confiáveis para consumo analítico.

  • Experiência sólida com SAP Datasphere: Spaces, Connections, Data Builder e Business Builder.

We are looking for a full-time, remote Agentic Developer with 8+ years of experience in .NET, C#, Python, Node.js, or similar to join our client's Web / Foundations Team. In this role, you will contribute to the development and evolution of our client's core web platform, a mission-critical SaaS system that supports real-world customer workflows across healthcare, legal, education, and enterprise environments. You will play a key role in building and enhancing core product capabilities while ensuring reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Hello from RE Partners!


Who We Are: We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.

The 3 G’s of RE:

“Get Shit Done.”

“Get Over Shit.”

“Give a Shit.”


DevOps Engineer


We are looking for a DevOps Engineer with basic Golang skills to support a team focused on improving development processes and the product. In this role, you will work closely with a Staff Engineer building with a focus on designing, migrating, implementing, and maintaining the infrastructure and cloud environments that enable these systems to operate reliably and at scale.


Your work will involve containerized services, AWS Lambda, Terraform-managed infrastructure, and secure data transfer between AWS accounts , with a strong emphasis on scalability, security, and operational excellence.


You will collaborate with engineering, product, and operational teams, while also coordinating technical requirements with the vendor. Strong communication skills are important, as you’ll often act as the bridge between the team and other internal teams, ensuring infrastructure and systems are aligned with internal standards and best practices.



What we’re looking for:


● Strong AWS and DevOps experience (infrastructure, deployments, operations, observability)


● Solid experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred)


● Experience with containerized environments (Docker, ECS/EKS, etc.)


● Hands-on experience with AWS services such as Lambda and related cloud tooling


● Golang and Bash skills for scripting, automation, and backend support

description:

About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

The BMP (Business Model and Pricing) Analytics team is seeking an experienced Data Engineer to support business performance management and strategic decision-making through scalable data infrastructure and engineering solutions. The team partners closely with leadership, finance, operations, and business stakeholders to enable reliable, high-quality data access, support advanced analytics, and drive data-informed actions across the organization.

The Data Engineer will play a critical role in designing, building, and maintaining robust data pipelines, data models, and foundational data assets that power analytics, reporting, and emerging AI/ML capabilities. title: Direct Response Creative Strategist
description:
Direct Response Creative Strategist (Meta Ads Focus)


Company:

Penrose Skin

Location: Fully Remote

Compensation: $50,000 to $72,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure

Job Type: Full-time


The Opportunity

Own the creative engine behind a DTC brand currently spending nearly $700K per month on Meta Ads with a target to scale to $2-3M per month in ad spend this year. You will write the scripts, build the strategy, and drive the ads that take Penrose Skin to the next level. This is a high-impact role for an elite direct response creative strategist who operates with extreme autonomy, understands deep consumer psychology, and wants a direct line to the founders.


About Penrose Skin

We are a premium direct-to-consumer grooming brand known for luxury, pheromone-infused body butters inspired by designer fragrances. From a niche disruptor, we have grown rapidly through viral digital marketing into a highly sought-after grooming essential. With a strong DTC presence and ambitious product launches ahead, this role sits at the absolute center of our next phase of aggressive scaling.


What You Will Do

Scale the Account: Push our Meta ad spend from its current $700K per month toward $2-3M per month while maintaining or improving ROAS through relentless creative testing and iteration.

Deep Psychological Strategy: Build concepts based on deep customer personas and match specific marketing frameworks (unaware, problem-aware, solution-aware) to those personas and their desires.

High-Volume Output: Produce a high volume of quality concepts weekly, working seamlessly with our graphic designers and leveraging AI tools (like nanobanana pro) to build statics on your own.

Scientific Iteration: Run \"learnings\" on every single creative. Form a hypothesis, test it, analyze why it worked or failed, and iterate on the winners relentlessly.

UGC and Content Mastery: Build and improve systems to source UGC, brief creators, manage AI video creatives, and oversee the production of high-converting assets.


What We Are Looking For

Proven Scale: You have a documented track record of managing creative strategy for Meta ad accounts spending $500K+ per month and have helped scale ad spend to $1M+ per month.

Extreme Autonomy: You do not wait for instructions. You get things done, build systems, and take full ownership of the creative pipeline without being asked.

Psychology Expert: You deeply understand consumer awareness stages, emotional hooks, personas, and how to write copy that converts cold traffic for specific audience segments.

AI and Format Fluent: You are up-to-date with the latest AI tech for ad creation (statics, video, AI-generated content) and know how to design listicles, advertorials, and hybrid MOF/BOF ads.

Obsessive Learner: You are addicted to learning, improving, and analyzing data to beat your own control ads. You stay on top of every new tool and trend in the space.


Our Culture

We are not a corporate 9-to-5. We are a small, obsessive team that plays to win.

We believe discipline beats motivation, every single day. We go all in, execute relentlessly, and hold ourselves to excruciatingly high standards because great is simply not good enough. We take full responsibility for our results. No excuses, no blame, no waiting to be saved.

We stay focused. We eliminate distractions. We embrace resistance because the sword can only be forged under fire.

We are radically honest, delusionally optimistic, and deeply grateful, but never satisfied.

If that sounds exhausting, this is not for you. If it sounds like home, we want to talk.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Java/Angular) - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • At least 4 years of professional experience in Java development;
  • Experience with cloud environments and modern backend systems;
  • Hands-on experience with Spring Boot and microservices architecture;
  • Experience working with Apache Kafka;
  • Experience with Angular for frontend development;
  • English level B2 or higher, with the ability to communicate effectively;
  • Ability to communicate in Portuguese;
  • Willingness to relocate from Brazil to Portugal;
  • Available to work in Porto or Lisbon (hybrid work model).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to: .

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Estamos buscando profissionais de Quality Engineering (QE) com foco total em automação.


Você fará parte de um time orientado à inovação, excelência técnica e qualidade ponta a ponta, atuando em um ecossistema distribuído, com integrações, mensageria e pipelines CI/CD maduros.


Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver, executar e manter testes automatizados com foco em APIs e microserviços .
  • Especificar e implementar cenários em BDD com Gherkin (uso obrigatório) .
  • Registrar, organizar e rastrear cenários, evidências e resultados no Jira/Xray , garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta.
  • Garantir cobertura e eficácia aplicando técnicas de caixa preta e caixa branca .
  • Integrar automações aos pipelines de CI/CD (ex.: Jenkins) .
  • Executar smoke tests e identificar rapidamente falhas críticas.
  • Validar fluxos síncronos e assíncronos, incluindo cenários com mensageria (AWS SQS) .
  • Utilizar Docker para provisionamento de ambientes e execução em pipelines.
  • Apoiar investigação de falhas com ferramentas de observabilidade (logs, métricas, traces) .
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento, produto e operações assegurando qualidade ponta a ponta.


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Experiência sólida com Playwright (automação) .
  • Experiência com BDD + Gherkin (uso obrigatório) e Xray com cenários em Gherkin.
  • Domínio profundo de APIs (payloads, autenticação, contratos, timeouts, retries, tratamento de erros).
  • Experiência com CI/CD e execução de testes em pipelines (ex.: Jenkins) .
  • Conhecimento em Docker e ambientes conteinerizados.
  • Experiência em arquitetura distribuída / microserviços.
  • Domínio de técnicas de teste caixa preta e caixa branca .
  • Vivência com smoke testing .
  • Programação em JavaScript (eliminatório) – capacidade real de implementar, manter e evoluir código de automação.


Diferenciais


  • Experiência com validação de fluxos assíncronos e mensageria (SQS/DLQ/reprocessamento) .
  • Noções de Kubernetes/EKS para troubleshooting.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade (Dynatrace, OpenTelemetry, Grafana Loki).
  • Experiência com testes de performance e segurança.
  • Conhecimento em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) .
  • Noções de Terraform .

title: Go High Level (GHL) Intern
description:
Calling All Awesome Marketing Interns!!!


We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented GoHighLevel (GHL) Marketing Intern to support the growth of our vacation rental management business. This role is ideal for someone who wants hands-on experience in funnel building, landing pages, and performance marketing.


The program is a 3-month remote internship, during which you will assist in fulfilling various digital marketing tasks for your mentioned business for 10 hours per week. This is an unpaid program whose end goal is to provide students with a higher chance of getting hired in the digital marketing space after completing our apprenticeship program.


Check with your school's Internship Coordinator BEFORE accepting the hiring offer to determine if this position satisfies the criteria for receiving academic credit.


What’s In It For You?

  • It’s (100%) fully remote position and offers flexibility in schedule.
  • You’ll have clear goals and the training resources you need to deliver.
  • Access our free courses on the platform that you can finish at your own pace.
  • 1 to 2 hours of mentorship every week.
  • Issued certification upon successfully completing the program.
  • Boost your portfolio and grow your professional network
  • Get to utilize and elevate your digital marketing skills in real projects
  • You have a high chance of being hired by your mentor during or after the apprenticeship, depending on your performance.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Update and optimize our existing GoHighLevel website for a vacation rental management company
  • Collaborate with the business owner and marketing coach to implement pre-planned funnel pages and campaigns
  • Build and maintain high-converting landing pages for vacation rental properties (with scalable/duplicable templates)
  • Ensure all pages are fully functional, user-friendly, and properly tracking traffic sources (especially Facebook Ads)
  • Support customer acquisition efforts by coordinating email marketing and Facebook ad campaigns already in place
  • Monitor and optimize campaign performance to improve guest conversion and increase direct bookings
  • Implement additional marketing strategies on the website (e.g., blog pages, service pages)
  • Provide recommendations to improve website traffic, lead generation, and conversion rates
  • Ensure consistent website experience across all traffic sources, including referrals from partner platforms (e.g., tourist bureau listings)


Qualifications:

  • Basic experience or strong interest in GoHighLevel (GHL)
  • Familiarity with landing pages, funnels, and digital marketing concepts
  • Understanding of Facebook Ads and email marketing (hands-on experience is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to troubleshoot page issues
  • Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively
  • Self-starter with a willingness to learn and take initiative


Nice to Have:

  • Experience in vacation rental, hospitality, or real estate marketing
  • Basic knowledge of SEO and content marketing (blogs, service pages)
  • Experience with analytics and tracking tools


About us:

Acadium started with the belief that anyone, anywhere, should be able to get the skills and experience they need to start their career without barriers like price, schedule, or location getting in their way. Acadium gives anyone the tools, support, and mentorship they need to launch their dream career. Acadium is the only platform that provides real work experience, accessible to everyone. Acadium began in 2017 with a team of 3 co-founders: Richard Shaw, Marco Tundo, and Moe Abbas. Since then, they’ve attracted more than 120,000 student members and over 50,000 businesses to connect through the apprenticeship marketplace. Our team is growing and looking for people who are motivated, intelligent, and committed to making education accessible to join our team.


What We Value:

  • Integrity - Be trustworthy in your actions
  • Care - Treat your teammates and our community as you would want to be treated
  • Curiosity - Ask questions. Always state your assumptions
  • Tenacity - Persevere when times are tough
  • Discipline - Be consistent in your actions
  • Ambition - Aspire to become better every day
  • Service -Serve your community to the best of your abilities.

title: Senior Developer in Spyglass
description:
Senior Developer with primary focus on Spyglass Event Configuration Management


Responsibilities


  • Design and implement Event Correlation Rules within Spyglass to aggregate disparate logs and metrics into meaningful business events;
  • Configure Event Policies Suppression Rules and Deduplication logic to reduce alert fatigue for L1/L2 support teams
  • Build and maintain Spyglass Dashboards that provide real time visibility into the health of the FMCG application landscape
  • Experience Engineering Mobile and Emerging Tech
  • Integrate Spyglass with diverse data sources Azure Monitor GCP Cloud Logging AWS CloudWatch and ELKFalcon LogScale
  • Manage the lifecycle of an event from ingestion and normalization to correlation alerting and archival
  • Proactive Monitoring SRE Integration
  • Develop Thresholdbased and Anomaly detection alerts to identify performance degradation before it impacts the consumer experience
  • Implement Service Level Objective SLO monitoring within Spyglass to track the reliability of critical business paths, eg OrdertoCash, Checkout flows
  • Automate the creation of incidents in ITSM tools, eg ServiceNow, based on Spyglass event triggers
  • Build Situation Rooms or high level executive views within Spyglass for major promotional events or seasonal peaks
  • Ensure seamless event ingestion from hyperscaler hosted microservices AKSGKE and serverless functions
  • Support the monitoring of Integration Platforms Boomi APIM by capturing and correlating middleware execution events
  • Collaborate with the Cloud Infrastructure team to monitor network latency and connectivity events across the global AzureGCP backbone


Senior Developer Specifics

  • Lead the architectural design of the Global Event Management Strategy
  • Define enterprise standards for event metadata severity levels and correlation patterns
  • Mentor junior developers in eventdriven observability and AIOps principles
  • Conduct PostMortem analysis of major incidents to refine Spyglass correlation rules and prevent recurrence


Must have

  • Spyglass Event Management Expert level, proficiency in Spyglass configuration rule writing and dashboarding
  • Event Correlation Deep understanding of event patterns deduplication and suppression logic
  • Observability Integration Hands on experience connecting Spyglass to Azure Monitor, GCP Stackdriver or ELK
  • ITSM Integration
  • Proven experience integrating event platforms with ServiceNow or similar tools
  • Data Normalization, Ability to parse and normalize logs events from heterogeneous sources JSON, XML, Syslog

title: Virtual Assistant Team Manager - Independent Contractor
description:
Job description: Talent Manager(Independent Contractor)

**Must send resume in English**



Overview:

The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.


Key Responsibilities:


Relationship Management

  • Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Build and maintain professional, trust-based relationships with Virtual Assistants while encouraging open, honest dialogue.
  • Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up.
  • Identify, document, and escalate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes.
  • Create a supportive and open communication environment with VAs, clients, and management.
  • Detect subtle communication cues and potential challenges, log observations, and alert management when appropriate.



Administrative

  • Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time.
  • Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
  • Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
  • Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.
  • Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation.
  • Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement.
  • Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions.
  • Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processing


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management
  • Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information
  • Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills
  • Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy)
  • Proven ability to multitask (conversing while documenting)


Technical Requirements:

  • Fully remote position
  • High-speed, stable internet connection
  • Professional-grade webcam
  • High-quality speakerphone or headset
  • Modern computer with reliable performance
  • Proficiency with video conferencing tools and spreadsheet software


Personal Attributes:

  • Empathetic and active listener
  • Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment
  • Quick thinking and adaptable communication style
  • Patient and persistent in building relationships
  • Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individuals

title: Direct Response Creative Strategist
description:
Direct Response Creative Strategist (Meta Ads Focus)


Company:

Penrose Skin

Location: Fully Remote

Compensation: $50,000 to $72,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure

Job Type: Full-time


The Opportunity

Own the creative engine behind a DTC brand currently spending nearly $700K per month on Meta Ads with a target to scale to $2-3M per month in ad spend this year. You will write the scripts, build the strategy, and drive the ads that take Penrose Skin to the next level. This is a high-impact role for an elite direct response creative strategist who operates with extreme autonomy, understands deep consumer psychology, and wants a direct line to the founders.


About Penrose Skin

We are a premium direct-to-consumer grooming brand known for luxury, pheromone-infused body butters inspired by designer fragrances. From a niche disruptor, we have grown rapidly through viral digital marketing into a highly sought-after grooming essential. With a strong DTC presence and ambitious product launches ahead, this role sits at the absolute center of our next phase of aggressive scaling.


What You Will Do

Scale the Account: Push our Meta ad spend from its current $700K per month toward $2-3M per month while maintaining or improving ROAS through relentless creative testing and iteration.

Deep Psychological Strategy: Build concepts based on deep customer personas and match specific marketing frameworks (unaware, problem-aware, solution-aware) to those personas and their desires.

High-Volume Output: Produce a high volume of quality concepts weekly, working seamlessly with our graphic designers and leveraging AI tools (like nanobanana pro) to build statics on your own.

Scientific Iteration: Run \"learnings\" on every single creative. Form a hypothesis, test it, analyze why it worked or failed, and iterate on the winners relentlessly.

UGC and Content Mastery: Build and improve systems to source UGC, brief creators, manage AI video creatives, and oversee the production of high-converting assets.


What We Are Looking For

Proven Scale: You have a documented track record of managing creative strategy for Meta ad accounts spending $500K+ per month and have helped scale ad spend to $1M+ per month.

Extreme Autonomy: You do not wait for instructions. You get things done, build systems, and take full ownership of the creative pipeline without being asked.

Psychology Expert: You deeply understand consumer awareness stages, emotional hooks, personas, and how to write copy that converts cold traffic for specific audience segments.

AI and Format Fluent: You are up-to-date with the latest AI tech for ad creation (statics, video, AI-generated content) and know how to design listicles, advertorials, and hybrid MOF/BOF ads.

Obsessive Learner: You are addicted to learning, improving, and analyzing data to beat your own control ads. You stay on top of every new tool and trend in the space.


Our Culture

We are not a corporate 9-to-5. We are a small, obsessive team that plays to win.

We believe discipline beats motivation, every single day. We go all in, execute relentlessly, and hold ourselves to excruciatingly high standards because great is simply not good enough. We take full responsibility for our results. No excuses, no blame, no waiting to be saved.

We stay focused. We eliminate distractions. We embrace resistance because the sword can only be forged under fire.

We are radically honest, delusionally optimistic, and deeply grateful, but never satisfied.

If that sounds exhausting, this is not for you. If it sounds like home, we want to talk.

title: Quality Assurence
description:
Estamos buscando profissionais de QA com forte atuação funcional e suporte técnico em automação.


Buscamos profissionais para atuação em qualidade ponta a ponta , com foco em validação funcional, geração de evidências e rastreabilidade das entregas em um ecossistema com microserviços, integrações e múltiplos meios de pagamento .


Essa posição tem foco funcional, porém exige conhecimento obrigatório em JavaScript e Playwright , para apoiar validações técnicas, ajustes de fluxo e interpretações de respostas de APIs quando necessário.


Você fará parte de um time orientado à excelência em qualidade, atuando de forma próxima aos times de desenvolvimento, produto e operações.


Responsabilidades


  • Participar de refinamentos, entendimento de regras de negócio e definição de critérios de aceite.
  • Planejar, executar e evidenciar testes funcionais ponta a ponta.
  • Criar e manter cenários e casos de teste com rastreabilidade no Jira/Xray , utilizando BDD com Gherkin (uso obrigatório) .
  • Executar testes de regressão, testes exploratórios e suporte a UAT/homologação.
  • Validar integrações e fluxos críticos envolvendo APIs, microserviços, mensageria (SQS), ERP e meios de pagamento (Pix, Boleto e Cartão) .
  • Acompanhar incidentes/bugs, apoiar priorização e realizar retestes.
  • Garantir rastreabilidade entre requisito ↔ teste ↔ evidência ↔ defeito .
  • Implementar testes e ajustes utilizando Playwright .
  • Apoiar validações técnicas com JavaScript (ex.: lógica de validação, estruturação de payloads, análise de respostas de APIs, interpretação de objetos JSON e pequenos scripts de apoio).


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Experiência com testes funcionais e processos de qualidade em ambientes ágeis.
  • Vivência com sistemas distribuídos e integrações (APIs/microserviços).
  • Experiência com validação de APIs via Postman ou Insomnia .
  • Experiência com Jira e Xray .
  • Uso obrigatório de BDD com Gherkin para criação e manutenção de cenários.
  • Boa escrita de cenários, critérios de aceite e documentação de evidências.
  • Experiência com testes de regressão e priorização de cenários críticos.
  • Conhecimento obrigatório em JavaScript (não atuará como QE, mas precisa interpretar, ajustar e criar pequenos trechos de código).
  • Experiência sólida com Playwright (locators, interações, assertions, waits, screenshots e vídeos).
  • Experiência com CI/CD e execução de testes em pipelines (ex.: Jenkins) .
  • Conhecimento em Docker e ambientes conteinerizados.


Diferenciais


  • Noções de observabilidade (Dynatrace, Loki).
  • Experiência com jornadas de Checkout e Pagamentos (Pix, boleto, cartão) .
  • Noções de segurança/controles (ex.: PCI) aplicados a testes.
  • Conhecimento básico em AWS ou ambientes cloud (multi-account) .

description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Brazil Senior Condition Intelligence (CI & PM)
description:
Company Description

Dingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world’s largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities.

Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey.


Role Description

As a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime.

In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo’s advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results.

With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo’s reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.


Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality.

Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life.

Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics.

Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities.

Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality.

Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records.

title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.


The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.


What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.


Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.


This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.
