title: Analista de infraestrutura Pleno - Remoto
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Detalhes da vaga

-CLT + Benefícios

-Modelo de atuação: Remoto


O analista de observabilidade será responsável por monitorar, diagnosticar e otimizar sistemas e aplicações, garantindo a visibilidade de ponta a ponta da infraestrutura tecnológica. Esse profissional deve dominar ferramentas de observabilidade e ter um olhar analítico para resolver problemas complexos em ambientes dinâmicos.


Responsabilidades

  • Configuração e gerenciamento de dashboards para monitoramento em tempo real.
  • Diagnóstico e análise de problemas em sistemas e aplicações, identificando causas raízes.
  • Gestão de Ferramentas de Observabilidade: Implantação e configuração de ferramentas como Elastic Stack (ELK), Zabbix, Grafana, Prometheus, New Relic, Dynatrace, Datadog entre outras. Automação de alertas e relatórios utilizando essas ferramentas.
  • Análise de Métricas e Logs: Coleta, tratamento e análise de métricas e logs para identificar tendências ou incidentes. Desenvolvimento de soluções para problemas relacionados ao desempenho e à confiabilidade dos sistemas.
  • Colaboração com Times de Desenvolvimento e Infraestrutura: Auxílio no desenho de soluções que melhorem a observabilidade de novas aplicações. Trabalhar junto com times DevOps para garantir a implementação de práticas de observabilidade no ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software.
  • Proatividade em Melhoria Contínua: Recomendação de melhorias para aumentar a eficiência da infraestrutura e aplicações.
  • Participação em incidentes críticos e suporte para garantir alta disponibilidade dos serviços.


Conhecimento Técnico

  • Ferramentas: Conhecimento prático em ferramentas de observabilidade como: Dynatrace, Elastic Stack (ELK), Zabbix, Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk Datadog, New Relic ou similares.
  • DevOps: Experiência com automação usando Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins ou similares. Cloud: Conhecimento em observabilidade de ambientes cloud (Azure), incluindo monitoramento de serviços específicos.
  • Linguagens de Script: Habilidade em Python, Shell Script, ou PowerShell para automação de tarefas.
  • APM (Application Performance Monitoring): Experiência com ferramentas APM e análise de desempenho de aplicações.
  • Logs e Métricas: Domínio sobre coleta, centralização e análise de logs/métricas.


Certificações

  • Certificações como: LPIC-2: Linux Engineer, CompTIA Linux+, ZCS – Zabbix Certified Specialist 5.0, ZCP – Zabbix Certified Professional 5.0, ITIL® Foundation Certificate in IT Service Management,

E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Comprador
description:
Descrição da Empresa A PONTO FACIL FERRAMENTAS E MATERIAIS é uma empresa dedicada a fornecer as melhores soluções em ferramentas e materiais, visando atender clientes com eficiência e qualidade. Com um forte compromisso com a excelência no atendimento, buscamos sempre oferecer produtos diversificados e inovadores para nossos parceiros e consumidores. Nossa missão é ser referência no setor, promovendo valores como confiabilidade e agilidade em todas as nossas operações.
Descrição do Cargo Estamos contratando um Comprador para atuar em nossa unidade localizada em Blumenau, SC. Este cargo é responsável por negociar com fornecedores, realizar compras de insumos e materiais, e monitorar os processos de aquisição para garantir um abastecimento eficaz e com custos competitivos. O profissional deverá analisar cotações, avaliar fornecedores, gerenciar prazos de entrega e assegurar a qualidade dos produtos adquiridos. Este é um cargo de tempo integral, com necessidade de trabalho presencial.
Qualificações
  • Compras e Negociação: Experiência em processos de compras, negociação com fornecedores e controle de custos.
  • Análise de Mercado: Habilidade em realizar pesquisa de mercado para identificar melhores oportunidades de aquisição e novos fornecedores.
  • Gestão de Estoque: Conhecimento em controle de estoque e reposição estratégica para evitar rupturas ou excessos.
  • Será um diferencial ter formação em Administração, Logística, ou áreas correlatas, e conhecimentos em sistemas de ERP.

title: Business Strategy Consultant
description:
Organizations collect mountains of data about their customers — and still struggle to act on it. They run surveys, build dashboards, and generate reports, but often lack the structured thinking to turn those outputs into decisions that actually change the business. This role exists to close that gap.


Responsibilities:

  • Diagnosing drivers of customer satisfaction, loyalty, and operational performance across enterprise clients.
  • Structuring insights from large datasets and Voice of Customer programs into strategic recommendations.
  • Developing analytical frameworks that connect behavioral and operational data to business outcomes.
  • Building executive presentations and data-driven narratives for C-level and senior stakeholders.
  • Contributing to consulting proposals and new service offerings — translating insights into commercial value propositions.
  • Supporting the development of consulting methodologies, tools, and analytical approaches.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, Data Science, or Marketing.
  • 3–6 years of experience in roles such as Strategy consulting; Business analytics or insights; Strategic planning; Business intelligence or data-driven product roles.
  • Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.
  • Structured problem-solving and analytical framework development.
  • Ability to synthesize qualitative and quantitative inputs into strategic recommendations
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.


Desired Skills:

  • Fluency in Spanish.
  • SQL, Python, or R.
  • Power BI, Tableau, or other BI tools.
  • Experience with customer analytics, Voice of Customer programs, or customer journey analysis.

title: BDR (Business Development Representative)
description:
About Foundey

Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting SaaS, AI, and tech startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with founders to deliver high-impact design solutions—from MVP design sprints to full-scale product interface design and UX audits.


The Opportunity

We’re looking for a proactive, hands on and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand Foundey’s pipeline of high-quality startup clients. In this role, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers—primarily founders and decision-makers in SaaS, AI, and tech companies.

You’ll play a critical role in connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys building relationships from the ground up.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and research potential clients within SaaS, AI, and tech startup ecosystems
  • Conduct outbound prospecting via email, LinkedIn, and other channels
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads to assess fit and readiness
  • Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities
  • Collaborate with marketing and design teams to refine outreach messaging
  • Track activities and performance using CRM tools
  • Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback


Qualifications

  • 3 years+ of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in SaaS or agency environments)
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially in written outreach
  • Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce)
  • Ability to understand and communicate design, product, or tech-related concepts
  • Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely
  • English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus)


Nice to Have

  • Experience selling design, product, or digital services
  • Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development
  • Experience working with early-stage startups or founders


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Arquiteto de Soluções - Java
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.

Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Modelo de trabalho: remoto


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações de software utilizando Java e frameworks modernos.
  • Implementar e otimizar APIs RESTful, garantindo a integração com sistemas externos.
  • Participar do desenvolvimento do frontend utilizando Angular, garantindo uma experiência de usuário fluida e responsiva.
  • Aplicar princípios de Clean Code e boas práticas de desenvolvimento durante todo o ciclo de vida do software.
  • Projetar e implementar soluções baseadas em microserviços, utilizando boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para definir requisitos e desenvolver soluções inovadoras.
  • Conduzir revisões de código e garantir a qualidade do código por meio de ferramentas como SonarQube.
  • Implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para automação de testes e deploy.
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências de tecnologia e propor melhorias contínuas nas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Explorar e integrar soluções de Inteligência Artificial em projetos.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação completa na área de Tecnologia da Informação ou curso de graduação em qualquer área de formação, acrescido de curso de pós-graduação na área de engenharia de software ou desenvolvimento de software.
  • Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento e arquitetura Java.
  • Conhecimento em Clean Code, princípios SOLID e Design Patterns (Factory, Singleton, Strategy, etc.)
  • Desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs RESTful, utilizando Spring Boot e/ou Quarkus.
  • Experiência com API externas, mensageria (Kafka, AMQ), web services (SOAP, REST).
  • Persistência de dados utilizando JPA/Hibernate, modelagem de banco de dados, otimização de queries e índices.
  • Conhecimentos avançados em Angular (versões modernas), incluindo: componentização, services e injeção de dependência, RxJS (Observables), Integração com APIs REST e Lazy loading.

Vale-alimentação ou vale-refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini — plataforma com cursos on-line, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência médica;

title: Citrix Engineer - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.

  • More than 4 years as a Citrix Engineer ;

  • Fluency in English (B2+) - Mandatory ;

What do we have to offer you?

title: Desenvolvedor Mobile (Front-End) - Remoto
description:

title: Performance Video Editor - Meta Ads (Remote)
description:
Creative Video Editor - DTC Brand


Location: Fully Remote (must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Create scroll-stopping content for a scaling DTC brand. We need a performance-focused video editor who can turn raw footage into high-converting ads and social content - with creative freedom and direct feedback loops on what's working.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, eco-friendly pet care brand expanding across major retailers like Walmart, Target, and Chewy. Our marketing team is scaling rapidly, and we're looking for a video editor who wants to grow their skills in performance marketing while building a long-term role with a mission-driven company.


The Role

You'll be our go-to editor for short-form video content that drives sales—think Facebook/Instagram ads, TikTok content, and social clips. You'll work with a steady flow of creator and product footage, turning it into thumb-stopping content that performs. This isn't agency churn-and-burn; you'll see what converts, iterate based on data, and refine your craft with real-time feedback.


What You'll Do

Video Editing & Production

  • Create high-performing Facebook/Instagram ad creatives and social media clips
  • Edit short-form content optimized for platform-specific formats
  • Source and organize B-roll and stock footage using the provided subscriptions
  • Manage creator content in Frame.io and maintain organized asset libraries

Graphic Design & Assets

  • Design marketing images, thumbnails, and social graphics
  • Create on-brand visual assets using Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva

Project Management

  • Track assignments and status updates in ClickUp
  • Follow naming conventions and file organization protocols
  • Communicate proactively about timelines, blockers, and questions


Requirements

  • 3-5+ years of video editing experience, specializing in short-form content
  • Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills (required)
  • Proven experience creating or editing Facebook/Instagram ads
  • Mid-level proficiency with Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva
  • Strong fundamentals in typography, color theory, composition, and motion graphics
  • Fluent English — excellent written and verbal communication
  • Self-managed — strong time management and ability to meet daily/weekly deadlines
  • Proactive communicator — asks questions early, flags issues before they become problems
  • Portfolio required — you must submit a portfolio showcasing your video editing work. Applications without portfolios will not be considered.


Nice to Have

  • Background in DTC or e-commerce brands
  • Experience with remote collaboration tools (Slack, ClickUp, Frame.io, Notion)
  • Familiarity with performance marketing metrics and what makes ads convert


Tech Requirements

Computer: i7 processor (or equivalent) with 16GB RAM minimum

Internet: 100 Mbps download speed minimum

Schedule

Monday-Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST (1-hour break)

Required: Weekly team meeting on Thursdays at 10:00 AM EST



Benefits & Perks

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire.
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business


Ready to Apply?

If you love creating high-performing video content and have a portfolio that showcases your work, we want to see it. Apply now.

Note: Applications without portfolio samples will not be reviewed.

• Experiência com modelos de clusterização, propensão ou segmentação de clientes.

title: Cloud Systems Engineer/DevOps
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Overview

We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration; you must be capable of building architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.


The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role’s primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

strategy.


Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN , pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter


Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)


Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) BackEnd GO Pleno (Tech Lead + Scrum Master)
description:
Sobre a TOQ


A TOQ é uma startup SaaS do mercado imobiliário que conecta proprietários de imóveis a corretores através de uma plataforma onde o material profissional (fotos e vídeos sem logo) fica disponível para centenas de corretores trabalharem.


Nascemos em Alphaville (SP). Temos crescimento consistente, operação com receita e produto em evolução contínua. O plano é claro: escalar no estado nos próximos 3 anos.


Stack atual: Go, PostgreSQL, arquitetura hexagonal, REST APIs, AWS, NGINX, Linux, Scrum. Integrações com Twilio, Intercom, Meta WhatsApp API, e em breve gateways de pagamento.


Sobre a Vaga.


Você vai ser a referência técnica do produto e o facilitador do processo ágil — lidera tecnicamente o backend da TOQ e, ao mesmo tempo, conduz as cerimônias Scrum.


Não é um cargo de gestão de pessoas tradicional. É um tech lead hands-on : cerca de 70% do tempo escrevendo código, 30% em arquitetura, mentoria, cerimônias e alinhamento com produto.

Buscamos alguém Pleno consolidado — se tiver perfil Sênior, melhor ainda e vale a conversa sobre pacote.


O que você vai fazer.


  • Desenvolver e evoluir nossas APIs em Go, seguindo arquitetura hexagonal
  • Tomar decisões de arquitetura e defender trade-offs com clareza
  • Revisar código do time, definir padrões de qualidade e elevar o nível técnico
  • Conduzir as cerimônias Scrum (daily, planning, review, retro) com o time de produto
  • Gerenciar o backlog técnico e ajudar a priorizar junto com produto
  • Fazer a ponte entre produto e engenharia — traduzir requisitos em soluções técnicas
  • Participar do design de features críticas (pagamentos, notificações, chat in-app, integrações)
  • Mentorar os desenvolvedores do time
  • Garantir observabilidade, performance e segurança da plataforma

O que esperamos de você.


OBRIGATÓRIO

  • 4+ anos de experiência com desenvolvimento backend
  • 2+ anos com Go (Golang) em produção
  • Domínio de arquitetura hexagonal (portas e adaptadores) — saber explicar e aplicar
  • Experiência sólida construindo e mantendo APIs REST
  • Conhecimento de AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, SQS/SNS — pelo menos o básico funcional de cada)
  • Experiência com NGINX (configuração, proxy reverso, load balancing)
  • Confortável em ambiente Linux (operação, debugging, shell)
  • Vivência real com Scrum — ter conduzido cerimônias, gerenciado sprint backlog, lidado com impedimentos
  • Experiência com MySQL/RDS MySql e modelagem relacional
  • Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente sem ser autoritário


DESEJÁVEL

  • Testes automatizados em Go (unitários, integração)
  • Docker, CI/CD
  • Experiência prévia em startup ou produto SaaS
  • Certificação Scrum (CSM, PSM) ou equivalente
  • Perfil Sênior (remuneração ajustada)


O que oferecemos


  • Trabalho com autonomia técnica real — você decide como construir
  • Conceito maduro que vai escalar nacionalmente
  • Time pequeno, decisões rápidas, impacto direto
  • Stack moderna e bem cuidada
  • 100% remoto desde sempre
  • Contratação PJ
  • Plano de evolução real conforme a TOQ cresce


Processo Seletivo


  • Triagem de currículo
  • Conversa inicial (30 min) — trajetória e motivações
  • Teste técnico — desafio prático
  • Entrevista técnica (30 min) — discussão do teste + arquitetura mobile + olhar de UX
  • Fit cultural — conversa sobre produto e visão
  • Proposta


Prazo total estimado: 2 a 3 semana

Pure is a bold, global dating app redefining how people connect. We believe dating should be honest, fun, and free of judgment, a space to explore confidence, chemistry, and self-expression.

We’re building a UGC Creator Community of voices to help tell that story.

  • Receive feedback and coaching to grow your performance

  • You must be based in Brazil and be fluent in Portuguese

  • Familiarity with TikTok trends, Reels formats, and UGC-style videos

title: Data Engineer, EDM III BRL
description:
Job Title: Data Engineer, EDM III BRL- 10 Years

Location : Brazil remote

Project Duration: 6 months



Job description:

Primary Skills

SQL, Python, Pyspark, Airflow, AWS, MLOPs

Secondary Skills

Communication, leadership, project management

Position Overview

The BMP (Business Model and Pricing) Analytics team is seeking an experienced Data Engineer to support business performance management and strategic decision-making through scalable data infrastructure and engineering solutions. The team partners closely with leadership, finance, operations, and business stakeholders to enable reliable, high-quality data access, support advanced analytics, and drive data-informed actions across the organization.

The Data Engineer will play a critical role in designing, building, and maintaining robust data pipelines, data models, and foundational data assets that power analytics, reporting, and emerging AI/ML capabilities. This role requires strong engineering rigor, a deep understanding of data systems, and the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record of building scalable data solutions in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment and is comfortable balancing foundational data platform work with evolving analytics and AI-driven initiatives.


What you will do

You have a strong engineering and problem-solving mindset. You translate business and analytical needs into scalable, reliable data solutions and architectures.

You design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data models that support business performance monitoring, analytics, and reporting, while contributing to the development of the BMP Data Foundation across Hive, Snowflake and data lake environments.


You support the buildout of data products and applications, including contributing to Streamlit-based pipelines and the development of chatbot capabilities to enhance data access and user interaction.

You collaborate closely with analytics, data science, and business teams to ensure data availability, quality, and usability for dashboards, reporting, and advanced analyses.

You enable and support the buildout of advanced analytics, machine learning and AI capabilities, ensuring the necessary data infrastructure, pipelines, and environments are in place to support model development and deployment.

You contribute to the design and evolution of the data and ML ecosystem, helping establish the infrastructure, processes, and foundations required to scale AI/ML initiatives across the organization.


Minimum Qualifications

• Master’s degree in computer science, Data Engineering, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

• 5+ years of experience in data engineering, data platform development, or related roles.

• Strong experience with SQL and at least one programming language (Python or equivalent).

• Familiarity with big data and distributed processing frameworks (e.g., Spark / PySpark).

• Experience building and maintaining data pipelines and working with modern data architectures.

• Experience with orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow) and pipeline automation.

• Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., AWS) and data warehousing solutions (e.g., Snowflake).

• Strong understanding of data modeling, data quality, and data governance principles.

• Experience with version control systems (Git) and collaborative development workflows.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work with ambiguous requirements.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Fluent in English.



Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working with data lake architectures and hybrid data environments.

• Experience supporting machine learning pipelines and infrastructure.

• Exposure to data applications (e.g., Streamlit) and conversational interfaces (chatbots).

• Experience with AI-assisted development tools and practices.

• Experience contributing to documentation and knowledge-sharing platforms (e.g., Confluence).

• Experience working in a matrixed, global organization.

title: Analista Ongoing Pleno - CyberArk
description:
Sobre a vaga


Buscamos um profissional júnior que poderá atuar na implementação, configuração ou suporte de soluções completas de Identity and Access Management (IAM), abrangendo todo o ecossistema de segurança de identidades:


  • IGA (Identity Governance & Administration), PAM (Privileged Access Management),
  • CIAM (Customer Identity & Access Management),
  • MFA (Multi-Factor Authentication), entre outras.


O profissional terá contato com as principais plataformas líderes de mercado, trabalhando com parceiros estratégicos globais como SailPoint, Ping Identity, CyberArk, IBM, HashiCorp, IAMOnes, Styra, iProov, Silverfort, HYPR, Cerby, Radiant Logic, StrongKey, e Customer Futures, participando de projetos de implementação em todo o ciclo de vida das soluções.


Importante:  Para essa oportunidade, buscamos um profissional que já tenha atuado com projetos de implementação de CyberArk.


Descrição
  • Participar de implantações dos sistemas de IAM, abrangendo todo o ciclo (Requisitos, Desenvolvimento/Configurações, Testes, Homologações e Suporte).
  • Customizar integrações entre os sistemas (APIs, Json, XMLs, SWAGGER, Etc).
  • Desenvolver scripts (Java, Phyton, Etc) para customizações das soluções.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica atualizada (blueprints, procedimentos operacionais)
  • Apoiar em atualizações e upgrades das ferramentas
  • Monitorar status e progresso da resolução de chamados.
  • Garantir atendimento dentro do SLA contratado.
  • Escalar incidentes de alto impacto para os níveis apropriados.
  • Manter clientes informados sobre o status e progresso dos atendimentos.
  • Buscar constantemente novas tecnologias e metodologias de melhoria.

  • SOs: Conhecimentos básicos em microinformática tais como Linux e Windows Server, redes, segurança;
  • Java: compreender, desenvolver e ajustar códigos na linguagem Java;
  • Linux: compreender e conhecer comandos básicos para servidores Linux;
  • LDAP: conhecimento de protocolos LDAP;
  • JDBC: conhecimentos em banco de dados SQLServer;

  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Ter conhecimento básico em frameworks (Scrum; Kanban; ITIL; Cobit; NIST);
  • Conhecimento e Habilidades com ferramentas e conceitos de IA.

  • Tratar as pessoas com ética e sinceridade, buscando uma parceria no longo prazo.
  • Manter-se atualizado com novas tecnologias, métodos e inovações.
  • Valorizar o aprendizado.

  • Vaga remota.
  • Salário compatível com o mercado.

  • Seguro de vida Gympass/WellHub
  • Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação (Valor de R$860,00 para distribuir entre os 2 cartões)
  • Vale Transporte Auxílio Creche.
  • Ajuda de custo de 50% mês para aula de inglês com professor via online.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Job Description: Full Stack Developer (2 Openings)

Location: Remote from Barzil & Mexico

Experience Level: Mid–Senior

One role will be .NET-heavy , and the other Angular-heavy , though both are full stack positions.

Role Overview

We are hiring two Full Stack Developers to support the Digital Signage & Clubs team, building and maintaining software that powers airport signage systems and United Club applications used by customers and employees across airport locations.

These roles focus on developing scalable, cloud-based applications that support real-time signage displays, premium services, and club access platforms.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain full stack applications supporting digital signage and club systems
  • Develop front-end experiences using Angular (role-dependent emphasis)
  • Build backend services using .NET Core (latest versions)
  • Integrate applications with NoSQL databases such as DynamoDB and DocumentDB
  • Deploy and support applications in AWS
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, UX, and infrastructure
  • Support ongoing enhancements, performance improvements, and new feature development

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong full stack development experience
  • Angular (front-end focus for one role)
  • .NET Core and modern .NET ecosystem (backend focus for one role)
  • Experience with AWS cloud services
  • Hands-on experience with NoSQL databases , including DynamoDB and/or DocumentDB
  • Experience building scalable, production-grade applications

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting digital signage, real-time display systems, or customer-facing platforms
  • Familiarity with applications used in high-traffic public environments
  • Experience working on systems supporting both customer and employee workflows

title: \"Analista de Infraestrutura Cloud\" 994984
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Infraestrutura / Cloud para atuar em ambientes críticos, de alta disponibilidade, com forte presença em Cloud Computing.

Administração e suporte a ambientes Kubernetes

Gerenciamento e sustentação de Windows Server

Suporte e manutenção de portais rodando em IIS

Atuação em ambientes de Cloud Computing, com forte presença em Google Cloud Platform (GCP) (90% do ambiente)

Integração e operação em ambientes Microsoft Azure e Amazon Web Services (AWS)

Administração de ambientes virtualizados com VMware

Suporte a ambientes críticos e de alta disponibilidade

Disponibilidade de atuar em regime de plantão (24x7), quando necessário


O que você precisa ter:

Experiência sólida com Kubernetes

Conhecimentos consistentes em GCP

Vivência com Azure e AWS

Experiência em administração de Windows Server

Atuação prévia em ambientes críticos e de alta disponibilidade


Onde você vai trabalhar:

Acreditamos na troca de experiências e valorizamos as relações através do Regime Remoto.

title: Operador(a) de máquinas
description:
Sobre nós:

Furukawa Electric LatAm, Furukawa Electric Fiber & Cable e OFS agora são Lightera

Lightera é mais do que um nome, é um compromisso com a criação de conexões mais brilhantes que moldam o futuro.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Job Title: AI Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: PST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Overview


We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, DevOps, and Applied AI , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle.


The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering “golden paths.”


Key Responsibilities

  • Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity.
  • Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics , driving improvements across engineering workflows.
  • Build reusable patterns for:
  • AI-assisted code generation
  • Pull request automation
  • Test generation
  • Debugging workflows
  • Developer self-service enablement
  • Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback.
  • Manage AI usage governance, including:
  • Token budgeting and cost controls
  • Usage monitoring and reporting
  • PII redaction guardrails
  • Audit logging and responsible AI practices
  • Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines , APIs, and AI integrations.
  • Integrate AI tooling into GitLab CI/CD, GitOps workflows, and developer platforms .
  • Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.
  • Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.


Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Developer Experience , or related engineering roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings.
  • Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.
  • Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/SaaS tools , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management.
  • Practical daily usage of tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT , or similar.
  • Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities.
  • Strong AWS experience, ideally including:
  • Bedrock
  • API Gateway
  • Managed AI/Cloud Services
  • Experience with Terraform, Helm, GitOps, and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab preferred).
  • Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


Preferred / Nice to Have

  • Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence .
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • LLM Agents
  • RAG pipelines
  • Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch, etc.)
  • LangChain / LlamaIndex
  • Exposure to AI FinOps , usage reporting, and cost attribution models.
  • Knowledge of AI governance and security , including:
  • OWASP Top 10 for LLMs
  • Prompt injection risks
  • Model supply chain security
  • Responsible AI controls
  • Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

Low Latency | Async Rust | Tokio

On-site | Munich

Our members have driven everything. The novelty is gone. What they're chasing now is the social moments that they can't find anywhere else. We want to build a world of underground luxury that feel like scenes from a film.


Now we're building a creative team to match and we need an AI-native art direct who can sell the feeling of being inside Ark.

  • Design performance creatives that feel like film stills, not ads
  • Generate scroll-stopping visuals that pull our target deeper into the world (and the funnel)
  • Build on-image copy that speaks to a young successful founders
  • Maintain a visual language across motorsport, lifestyle, clothing, and brand storytelling pillars
  • Move fast — produce cinematic visuals at the volume performance marketing demands


Who You Are

  • We don't care about your years of experience. We care about your eye and what you've built.
  • You've built performance ads for premium DTC, lifestyle, or fashion brands before
  • You've mastered Freepik Spaces and Higgsfield
  • You understand the difference between \"looks expensive\" and \"feels exclusive\"
  • Your portfolio looks like an A24 mood board, not a Canva carousel
  • You've created something of your own — a brand, a zine, a film, a photo series, a fit page that proves you don't need a brief to build a world
  • You follow filmmakers, fashion houses, and underground car culture in equal measure
  • Streetwear, automotive, fashion, or film background? You're already shortlisted.
  • You can tell me without thinking why the Gentle Monster \"Hunt\" campaign works, or why a single shot of a wet parking lot at night can carry an entire brand


What We're Building

  • The most-watched private world in luxury automotive. Members don't join for the cars. They join for the access, the people, and the feeling of being on the inside of something most people will never see.
  • This role defines what that world looks like to anyone discovering us for the first time. Your work will be the first impression for people who've never been impressed.


What We're Offering

  • Competitive salary based on your portfolio
  • 10 days PTO per year
  • Path to grow into creative lead / brand director as we scale
  • Fully remote


How to Apply

  • A portfolio showing off your streetwear / midnight club design language
  • A short paragraph on how you'd approach the visual feel of an Ark Exotic ad campaign


If the interview goes well, we hire on the call. Welcome to Ark.

The role also involves configuring Word Templates for regulatory workflows, installing and troubleshooting iLovePDF and other document processing tools for high-volume submissions, and managing ServiceNow Request and Incident tickets to ensure timely resolution of customer escalations. This is a remote opportunity in LATAM, working US ET hours.

title: .NET Developer
description:
Job Title:

Mid-Level .NET Developer (Backend / Distributed Systems)


Overview

We are seeking a mid-level .NET Developer to join a backend-focused engineering team building and enhancing distributed services in AWS. This role is heavily backend and API-driven, with a strong emphasis on asynchronous processing, system-to-system integration, and resilient service design. The engineer will work on both net-new services and enhancements to existing systems, collaborating closely with product owners and other engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities

• Design, build, and enhance backend services using .NET and C#

• Develop RESTful APIs and backend components that operate within distributed systems

• Build and maintain asynchronous processing workflows using messaging patterns

• Upgrade and modernize existing .NET applications (e.g. .NET 8 to .NET 10)

• Implement system-to-system integrations, including external-facing services

• Consume and process messages from event-driven sources, handling retries and failure scenarios

• Participate in unit and integration testing as part of CI/CD pipelines

• Deploy services to Kubernetes environments in AWS

• Collaborate with product owners, engineers, and cross-functional teams in a ticket-driven environment

• Contribute to design discussions with a system-wide, not just code-level, mindset


Technical Requirements

• Strong proficiency with C# and modern .NET development

• Experience building backend services and RESTful APIs

• Solid understanding of distributed systems and asynchronous processing

• Hands-on experience with event-driven architectures (pub/sub, messaging systems)

• Experience working in AWS environments

• Familiarity with Kubernetes-based deployments (e.g. EKS)

• Experience using relational databases (e.g. AWS RDS)

• Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, preferably GitHub Actions

• Experience with unit testing and integration testing in .NET applications


Preferred / Nice to Have

• Experience with AWS messaging services such as SNS and SQS

• Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform

• Experience deploying applications via GitHub Actions

• Exposure to configuration management patterns (e.g. externalized config services)

• Experience working alongside teams using different technology stacks (e.g. Clojure or functional programming environments)

• Familiarity with authentication and service-to-service security (e.g. Okta)

• Comfort using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot


Work Environment & Team Culture

• Backend-heavy role with minimal frontend expectations

• Collaborative, low-micromanagement engineering culture

• Engineers are expected to work independently but ask questions when needed

• Ticket-driven work with varying levels of requirement detail

• Strong emphasis on respectful cross-team collaboration

• Encouragement of thoughtful technical pushback and design discussions

• Regular pairing and open communication via Slack and ad-hoc calls

• Focus on sustainable delivery rather than perfection under time constraints


What Success Looks Like

• Quickly ramping into existing systems and development patterns

• Owning backend services end to end, from design through deployment

• Demonstrating a strong systems mindset beyond individual features

• Building reliable, maintainable services within a distributed architecture

• Collaborating effectively across teams with different technical bac

title: Growth Marketing Analyst
description:
About Downtown Engineers

Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a New York-based MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) engineering firm trusted by architecture offices, developers and national brands. Our work spans from franchise rollouts for brands like McDonald's, Domino's and Dunkin' to hospitality projects with Hilton and Hyatt, healthcare and residential buildings across the United States, with a strong focus on New York City.


We're a remote-first team of 20+ people across different countries, with 300+ projects delivered across 16+ sectors. Our culture is grounded in trust, transparency and autonomy, and that's how we communicate too.


About the Opportunity

Downtown is growing and we need someone to build and run the marketing infrastructure that supports it. As a Growth Marketing Analyst, you'll work across three fronts — recurrent clients, referrals and new client acquisition —designing strategies, setting up campaigns, configuring tools and measuring what converts. Your primary focus is on capture and expansion (website, CRM, events, paid media, referral systems, client retention), while supporting the demand layer fed by content and authority.


This role works in close partnership with leadership and sales. You'll think about where to invest and how to grow, then make it happen, connecting marketing efforts to pipeline, testing what works, cutting what doesn't and scaling what proves itself.


Compensation & Structure

  • Full-time contractor (remote)
  • Fixed monthly compensation
  • Please include your compensation expectation in BRL (R$) in your application


What you’ll do


1.Channel oversight & growth

  • Set and track channel-level goals aligned with Downtown's growth priorities: recurrent clients, referrals and new client acquisition
  • Own the day-to-day management and growth of marketing channels — email, paid media, outbound, events and future channels
  • Plan, execute and optimize paid campaigns, including budget management and audience targeting
  • Support the design and execution of outbound and ABM initiatives
  • Optimize website performance as a conversion engine — landing pages, CTAs, user flow and lead capture
  • Monitor organic search performance and identify SEO opportunities to support inbound growth
  • Propose and test new campaigns, formats and acquisition strategies to improve performance


2.CRM & automation

  • Own the marketing layer of the CRM (Zoho) in partnership with sales: segmentation, audience lists, campaign tagging and marketing lifecycle tracking
  • Handle the technical setup and configuration of marketing platforms and integrations
  • Build and manage email marketing flows — nurture sequences, newsletters, re-engagement campaigns and event-driven communications


3.Reporting & optimization

  • Track and report on channel performance, campaign results and growth metrics
  • Run experiments, analyze data and translate findings into actionable improvements
  • Monitor referral and client retention metrics, supporting sales with data-driven insights


Requirements


Must-haves

  • Fluent English (written and spoken)
  • Analytical mindset with comfort in data, dashboards and performance reporting
  • Hands-on execution mindset with high autonomy, curiosity and ownership
  • Experience with B2B marketing and demand generation
  • Working knowledge of CRM platforms (Zoho, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar)
  • Experience building and managing email marketing flows and automation
  • Hands-on experience with paid media (LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads or similar platforms)


Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with Account-Based Marketing (ABM)
  • Experience with marketing automation tools beyond email (e.g., workflow builders, lead scoring)
  • Familiarity with the architecture, engineering or construction industry


Selection Process

  • Apply to the opportunity, submitting the form with your CV and English experience
  • Screening: English and communication assessment (video)
  • Technical challenge
  • Interviews with leadership
  • Offer


Why join Downtown?

  • Role with direct business impact
  • Work with top architects and U.S. brands
  • Fast-moving, low-bureaucracy culture with real autonomy
  • High growth opportunity as the company scales

title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
description:
Líder mundial em Recursos Humanos, a Adecco está presente em 60 países, por meio de uma rede de 5.500 delegações que diariamente proporcionam emprego a 700.000 pessoas e prestam serviços a mais de 100.000 empresas. Faz parte da Fortune Global 500 e está cotada na bolsa de Zurique. A Adecco possui uma estrutura global orientada para a oferta de soluções integradas em Recursos Humanos, com o compromisso de desenvolver continuamente serviços eficazes e competitivos para seus clientes.


Assessoramos importante empresa internacional de BPO.


Sobre a Posição


Buscamos um(a) Business Development Representative (BDR) altamente orientado(a) a resultados para impulsionar a geração de novas oportunidades de negócios e a aquisição de novos clientes (new logos ) na Europa e em outros mercados internacionais.

Esta função é estratégica para a expansão das operações globais de BPO, sendo responsável por construir pipeline do zero, abrir novos mercados e posicionar as soluções da empresa em contas estratégicas .

Procuramos um(a) profissional com mentalidade hunter , forte disciplina comercial e ambição de crescimento, capaz de atuar com alto desempenho em ambientes internacionais competitivos .

Principais Responsabilidades


Geração de Pipeline (Outbound)

  • Identificar e prospectar novos clientes potenciais em mercados europeus.
  • Planejar e executar estratégias de prospecção multicanal (cold calls, e-mails, LinkedIn).
  • Construir e manter um pipeline consistente de oportunidades qualificadas.


Desenvolvimento de Negócios (New Logos)

  • Abrir novas contas e gerar interesse em prospects que ainda não conhecem a empresa.
  • Posicionar a proposta de valor de BPO em segmentos-chave (atendimento ao cliente, vendas, back office, automação).
  • Agendar e conduzir reuniões estratégicas com tomadores de decisão.


Qualificação e Handoff para Vendas

  • Realizar discovery inicial para entender as necessidades do cliente.
  • Qualificar oportunidades e garantir um handoff eficaz para o time de vendas (Account Executives).
  • Manter informações atualizadas e precisas no CRM.


Gestão de Performance e Métricas

Cumprir e superar KPIs exigentes, incluindo:

  • Pipeline gerado
  • Oportunidades criadas
  • Novos logos impactados
  • Atividades comerciais (ligações, e-mails, reuniões)
  • Metas de receita


Colaboração Interna

  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de marketing, pré‑vendas e soluções.
  • Compartilhar insights de mercado para aprimorar campanhas e posicionamento.
  • Apoiar estratégias de crescimento regional.


Requisitos

  • Experiência como BDR, SDR outbound ou em desenvolvimento de negócios B2B/B2C.
  • Experiência comprovada na construção de pipeline e abertura de mercados do zero.
  • Vivência em mercados internacionais, preferencialmente Europa.
  • Inglês nível C2; espanhol será considerado um diferencial.
  • Experiência com CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot ou similares).
  • Forte orientação a resultados e atuação com metas desafiadoras.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, persuasão e negociação inicial.
  • Experiência em BPO, outsourcing ou serviços de tecnologia.
  • Conhecimento em vendas consultivas e ciclos de venda complexos.
  • Experiência em ambientes globais e multiculturais.

title: Estagiário de marketing
description:
Estagiário(a) de Marketing de Campo — Captação de Leads

Estágio em Marketing | Publicidade e Propaganda | Comunicação | Prospecção | Vendas


Sobre a vaga

Buscamos estagiário(a) para atuar em campo com captação de leads presencial. A abordagem é descontraída — você vai interagir com pessoas em espaços públicos, usando um roteiro criativo, coletar alguns dados de contato e repassar ao time interno.


O que você vai fazer

- Abordar pessoas em ruas, praças e locais públicos de forma leve e descontraída, seguindo o roteiro da empresa.

- Conduzir conversas curtas, despertar curiosidade e coletar dados de contato.

- Repassar os leads captados ao time interno para continuidade do atendimento.

- Participar de reuniões diárias de alinhamento com a liderança.

- Manter os registros organizados e atualizados.


Detalhes da vaga

- Modalidade: Atuação em campo

- Jornada: Segunda a Sexta, das 14h às 20h (30h semanais)

- Nível: Estágio

- Área: Marketing / Comercial / Comunicação


Remuneração e Benefícios

Bolsa-estágio: R$ 1.067,90 + benefícios

- Auxílio-alimentação de R$ 364,06

- Auxílio-saúde de R$ 94,65

- Auxílio transporte conforme necessidade

- Vale-alemão: curso de alemão + instrutor de idioma por IA

- Clude Saúde: consultas médicas, nutricionista e desconto em farmácias

- C4Life: terapia online, coaching, consultorias jurídicas e mais

- Totalpass: 20 mil academias/estúdios, terapia, nutrição

- Grupo de motivação fitness

- Bradesco Odonto: opção por contribuição, aberto a dependentes, com urgência, 2 limpezas/ano + clube de vantagens

- Kit de boas-vindas

- #EUVISTOACAMISA: novas camisetas a cada ano de empresa

- Day-off no aniversário + presente surpresa

- Convênio com o SESC: clubes, hospedagem, cursos, eventos e serviços para a família

- Bônus anual de +1 bolsa estágio se a empresa atingir a meta anual

- Bônus Indique e Ganhe


Perfil que buscamos

Não exigimos experiência prévia. Buscamos alguém com:

- Desenvoltura para conversar com pessoas desconhecidas

- Carisma, energia e boa comunicação verbal

- Responsabilidade com horários e compromissos

title: Brand & Content Analyst
description:
About Downtown Engineers

Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a New York-based MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) engineering firm trusted by architecture offices, developers and national brands.


Our work spans from franchise rollouts for brands like McDonald's, Domino's and Dunkin' to hospitality projects with Hilton and Hyatt, healthcare and residential buildings across the United States, with a strong focus on New York City.

We're a remote-first team of 20+ people across different countries, with 300+ projects delivered across 16+ sectors. Our culture is grounded in trust, transparency and autonomy and that's how we communicate too.



About the Opportunity

We're looking for a hands-on Brand & Content Analyst to help us build and sustain our authority in the market. This role sits at the intersection of brand, education and demand generation, creating content that builds trust with architects and developers before the first conversation ever happens.


The ideal candidate is content-obsessed with a strong brand lens, someone who takes one idea and immediately sees multiple formats, narratives and distribution paths. Beyond producing content, you'll ensure that everything Downtown puts out communicates the brand clearly and consistently.

You'll work closely with leadership, transforming technical knowledge into high-quality content, while reviewing and strengthening how the brand shows up across every touchpoint.



Compensation & Structure

  • Full-time contractor (remote)
  • Fixed monthly compensation
  • Please include your compensation expectation in BRL (R$) in your application


What you’ll do


1.Content & channels

  • Produce and distribute content across priority channels (LinkedIn, email, blog and future channels)
  • Write copy, adapt templates, collaborate on visuals and test new formats
  • Coordinate editorial calendar, approvals and publishing


2.Brand consistency & messaging

  • Review and propose copy for the website, social media pages, presentations, events, campaigns and sales materials, ensuring brand clarity and tone across all touchpoints
  • Research best practices and propose improvements to how Downtown communicates across channels
  • Be the first line of quality control on how the brand shows up externally


3.Demand generation & sales enablement

  • Create rich content (case studies, guides, studies, infographics) to educate architects and drive inbound demand
  • Support sales with enablement materials and educational assets
  • Help build Downtown's educational and thought leadership initiatives


4.Optimization & performance

  • Ensure content is evergreen, performance-driven and SEO-friendly
  • Track results, test improvements and iterate


Requirements


Must-haves

  • Fluent English (written and spoken)
  • Strong writing and content creation skills
  • Hands-on execution mindset with high autonomy, curiosity and ownership
  • Ability to think in formats, distribution and repurposing and not just write and post
  • Comfortable working with multiple channels and priorities without losing consistency
  • Experience with content marketing or B2B communication
  • Strong sense of brand consistency: you notice when messaging, tone or visuals feel off, you act on it. And you also proactively propose improvements


Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with SEO, content optimization or marketing automation tools
  • Experience in technical, engineering or architecture-related industries


Selection Process

  • Apply to the opportunity, submitting the form with your CV and English experience
  • Screening: English and communication assessment (video)
  • Technical challenge

  • Offer


Why join Downtown?

  • Role with direct business impact
  • Work with top architects and U.S. brands
  • Fast-moving, low-bureaucracy culture with real autonomy
  • High growth opportunity as the company scales

title: Gerente de Soluções Trilingue
description:
Líder mundial em Recursos Humanos, a Adecco está presente em 60 países, por meio de uma rede de 5.500 delegações que diariamente proporcionam emprego a 700.000 pessoas e prestam serviços a mais de 100.000 empresas. Principais Responsabilidades


Estratégia de Soluções e Go-to-Market

  • Identificar oportunidades para posicionar a automação como motor de transformação operacional e eficiência empresarial .
  • Criar ferramentas de marketing e vendas que apoiem o posicionamento das soluções.


Liderança de Pré‑Vendas

  • Liderar o desenho e a arquitetura das soluções durante o ciclo de pré‑vendas .
  • Traduzir requisitos dos clientes em soluções escaláveis de automação, IA e transformação digital .

  • Liderar a elaboração de respostas para RFPs, RFIs e processos de licitação .
  • Definir estratégias de pricing e modelos comerciais alinhados ao valor gerado para o cliente.
  • Coordenar equipes internas multidisciplinares durante a preparação das propostas .


Parcerias e Ecossistema

  • Atuar como ponto de conexão entre clientes, equipes internas e parceiros tecnológicos .
  • Identificar oportunidades para fortalecer soluções por meio de alianças estratégicas e tecnologias parceiras .


Colaboração e Gestão de Relacionamentos

  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com equipes de vendas, delivery, produto e marketing .
  • Construir e manter relacionamentos estratégicos de longo prazo com clientes e parceiros.
  • Apoiar o alinhamento interno sobre mensagens, posicionamento e capacidades das soluções .


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada em Pré‑Vendas, Consultoria de Soluções ou Solution Management .
  • Histórico de sucesso na venda de soluções de RPA, Inteligência Artificial ou Automação de Processos .
  • Experiência sólida no desenho de estratégias de automação e iniciativas de transformação digital .
  • Profundo conhecimento do ciclo de vendas enterprise e gestão de oportunidades complexas .
  • Experiência na condução de RFPs, RFIs e licitações internacionais .
  • Excelentes habilidades de apresentação comercial e storytelling executivo .

title: Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior
description:
Sobre a Empresa:

O Clínica Experts é uma plataforma completa de gestão para clínicas de saúde, estética e bem-estar, utilizada diariamente por mais de 7.500 clínicas e 16.000 usuários. Entregamos soluções que integram agenda, prontuário, financeiro, estoque, comunicação omnichannel e inteligência artificial, garantindo eficiência e escala para operações de todos os portes.


Sobre a Oportunidade:

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior para atuar diretamente no squad de IA do Clínica Experts, responsável por projetar, evoluir e escalar soluções baseadas em LLMs, agentes inteligentes e sistemas multi-agentes.

Você trabalhará em desafios reais de produção, com alto volume de dados e usuários, construindo soluções que vão desde engenharia de prompts até arquiteturas complexas de agentes com supervisão, memória, ferramentas e observabilidade.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Arquitetar e desenvolver soluções de IA baseadas em LLMs para ambientes de produção em larga escala;
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de agentes e multi-agentes, incluindo estruturas de supervisor, delegação de tarefas, memória e ferramentas;
  • Desenvolver fluxos complexos utilizando LangChain e LangGraph, aplicando boas práticas de composição, controle e observabilidade;
  • Integrar diferentes provedores de modelos (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, entre outros), escolhendo o melhor modelo para cada caso de uso;
  • Atuar na definição de estratégias de engenharia de prompt, avaliação de respostas, mitigação de alucinações e controle de qualidade;
  • Construir e evoluir pipelines de IA integrados a sistemas backend (APIs, filas, microsserviços);
  • Participar ativamente da inovação do produto através de POCs, MVPs e experimentos controlados;
  • Definir padrões técnicos, boas práticas e ajudar a elevar o nível do time, atuando como referência técnica em IA.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Fundamentos sólidos de IA aplicada e LLMs;
  • Engenharia de prompt (few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output, function calling);
  • LangChain e seus principais conceitos (chains, tools, memory, retrievers);
  • LangGraph para orquestração de fluxos e agentes complexos;
  • Arquiteturas de agentes autônomos e multi-agentes, incluindo supervisor/worker;
  • Integração com APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude);
  • Design de APIs e serviços backend para consumo de IA;
  • Observabilidade aplicada a IA (logs, métricas, tracing, avaliação de respostas);
  • Conceitos de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), embeddings e vetorização;
  • Mensageria, processamento assíncrono e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Experiência prática colocando soluções de IA em produção;
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software, sendo parte disso com sistemas complexos ou distribuídos.


Você vai se divertir mais se:

  • Tiver paixão por inteligência artificial e acompanhar a evolução rápida do ecossistema de LLMs;
  • Gostar de resolver problemas ambíguos e ainda não totalmente definidos;
  • Curte equilibrar experimentação rápida com engenharia robusta para produção;
  • Tiver senso de dono e se preocupar com impacto real no usuário final.


Será um diferencial se você:

  • Tiver experiência com Node.js, Python ou TypeScript em sistemas de IA;
  • Já tiver trabalhado com RAG em produção, FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate ou similares;
  • Conhecer técnicas de avaliação automática de LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge, scoring, CSAT);
  • Possuir experiência com AWS (EC2, S3, filas, escalabilidade);
  • Ter participado da construção de produtos de IA para usuários finais;
  • Já ter atuado como referência técnica ou líder técnico.


Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição no cartão Flash;

title: Full Stack Engineer (React.js/Node.js)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.js and Node.js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn.


The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software!


Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.


Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status.


Responsibilities


  • Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs
  • Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.js and Node.js
  • Develop and implement highly responsive UI components
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles implementing them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers helping them find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience


  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks
  • Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models

  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A focus on customer value delivery
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success
  • A collaborative approach, a can do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when youve made a mistake


Desired Experience


  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field


Additional Information


  • Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable.
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team.

  • Evidence-Based Decisions : Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners.

  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger.
  • The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient


We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Please send your resume in English!


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities


  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to team coordination and iterative delivery processes, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.


Competencies / Requirements


  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Event Management Engineer (Spyglass)
description:
Observability & Event Management Engineer (Spyglass)

Remote

Contract


Key Responsibilities

  • Spyglass Event Configuration Management Primary Focus
  • Design and implement Event Correlation Rules within Spyglass to aggregate disparate logs and metrics into meaningful business events
  • Configure Event Policies Suppression Rules and Deduplication logic to reduce alert fatigue for L1L2 support teams
  • Build and maintain Spyglass Dashboards that provide real-time visibility into the health of the FMCG application landscape Experience Engineering Mobile and Emerging Tech
  • Integrate Spyglass with diverse data sources Azure Monitor GCP Cloud Logging AWS CloudWatch and ELK Falcon Log Scale
  • Manage the lifecycle of an event from ingestion and normalization to correlation alerting and archival
  • Proactive Monitoring SRE Integration
  • Develop Threshold based and Anomaly detection alerts to identify performance degradation before it impacts the consumer experience
  • Implement Service Level Objective SLO monitoring within Spyglass to track the reliability of critical business paths eg Order-to-Cash Checkout flows
  • Automate the creation of incidents in ITSM tools eg ServiceNow based on Spyglass event triggers
  • Build Situation Rooms or high level executive views within Spyglass for major promotional events or seasonal peaks
  • Hyper scaler Platform Connectivity
  • Ensure seamless event ingestion from Hyperscaler hosted microservices AKSGKE and serverless functions
  • Support the monitoring of Integration Platforms Boomi APIM by capturing and correlating middleware execution events
  • Collaborate with the Cloud Infrastructure team to monitor network latency and connectivity events across the global Azure GCP backbone
  • Senior Developer Specifics
  • Lead the architectural design of the Global Event Management Strategy
  • Define enterprise standards for event metadata severity levels and correlation patterns
  • Mentor junior developers in event driven observability and AIOps principles
  • Conduct Post Mortem analysis of major incidents to refine Spyglass correlation rules and prevent recurrence


Primary Skills Must-Have

  • Spyglass Event Management Expert level proficiency in Spyglass configuration rule writing and dashboarding
  • Event Correlation Deep understanding of event patterns deduplication and suppression logic
  • Observability Integration Hands-on experience connecting Spyglass to Azure Monitor GCP Stackdriver or ELK
  • ITSM Integration Proven experience integrating event platforms with ServiceNow or similar tools
  • Data Normalization Ability to parse and normalize logs events from heterogeneous sources JSON XML Syslog


Secondary Skills Good-to-Have

  • AIOps Familiarity with machine learning based noise reduction and predictive alerting
  • Scripting Proficiency in Python or JavaScript for custom event processing or API integrations
  • Cloud Native Experience monitoring Kubernetes AKSGKE environments
  • FMCG Domain Understanding of critical business hours and high traffic windows for retail sales applications.
