title: Full Stack Engineer (React.js/Node.js)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.js and Node.js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn.


The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software!


Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.


Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status.


Responsibilities


  • Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs
  • Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.js and Node.js
  • Develop and implement highly responsive UI components
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles implementing them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers helping them find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience


  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks
  • Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models
  • Experience working in an (preferred), GCP, , or other cloud environments
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A focus on customer value delivery
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success
  • A collaborative approach, a can do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when youve made a mistake


Desired Experience


  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field


Additional Information


  • Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values


  • The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable.
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team.
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. Theres no excuse for being a jerk.
  • Evidence-Based Decisions : Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners.
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do.
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger.
  • The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient


We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Please send your resume in English!


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities


  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to team coordination and iterative delivery processes, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.


Competencies / Requirements


  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
description:
Líder mundial em Recursos Humanos, a Adecco está presente em 60 países, por meio de uma rede de 5.500 delegações que diariamente proporcionam emprego a 700.000 pessoas e prestam serviços a mais de 100.000 empresas. Faz parte da Fortune Global 500 e está cotada na bolsa de Zurique. A Adecco possui uma estrutura global orientada para a oferta de soluções integradas em Recursos Humanos, com o compromisso de desenvolver continuamente serviços eficazes e competitivos para seus clientes.


Assessoramos importante empresa internacional de BPO.


Sobre a Posição


Buscamos um(a) Business Development Representative (BDR) altamente orientado(a) a resultados para impulsionar a geração de novas oportunidades de negócios e a aquisição de novos clientes (new logos ) na Europa e em outros mercados internacionais.

Esta função é estratégica para a expansão das operações globais de BPO, sendo responsável por construir pipeline do zero, abrir novos mercados e posicionar as soluções da empresa em contas estratégicas .

Procuramos um(a) profissional com mentalidade hunter , forte disciplina comercial e ambição de crescimento, capaz de atuar com alto desempenho em ambientes internacionais competitivos .

Principais Responsabilidades


Geração de Pipeline (Outbound)

  • Identificar e prospectar novos clientes potenciais em mercados europeus.
  • Planejar e executar estratégias de prospecção multicanal (cold calls, e-mails, LinkedIn).
  • Construir e manter um pipeline consistente de oportunidades qualificadas.


Desenvolvimento de Negócios (New Logos)

  • Abrir novas contas e gerar interesse em prospects que ainda não conhecem a empresa.
  • Posicionar a proposta de valor de BPO em segmentos-chave (atendimento ao cliente, vendas, back office, automação).
  • Agendar e conduzir reuniões estratégicas com tomadores de decisão.


Qualificação e Handoff para Vendas

  • Realizar discovery inicial para entender as necessidades do cliente.
  • Qualificar oportunidades e garantir um handoff eficaz para o time de vendas (Account Executives).
  • Manter informações atualizadas e precisas no CRM.


Gestão de Performance e Métricas

Cumprir e superar KPIs exigentes, incluindo:

  • Pipeline gerado
  • Oportunidades criadas
  • Novos logos impactados
  • Atividades comerciais (ligações, e-mails, reuniões)
  • Metas de receita


Colaboração Interna

  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de marketing, pré‑vendas e soluções.
  • Compartilhar insights de mercado para aprimorar campanhas e posicionamento.
  • Apoiar estratégias de crescimento regional.


Requisitos

  • Experiência como BDR, SDR outbound ou em desenvolvimento de negócios B2B/B2C.
  • Experiência comprovada na construção de pipeline e abertura de mercados do zero.
  • Vivência em mercados internacionais, preferencialmente Europa.
  • Inglês nível C2; espanhol será considerado um diferencial.
  • Experiência com CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot ou similares).
  • Forte orientação a resultados e atuação com metas desafiadoras.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, persuasão e negociação inicial.
  • Experiência em BPO, outsourcing ou serviços de tecnologia.
  • Conhecimento em vendas consultivas e ciclos de venda complexos.
  • Experiência em ambientes globais e multiculturais.

title: Brand & Content Analyst
description:
About Downtown Engineers

Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a New York-based MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) engineering firm trusted by architecture offices, developers and national brands.


Our work spans from franchise rollouts for brands like McDonald's, Domino's and Dunkin' to hospitality projects with Hilton and Hyatt, healthcare and residential buildings across the United States, with a strong focus on New York City.

We're a remote-first team of 20+ people across different countries, with 300+ projects delivered across 16+ sectors. Our culture is grounded in trust, transparency and autonomy and that's how we communicate too.



About the Opportunity

We're looking for a hands-on Brand & Content Analyst to help us build and sustain our authority in the market. This role sits at the intersection of brand, education and demand generation, creating content that builds trust with architects and developers before the first conversation ever happens.


The ideal candidate is content-obsessed with a strong brand lens, someone who takes one idea and immediately sees multiple formats, narratives and distribution paths. Beyond producing content, you'll ensure that everything Downtown puts out communicates the brand clearly and consistently.

You'll work closely with leadership, transforming technical knowledge into high-quality content, while reviewing and strengthening how the brand shows up across every touchpoint.



Compensation & Structure

  • Full-time contractor (remote)
  • Fixed monthly compensation
  • Please include your compensation expectation in BRL (R$) in your application


What you’ll do


1.Content & channels

  • Produce and distribute content across priority channels (LinkedIn, email, blog and future channels)
  • Write copy, adapt templates, collaborate on visuals and test new formats
  • Coordinate editorial calendar, approvals and publishing


2.Brand consistency & messaging

  • Review and propose copy for the website, social media pages, presentations, events, campaigns and sales materials, ensuring brand clarity and tone across all touchpoints
  • Research best practices and propose improvements to how Downtown communicates across channels
  • Be the first line of quality control on how the brand shows up externally


3.Demand generation & sales enablement

  • Create rich content (case studies, guides, studies, infographics) to educate architects and drive inbound demand
  • Support sales with enablement materials and educational assets
  • Help build Downtown's educational and thought leadership initiatives


4.Optimization & performance

  • Ensure content is evergreen, performance-driven and SEO-friendly
  • Track results, test improvements and iterate


Requirements


Must-haves

  • Fluent English (written and spoken)
  • Strong writing and content creation skills
  • Hands-on execution mindset with high autonomy, curiosity and ownership
  • Ability to think in formats, distribution and repurposing and not just write and post
  • Comfortable working with multiple channels and priorities without losing consistency
  • Experience with content marketing or B2B communication
  • Strong sense of brand consistency: you notice when messaging, tone or visuals feel off, you act on it. And you also proactively propose improvements


Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with SEO, content optimization or marketing automation tools
  • Experience in technical, engineering or architecture-related industries


Selection Process

  • Apply to the opportunity, submitting the form with your CV and English experience
  • Screening: English and communication assessment (video)
  • Technical challenge
  • Interviews with leadership
  • Offer


Why join Downtown?

  • Role with direct business impact
  • Work with top architects and U.S. brands
  • Fast-moving, low-bureaucracy culture with real autonomy
  • High growth opportunity as the company scales

title: Estagiário de marketing
description:
Estagiário(a) de Marketing de Campo — Captação de Leads

Estágio em Marketing | Publicidade e Propaganda | Comunicação | Prospecção | Vendas


Sobre a vaga

Buscamos estagiário(a) para atuar em campo com captação de leads presencial. A abordagem é descontraída — você vai interagir com pessoas em espaços públicos, usando um roteiro criativo, coletar alguns dados de contato e repassar ao time interno.

- Repassar os leads captados ao time interno para continuidade do atendimento.

- Participar de reuniões diárias de alinhamento com a liderança.

- Manter os registros organizados e atualizados.


Detalhes da vaga

- Auxílio-saúde de R$ 94,65

- Vale-alemão: curso de alemão + instrutor de idioma por IA

- C4Life: terapia online, coaching, consultorias jurídicas e mais

- Totalpass: 20 mil academias/estúdios, terapia, nutrição

- Grupo de motivação fitness

- Bradesco Odonto: opção por contribuição, aberto a dependentes, com urgência, 2 limpezas/ano + clube de vantagens

- Day-off no aniversário + presente surpresa

- Bônus anual de +1 bolsa estágio se a empresa atingir a meta anual

- Bônus Indique e Ganhe


Perfil que buscamos

Não exigimos experiência prévia. Buscamos alguém com:

- Desenvoltura para conversar com pessoas desconhecidas

- Carisma, energia e boa comunicação verbal

- Responsabilidade com horários e compromissos

- Vontade de aprender sobre captação de leads, prospecção e comunicação persuasiva na prática

Sobre a empresa

A Sprache&Wissen (S&W) é uma edtech brasileira fundada por dois irmãos mineiros: um administrador formado pelo CEFET-MG e uma professora doutora pela UFMG. O grupo educacional administra as marcas Clube de Alemão, Punkify e Vale-inglês. A S&W é a maior escola online de alemão da América Latina. description:

We are a growth financing marketplace for small business owners, with a mission to increase access to entrepreneurship and empower women- and diverse-owned businesses.

By connecting entrepreneurs to growth capital and providing world-class financial management services, we help them take control of their finances, maintain clean, real-time financials, and achieve sustainable economic success.


The Role

We are looking for a highly driven Growth Marketing Manager to own and execute our marketing strategy across digital channels, with a strong focus on content, social media, and AI-powered growth initiatives.

  • Own and execute the company’s social media strategy across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms
  • Plan, create, and publish high-performing short-form and long-form content aligned with brand and growth goals
  • Analyze performance metrics and optimize campaigns based on data-driven insights
  • Manage and scale organic and paid acquisition channels , including social ads and content distribution
  • Leverage AI tools to generate content, optimize workflows, and improve campaign performance
  • Experiment with new growth tactics, content formats, and distribution strategies to drive engagement and lead generation
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, CX, Product) to align messaging and campaigns
  • Develop and maintain a consistent brand voice and positioning across all channels
  • Identify trends and opportunities within the market to keep the brand relevant and competitive
  • Support funnel optimization from awareness to conversion, improving overall marketing ROI
  • Track and report on KPIs, providing actionable insights to leadership
  • Continuously test, learn, and iterate on campaigns to improve performance


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in growth marketing, digital marketing, or social media marketing
  • Strong experience managing and growing Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn accounts
  • Proven ability to create engaging, high-performing content , especially short-form video
  • Deep familiarity with AI tools (ChatGPT, Midjourney, automation tools, etc.) and how to apply them to marketing workflows
  • Analytical mindset with experience using data to drive decisions and optimize campaigns
  • Experience with paid media (Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads) is a strong plus
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, tech-driven environment with rapid iteration
  • Strong communication skills and ability to translate ideas into clear, compelling messaging
  • Creative, proactive, and highly execution-oriented
  • Experience with marketing tools (analytics platforms, CRMs, scheduling tools, etc.)
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize effectively
  • Excited about leveraging technology and AI to scale marketing efforts


Details

  • Full-time position (Remote – Colombia, Brasil, Guatemala)

title: Tech - Delivery Manager
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


  • O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho
  • Supervisionar o ciclo de entrega dos projetos Nearshore, garantindo padronização, documentação e aderência às práticas de governança da Dexian.
  • Realizar avaliações técnicas dos projetos (arquitetura, qualidade de código, automação, maturidade DevOps) e propor ações de melhoria com base em evidências.
  • Definir e acompanhar KPIs operacionais — velocity, throughput, defect density, taxa de conclusão de sprints, lead time.
  • Participar ativamente de reuniões com clientes US, conduzindo discussões técnicas e de performance com postura executiva.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os Delivery Managers e o SDM existentes, identificando bloqueios, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria nos times.
  • Monitorar indicadores financeiros dos projetos (GP, utilização, aderência ao SOW) em parceria com Finanças/Ops.
  • Acompanhar satisfação e engajamento dos consultores alocados, identificando sinais de risco de attrition.
  • Apoiar o recrutamento na validação de fit técnico e senioridade de novos recursos.


O que você precisa ter

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas. Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento, QA automation ou DevOps, com pelo menos 2 anos em liderança técnica ou de delivery.
  • Profundidade técnica em pelo menos uma área (Cloud/APIs, automação de testes ou DevOps/observabilidade) e capacidade de avaliar criticamente as demais.
  • Experiência com métricas operacionais (KPIs, SLAs, produtividade).
  • Inglês avançado com postura executiva para reuniões com clientes.
  • Experiência com múltiplos projetos simultâneos e metodologias ágeis.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Role: AI Solutions Engineer (GenAI & Cloud Transformation)

Starting Date: Immediately

Contract: long term

Work Place: São Paulo/SP (100% remote)

Work Time: 9h00 to 18h00

Language: Advanced english is mandatory and Spanish is desirable


Position Overview


We are seeking a highly strategic and hands-on AI Solutions Engineer with strong experience in delivering end-to-end AI and Generative AI (GenAI) initiatives. This professional will play a critical role in bridging business challenges with technical execution, driving high-impact innovation aligned with enterprise goals.


The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong business acumen, capable of operating in ambiguous environments, influencing executive stakeholders, and leading AI-driven transformation initiatives—particularly within the Google Cloud ecosystem.


Key Responsibilities


• Lead AI/GenAI projects from ideation through prototyping and delivery, ensuring alignment with business objectives

• Translate complex and ambiguous business problems into structured, high-impact technical roadmaps for executive stakeholders (C-level)

• Act as a strategic advisor, challenging assumptions and prioritizing initiatives with the highest business return

• Design and implement scalable AI solutions leveraging modern cloud architectures and services

• Operate effectively in “Day Zero” environments, establishing direction, frameworks, and delivery models from scratch

• Drive digital transformation initiatives by building sustainable, scalable, and high-adoption solutions

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business, engineering, data, and leadership stakeholders


Required Qualifications


• Proven experience delivering AI and/or Generative AI solutions in enterprise environments

• Strong ability to bridge business and technology, with experience engaging senior stakeholders

• Hands-on experience designing AI architectures and deploying solutions in cloud environments

• Solid understanding of modern AI/ML concepts, including LLMs, RAG architectures, and intelligent agents

• Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Google Cloud

• Ability to operate autonomously in high-ambiguity, fast-paced environments


Preferred Qualifications


• Experience working in consulting or transformation-driven roles

• Knowledge of enterprise-scale digital transformation strategies

• Familiarity with data platforms, MLOps, and AI governance

• Spanish proficiency (desirable)


Key Competencies


• Strategic “challenger” mindset with strong outcome orientation

• Analytical thinking and structured problem-solving

• Strong communication and executive presence

• Adaptability and resilience in undefined environments

• High ownership and accountability


Additional Notes


This is a strategic role focused on delivering measurable business impact through AI innovation. The professional is expected to influence decision-making, shape transformation agendas, and build long-term value through scalable and sustainable solutions.


Further information will be given along the technical interview.

title: AI Art Director (Streetwear/Exotic Cars)
description:
So… what the hell is Ark Exotic?

Ark Exotic is where founders and creatives who've already made it come to gather and access our fleet.


Our members have driven everything. The novelty is gone. What they're chasing now is the social moments that they can't find anywhere else. We want to build a world of underground luxury that feel like scenes from a film.


Now we're building a creative team to match and we need an AI-native art direct who can sell the feeling of being inside Ark.


What You'll Do

  • Lead a team of designers to create visuals that stop scrolls
  • Design performance creatives that feel like film stills, not ads
  • Generate scroll-stopping visuals that pull our target deeper into the world (and the funnel)
  • Build on-image copy that speaks to a young successful founders
  • Maintain a visual language across motorsport, lifestyle, clothing, and brand storytelling pillars
  • Move fast — produce cinematic visuals at the volume performance marketing demands


Who You Are

  • We don't care about your years of experience. We care about your eye and what you've built.
  • You've built performance ads for premium DTC, lifestyle, or fashion brands before
  • You've mastered Freepik Spaces and Higgsfield
  • You understand the difference between \"looks expensive\" and \"feels exclusive\"
  • Your portfolio looks like an A24 mood board, not a Canva carousel
  • You've created something of your own — a brand, a zine, a film, a photo series, a fit page that proves you don't need a brief to build a world
  • You follow filmmakers, fashion houses, and underground car culture in equal measure
  • Streetwear, automotive, fashion, or film background? You're already shortlisted.
  • You can tell me without thinking why the Gentle Monster \"Hunt\" campaign works, or why a single shot of a wet parking lot at night can carry an entire brand


What We're Building

  • The most-watched private world in luxury automotive. Members don't join for the cars. They join for the access, the people, and the feeling of being on the inside of something most people will never see.
  • This role defines what that world looks like to anyone discovering us for the first time. Your work will be the first impression for people who've never been impressed.


What We're Offering

  • Competitive salary based on your portfolio
  • 10 days PTO per year
  • Path to grow into creative lead / brand director as we scale
  • Fully remote


How to Apply

  • A portfolio showing off your streetwear / midnight club design language
  • A short paragraph on how you'd approach the visual feel of an Ark Exotic ad campaign


If the interview goes well, we hire on the call. Welcome to Ark.

title: Lead Full-Stack Developer (.Net+Angular)
description:
LUXOFT ONLY OPERATES UNDER CLT CONTRACT

PLEASE APPLY WITH YOUR ENGLISH CV


The Mission

We are building the next generation of real-time solutions for our Risk Management and Portfolio Management teams. This isn’t just maintenance; you will be part of a small, elite agile squad of technologists tasked with re-engineering how we handle high-throughput, latency-sensitive financial data.

We value the \"Full Lifecycle Engineer\"—someone who takes pride in owning a feature from the initial whiteboard sketch and requirements gathering through to implementation, automated testing, and production monitoring.


Technical DNA

We are looking for a specialist in the .NET ecosystem who treats performance as a feature, not an afterthought. You should possess:

  • Architectural Mastery: A deep obsession with Clean Architecture , SOLID principles, and design patterns. You believe code should be as readable as it is fast.
  • Performance Engineering: Real-world experience building Low-Latency/High-Throughput systems. You know how to find bottlenecks using profiling tools and how to mitigate them.
  • The Concurrent Mindset: Expertise in TPL (Async/Await) and a deep understanding of thread safety and synchronization. You don't just use lock; you understand why you're using it.
  • Data at Scale: Mastery of SQL Server performance tuning, from execution plans to index optimization, ensuring our data layer scales with our ambitions.

The Toolkit (Must-Haves)

  • Core: C# / .NET 8 (or ASP.NET Core)
  • Patterns: Clean Architecture, DI/IoC (Autofac/Microsoft), Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Data: SQL Server, T-SQL, Stored Procedures, and Query Tuning.
  • Infrastructure: Distributed Systems, Microservices, and Cloud-native design.
  • Reliability: Monitoring & Observability (App Insights/Prometheus), Memory Management (GC Tuning).
  • Operations: Full SDLC ownership, including CI/CD and Production Support.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You have an independent mindset but crave a collaborative environment.
  • You have a \"Builder\" mentality—you enjoy solving the complex math and logic behind Risk Management.
  • You don't just fix bugs; you identify systemic risks and propose architectural improvements.


LUXOFT ONLY OPERATES UNDER CLT CONTRACT

PLEASE APPLY WITH YOUR ENGLISH CV

title: Comprador Pl
description:
Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Atuar nos processos de compras que podem apresentar algum nível de complexidade em relação a estratégia de compras, negociação, riscos de fornecimento, volume e preços.
  • Analisar os pedidos de compra, identificando e recomendando soluções de fornecimento em relação às necessidades apresentadas e estabelecer a estratégia de compras conforme os objetivos do negócio.
  • Estruturar as cotações, analisar e conduzir o processo de negociação junto aos fornecedores considerando a melhor condição comercial possível.
  • Recomendar o fornecedor para fechamento da aquisição e disponibilizar o pedido de compra no sistema para aprovação dos envolvidos na cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Estabelecer, com base em histórico e perfil dos itens a serem comprados, contratos de fornecimento, interagindo com o jurídico e fornecedores para elaboração, negociação e fechamentos dos contratos.
  • Participar e suportar o processo de análise crítica de itens de compras que apresentam maior risco para aquisição (ex. variações de preço, consumo, logística de fornecimento) e recomendar ações para mitigação de riscos.
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento comercial de novos fornecedores.
  • Realizar análise de indicadores e matérias primas para avaliação de preços.
  • Apresentar relatórios que corrobore para explicação de variações do Budget.
  • Conduzir negociações em sinergia com outras unidades da Bracell.
  • Realizar outras atividades correlatas às descritas acima, compatível com a sua condição pessoal e conforme solicitado pelo seu superior imediato.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar de forma presencial em Feira de Santana-BA;
  • Experiência carteira de Logística e Transporte, com a contratação de serviços de logística;
  • Conhecimento das técnicas de negociação, conhecimento do mercado de fornecimento, conhecimento em formação de preços de serviços (ex. despesas com pessoal, encargos, impostos, margens) e em Strategic Sourcing;
  • Noções em análise de contratos e em análise de risco de fornecimento ( ex.: financeiro, logística, prazos, obrigações acessórias)
  • Vivência em Pacote Office;
  • Conhecimento em Sistema Integrado (ERP), ex.: SAP;
  • Desejável Inglês Intermediário.

title: Senior/Lead QA Consultant – Loyalty & Marketing Automation (Independent Contractor) - 6 to 9 months (renewable)
description:
Keyrus is an international consulting firm, specializing in the integration of data intelligence and Digital solutions. With over 3200 employees spread across 28 countries, Keyrus continues to deliver on such projects to a wide range of clients from various industries including but not limited to Banking/Finance, Healthcare/pharmaceuticals, FMCG, Oil & Gas, and more.


As part of Keyrus’ solution delivery, we are also in a position to recruit and place technical consultants to complement on existing client projects with their expertise. As such, we seek innovative and agile people to support ambitious and forthcoming technological challenges


About The Role


We are seeking an experienced QA Lead Consultant based in Brazil, Sao Paulo to support a large-scale transformation program within the retail sector. The role is responsible for leading QA activities across multiple squads.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in complex, multi-system projects and is comfortable operating in fast-paced, cross-functional environments.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and coordinate QA activities across multiple development teams
  • Own end-to-end (E2E) testing readiness , ensuring alignment across systems and stakeholders
  • Oversee test data preparation and validation across systems
  • Manage defect lifecycle : triage, prioritization, and resolution follow-up with dev teams
  • Provide clear reporting on QA progress, risks, and quality metrics to stakeholders

Requirements

  • Direct experience with Zephyr
  • Proven experience as a QA Lead / Test Lead in large-scale, complex projects
  • Hands-on experience with E2E testing coordination across multiple teams/systems
  • Solid experience in defect management and QA governance
  • Ability to manage cross-functional stakeholders in fast-paced delivery environments
  • Experience working in Agile / distributed team setups

Nice to Have

  • Experience with CRM platforms and loyalty/marketing systems
  • Prior exposure to retail or omnichannel environments

title: Data Engineer III
description:
Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de desempenho do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de infraestrutura de dados escalável e soluções de engenharia. A equipe trabalha em estreita colaboração com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders do negócio para viabilizar acesso confiável a dados de alta qualidade, apoiar análises avançadas e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.

O(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados terá um papel crítico no desenho, construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados robustos, modelos de dados e ativos fundamentais que suportam analytics, relatórios e capacidades emergentes de IA/ML. Essa função exige forte rigor em engenharia, profundo entendimento de sistemas de dados e capacidade de colaborar entre equipes técnicas e de negócio.

O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui um histórico comprovado na construção de soluções de dados escaláveis em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, e sente-se confortável equilibrando trabalho em plataformas de dados fundamentais com iniciativas em evolução de analytics e IA.


O que você fará

Você possui uma forte mentalidade de engenharia e resolução de problemas. Converte necessidades de negócio e analíticas em soluções e arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e confiáveis.

Projeta, constrói e mantém pipelines e modelos de dados escaláveis que suportam monitoramento de desempenho do negócio, analytics e relatórios, além de contribuir para o desenvolvimento da Base de Dados BMP em ambientes Hive, Snowflake e data lakes.

Apoia o desenvolvimento de produtos e aplicações de dados, incluindo contribuição em pipelines baseados em Streamlit e no desenvolvimento de capacidades de chatbot para melhorar o acesso e a interação com dados.

Colabora de perto com equipes de analytics, ciência de dados e áreas de negócio para garantir disponibilidade, qualidade e usabilidade dos dados para dashboards, relatórios e análises avançadas.

Viabiliza e apoia o desenvolvimento de analytics avançado, machine learning e capacidades de IA, garantindo que a infraestrutura, pipelines e ambientes necessários estejam disponíveis para o desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos.

Contribui para o design e evolução do ecossistema de dados e ML, ajudando a estabelecer infraestrutura, processos e fundamentos necessários para escalar iniciativas de IA/ML na organização.


Qualificações Mínimas

• Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia ou área quantitativa relacionada.

• Mais de 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, desenvolvimento de plataformas de dados ou funções relacionadas.

• Forte experiência com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (Python ou equivalente).

• Familiaridade com frameworks de big data e processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark).

• Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados e trabalho com arquiteturas modernas de dados.

• Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow) e automação de pipelines.

• Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS) e soluções de data warehouse (ex.: Snowflake).

• Sólido entendimento de modelagem de dados, qualidade de dados e governança de dados.

• Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão (Git) e fluxos colaborativos de desenvolvimento.

• Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e capacidade de trabalhar com requisitos ambíguos.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de colaborar com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.

• Inglês fluente.


Qualificações Desejáveis

• Experiência com arquiteturas de data lake e ambientes de dados híbridos.

• Experiência com suporte a pipelines e infraestrutura de machine learning.

• Experiência com aplicações de dados (ex.: Streamlit) e interfaces conversacionais (chatbots).

• Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA.

• Experiência contribuindo para documentação e plataformas de compartilhamento de conhecimento (ex.: Confluence).

• Experiência em organizações globais com estrutura matricial.

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

title: Talent Matcher (Recruiter) - 75290
description:
About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.


About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Technical Matcher (recruiter) to manage the end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical and technical roles at Turing. You will be responsible for facilitating sourcing candidates, talent planning, capacity management, and internal supply optimization, while activating external sourcing channels where necessary. The ideal candidate has experience in client hiring setups, is highly organized, thrives in dynamic environments, and excels at stakeholder management.


Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the single point of contact between the Internal Delivery and Talent Fulfillment teams for assigned projects.
  • Manage end-to-end fulfillment for multiple client requirements concurrently (typically 3–4 at a time).
  • Activate external sourcing channels (via partnerships or talent acquisition teams) when internal supply is insufficient.
  • Oversee resource planning and capacity management, ensuring timely ramp-ups for customer-side roles.
  • Collaborate with Delivery Leads to understand project requirements and talent expectations.
  • Ensure data accuracy and visibility across systems — maintaining reports on hiring pipelines, fulfillment progress, and performance metrics.
  • Track and report fulfillment metrics, including fill rates, turnaround times, and candidate quality.
  • Partner with recruiting and sourcing teams to improve process efficiency and hiring velocity.
  • Deliver a strong stakeholder experience, maintaining proactive communication and alignment on timelines and expectations.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in talent operations, recruitment delivery, or resource planning within IT services, outsourcing, or global staffing environments.
  • Proven experience in client-side hiring setups and resource & capacity management.
  • Working knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter (good to have) and Google tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive) for tracking and reporting.
  • Data analysis and reporting skills — able to extract insights, identify trends, and drive data-backed decisions.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, and evolving environment.
  • Experience working across global time zones and in cross-cultural teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in non-technical or technical recruitment delivery or managing customer-side talent fulfillment.
  • Prior experience in startups or high-growth organizations with minimal structure.


Application process

  • Work experience based questionnaire
  • Aptitude analytical assessment
  • 2 live rounds of interview discussion

title: Gerente de projeto de design
description:
Sobre a vaga

A Bas-Alto é um estúdio de design full-service que opera sob o modelo de fractional design team: o fundador atua como design lead embedded em empresas parceiras, integrado aos times e às decisões de produto e de marca. A Bas-Alto é a estrutura que sustenta essa atuação: um time de designers entregando produto, web e visual design em paralelo, com o Gerente de Projetos/DesignOps garantindo que tudo opere com consistência enquanto o fundador está focado na frente estratégica. Site para referência:


Estamos contratando um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Design para trabalhar como \"braço direito operacional \" do fundador do estúdio na gestão de projetos de design. O papel central é garantir que o time de designers tenha sempre briefings claros, prioridades bem definidas e entregas organizadas, mantendo múltiplos projetos simultâneos rodando com qualidade e sem perder prazo.


Responsabilidades

  • Relacionamento com os clientes no dia a dia , respondendo a dúvidas, alinhando expectativas e garantindo que estejam sempre informados sobre o andamento dos projetos (por escrito, em inglês).
  • Suporte direto ao design lead na condução dos projetos e organização de demandas
  • Criação de briefings executáveis que traduzem as necessidades e objetivos em projetos para a equipe de design
  • Gerenciar tarefas , entregas e prazos em plataformas como ClickUp, Asana, Notion ou similares
  • Acompanhar o andamento de entregas de design (produto, web e marketing), garantindo qualidade e consistência
  • Fazer o handoff das entregas finais para os clientes, garantindo clareza, organização e um padrão elevado de apresentação
  • Estruturar fluxos de trabalho, cronogramas e processos internos
  • Antecipar gargalos, resolver impedimentos e manter os projetos em movimento

Diferencial: D ireção de design dos projetos (para candidatos com background sólido em design)


Necessário

  • Experiência sólida em gestão de projetos , de preferência em estúdios de design, agências ou startups
  • Experiência sólida no setor de tecnologia e de gestão de produtos digitais
  • Familiaridade com Figma e com o universo de design: entender o que são um wireframe, um design system, uma entrega de UI ou um fluxo de UX.
  • Inglês fluente em escrita e leitura.
  • Extrema organização e atenção a detalhe para manejar múltiplas frentes ao mesmo tempo
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva, tanto com clientes quanto com a equipe
  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de projetos (ClickUp, Asana, Notion, Jira ou similares)
  • Experiência com um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico/ágil de startups


Remuneração e modelo

  • Salário a partir de R$ 3.600+, podendo ser significativamente maior para candidatos com background sólido em design (que consigam atuar também na direção de design dos projetos).
  • Contratação: CLT ou PJ, a negociar
  • Formato de trabalho: 100% remoto
  • Horário flexível. Obs.: É necessária disponibilidade para atender demandas também no período noturno, devido ao fuso horário dos clientes da Califórnia (4h antes do horário do Brasil).

description:

Grauman Builders is a well-established General Contractor based in Massachusetts, with over 20 years of experience delivering high-quality residential construction.   • Present Grauman Builders as a trusted and experienced contractor

  • Confidence speaking with professionals (architects, designers, etc.)
  • Ability to build rapport quickly and naturally
  • Organized and consistent with follow-ups


Compensation:

  • Base salary + Comission

Nice to Have

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communicator across technical and business teams
  • Experience contributing to modern data platforms end-to-end

title: RAG Engineer
description:
About Joveo:

Every company says they're \"AI-first.\" We actually are. Joveo's recruitment

advertising platform processes millions of hiring decisions through machine

learning, real-time bidding, and predictive analytics — helping the world's

largest employers find the right people, faster and fairer. But we're not

done. Not even close.


Role: RAG Engineer

Location: Remote


Role Overview:

We are hiring a RAG Engineer to build the retrieval-augmented generation

systems that ground Joveo's LLM-powered features in real, verifiable

data. You will design retrieval pipelines, optimize vector indexes,

and engineer the prompt orchestration that makes AI responses accurate,

fast, and trusted at scale.


Key Responsibilities:

- Design and build RAG pipelines — chunking, embedding, indexing, and retrieval

- Optimize vector databases for recall, latency, and cost at production scale

- Implement hybrid retrieval combining semantic search with metadata filtering

- Engineer prompt orchestration and context assembly for LLM inputs

- Build evaluation frameworks for retrieval quality and grounding accuracy

- Monitor and improve RAG systems in production based on real usage signals


Required Skills & Qualifications:

- Hands-on experience building production RAG systems end-to-end

- Deep knowledge of embedding models, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, Qdrant)

- Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, DSPy)

- Strong Python skills and familiarity with modern LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source)

- Understanding of evaluation techniques — RAGAS, retrieval precision, hallucination detection

- Ability to debug retrieval quality issues through systematic experimentation

title: LIFECYCLE & RETENTION STRATEGIST (Klaviyo)
description:
ABOUT ATTN AGENCY

ATTN Agency (pronounced Attention Agency) is a boutique, performance-driven digital marketing agency trusted by e-commerce and DTC brands looking to scale profitably. We specialize in full-funnel growth across Google, Meta, TikTok, Klaviyo, Postscript, and emerging platforms — with a laser focus on ROAS, new customer acquisition, and incremental revenue.

We don't just manage emails. We build scalable systems for sustainable growth and we're selective about who we work with and who we hire. If you're obsessed with performance, welcome home.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Lifecycle and Retention Strategist to own and drive retention strategy across a portfolio of high-growth eCommerce and DTC brands. This is a senior, client-facing role that sits at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and execution oversight.

You will be responsible for building and managing full lifecycle programs spanning email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty, while leading the strategic direction for each brand on your portfolio. You think in customer journeys, speak fluently in data, and know how to translate insights into programs that move revenue.

You will also play a key role in evaluating and recommending the right tech stack for each client, including loyalty platforms, subscription tools, review integrations, and emerging retention channels, ensuring every brand is set up with the right infrastructure to scale.

This is not a coordinator role. We need someone who has been here before, can lead without being managed, and is ready to take ownership of outcomes.


SCOPE OF WORK

Strategy and Campaign Planning

  • Own the lifecycle roadmap across email, SMS, direct mail, and loyalty for a portfolio of 5 to 7 high-growth eCommerce brands
  • Develop rolling 30-day campaign calendars aligned with product launches, promotions, and paid media activity
  • Write clear, detailed copy briefs and flow outlines tailored to each brand's voice, tone, and audience
  • Build segmentation frameworks and customer journey maps designed to maximize engagement and lifetime value
  • Leverage AI tools and advanced analytics to uncover opportunities and improve workflow efficiency
  • Delegate campaign and flow builds to Retention Coordinators, then review, QA, and deliver actionable feedback
  • Coordinate with design and copy teams to keep assets and ClickUp timelines on track
  • Mentor junior team members and actively contribute to growing their strategic and technical capabilities

Optimization and Performance

  • Analyze performance across deliverability, engagement, conversion rate, revenue per recipient, and cohort LTV
  • Design and execute A/B and multivariate tests across creative, cadence, offers, and segments and translate results into clear next steps
  • Refine benchmarks, identify trends, and get ahead of problems before they affect performance
  • Evaluate and pilot emerging retention channels including loyalty tiers, push notifications, and in-app messaging
  • Document learnings and contribute to internal best practice development and team training

Tech Stack Management and Recommendations

  • Audit existing client tech stacks, identify gaps, and recommend the right tools for each brand's stage of growth
  • Advise on and help implement solutions across loyalty and rewards (Yotpo, Smile.io, LoyaltyLion), subscription management (Recharge, Skio, Stay), review and UGC platforms (Okendo, Stamped, Junip), SMS (Postscript, Attentive, Klaviyo SMS), post-purchase tools (Wonderment, Malomo, AfterShip), push notifications, and direct mail (PostPilot, PaperRun, etc.)
  • Stay current on the retention technology landscape and bring proactive recommendations to clients and the internal team

Client Collaboration

  • Join monthly or bi-weekly client calls led by Account Managers to present strategy, performance insights, and testing roadmaps
  • Deliver concise, data-driven performance summaries that clearly communicate wins, gaps, and next steps
  • Partner with Account Managers to ensure retention strategy integrates seamlessly with each client's broader growth initiatives


REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 4+ years of lifecycle and retention marketing experience, the majority within eCommerce or DTC
  • Proven track record managing email and SMS programs that have directly contributed to measurable revenue growth
  • Deep knowledge of Klaviyo including flows, segmentation, deliverability, and performance analysis
  • Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously, preferably in an agency environment
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, spot trends, and build a clear strategic response
  • Solid understanding of the eCommerce retention tech ecosystem with the ability to make confident platform recommendations
  • Experience briefing and managing creative and copy teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills including the ability to present strategy clearly to clients
  • Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment
  • Proficiency with ClickUp (Or similar project management platform), Slack, and GSuite


NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with SMS platforms such as Postscript or Attentive
  • Hands-on experience implementing or managing loyalty and subscription tools
  • Familiarity with direct mail as a retention channel
  • Experience mentoring or managing junior team members
  • Experience with other ESPs like Braze, Iterable, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud


HOW WE WORK

You will work directly with our Director of Lifecycle and Retention Marketing and collaborate closely with Account Managers, additional Retention Strategists, designers, and copywriters. We operate through ClickUp for project management and Slack for day-to-day communication. Availability and responsiveness between 9am and 5pm US hours on business days is required.

title: Influencer Marketing Manager
description:
Company Description Wowoo is a subscription app studio behind ChatPrime, AI Baby Generator, and FaceForm, reaching millions of users globally. We grow through performance-driven marketing and creator-led content. As we expand our presence in Brazil, we're looking for a senior operator who can lead our local team and own influencer marketing for one of the largest creator economies in the world.

Role Description This is a full-time remote role for a senior Influencer Marketing Manager based in Brazil. You will lead Wowoo's Brazil operations and be the point of accountability for our local team members, while owning the end-to-end influencer program across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube for our consumer apps. Day-to-day you'll source and vet top-tier creators, negotiate rates and usage rights, brief talent on hooks and direct-response angles, manage contracts and payments, and partner with our performance team to turn top-performing UGC into scalable paid creative. You'll also represent Wowoo locally with agencies, talent managers, and platform partners. Success is measured in CAC, ROAS, the quality of creators you bring in, and the strength of the team and partnerships you build in Brazil.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on influencer or creator marketing experience, with at least part of that in mobile apps or DTC subscription products
  • Proven track record sourcing and managing top-tier Brazilian creators on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese; native-level fluency expected
  • Strong professional English; able to represent Wowoo with global stakeholders, partners, and leadership
  • Elite negotiation skills, with a track record of closing favorable rates, usage rights, whitelisting, and exclusivity terms with high-profile talent
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian creator culture, agencies, and the local talent landscape
  • Experience leading or mentoring team members and acting as a local point of accountability for distributed teams
  • Comfortable working with performance metrics: CAC, ROAS, CPI, conversion rates, and creative testing frameworks
  • Bachelor's degree from a top Brazilian university such as USP, FGV, Insper, PUC-Rio, or UFRJ is strongly preferred
  • Bonus: familiarity with influencer platforms (Grin, Aspire, Modash), basic BI/spreadsheet work, and existing relationships with major Brazilian talent agencies

title: Talent Matcher (Recruiter) - 75290
description:
About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.


About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Technical Matcher (recruiter) to manage the end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical and technical roles at Turing. You will be responsible for facilitating sourcing candidates, talent planning, capacity management, and internal supply optimization, while activating external sourcing channels where necessary. The ideal candidate has experience in client hiring setups, is highly organized, thrives in dynamic environments, and excels at stakeholder management.


Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the single point of contact between the Internal Delivery and Talent Fulfillment teams for assigned projects.
  • Manage end-to-end fulfillment for multiple client requirements concurrently (typically 3–4 at a time).
  • Activate external sourcing channels (via partnerships or talent acquisition teams) when internal supply is insufficient.
  • Oversee resource planning and capacity management, ensuring timely ramp-ups for customer-side roles.
  • Collaborate with Delivery Leads to understand project requirements and talent expectations.
  • Ensure data accuracy and visibility across systems — maintaining reports on hiring pipelines, fulfillment progress, and performance metrics.
  • Track and report fulfillment metrics, including fill rates, turnaround times, and candidate quality.
  • Partner with recruiting and sourcing teams to improve process efficiency and hiring velocity.
  • Deliver a strong stakeholder experience, maintaining proactive communication and alignment on timelines and expectations.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in talent operations, recruitment delivery, or resource planning within IT services, outsourcing, or global staffing environments.
  • Proven experience in client-side hiring setups and resource & capacity management.
  • Working knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter (good to have) and Google tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive) for tracking and reporting.
  • Data analysis and reporting skills — able to extract insights, identify trends, and drive data-backed decisions.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, and evolving environment.
  • Experience working across global time zones and in cross-cultural teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in non-technical or technical recruitment delivery or managing customer-side talent fulfillment.
  • Prior experience in startups or high-growth organizations with minimal structure.


Application process

  • Work experience based questionnaire
  • Aptitude analytical assessment
  • 2 live rounds of interview discussion

title: Influencer Marketing Manager
description:
Company Description Wowoo is a subscription app studio behind ChatPrime, AI Baby Generator, and FaceForm, reaching millions of users globally. We grow through performance-driven marketing and creator-led content. As we expand our presence in Brazil, we're looking for a senior operator who can lead our local team and own influencer marketing for one of the largest creator economies in the world.

Role Description This is a full-time remote role for a senior Influencer Marketing Manager based in Brazil. You will lead Wowoo's Brazil operations and be the point of accountability for our local team members, while owning the end-to-end influencer program across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube for our consumer apps. Day-to-day you'll source and vet top-tier creators, negotiate rates and usage rights, brief talent on hooks and direct-response angles, manage contracts and payments, and partner with our performance team to turn top-performing UGC into scalable paid creative. You'll also represent Wowoo locally with agencies, talent managers, and platform partners. Success is measured in CAC, ROAS, the quality of creators you bring in, and the strength of the team and partnerships you build in Brazil.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on influencer or creator marketing experience, with at least part of that in mobile apps or DTC subscription products
  • Proven track record sourcing and managing top-tier Brazilian creators on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese; native-level fluency expected
  • Strong professional English; able to represent Wowoo with global stakeholders, partners, and leadership
  • Elite negotiation skills, with a track record of closing favorable rates, usage rights, whitelisting, and exclusivity terms with high-profile talent
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian creator culture, agencies, and the local talent landscape
  • Experience leading or mentoring team members and acting as a local point of accountability for distributed teams
  • Comfortable working with performance metrics: CAC, ROAS, CPI, conversion rates, and creative testing frameworks
  • Bachelor's degree from a top Brazilian university such as USP, FGV, Insper, PUC-Rio, or UFRJ is strongly preferred
  • Bonus: familiarity with influencer platforms (Grin, Aspire, Modash), basic BI/spreadsheet work, and existing relationships with major Brazilian talent agencies

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer – Microsoft Fabric (Contract)

Location: Remote (US-based client)

Duration: 3-month initial contract (high likelihood of extension)

Start Date: 27th April

Overview

We’re supporting a leading pharmaceutical organisation on a major data platform transformation, focused on building out a Microsoft Fabric-based environment to drive analytics, reporting, and AI-led initiatives across the business.

They’re looking for a hands-on Data Engineer to support the build and optimisation of scalable data pipelines, enabling high-quality, trusted data for downstream use.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and optimise data pipelines within a Microsoft Fabric / Azure-based environment
  • Support the development of a modern data platform (lakehouse / medallion architecture)
  • Integrate data from multiple sources into a centralised data platform
  • Develop and maintain data models to support analytics and reporting
  • Work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver scalable solutions
  • Ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across pipelines
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across data, analytics, and engineering

Required Skills & Experience

  • 4+ years experience as a Data Engineer
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric OR strong Azure data stack (Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks, ADLS, Power BI)
  • Strong experience building ETL/ELT pipelines (Python, SQL, PySpark)
  • Experience with data modelling (star schema / dimensional modelling)
  • Experience working with large-scale data platforms / lakehouse architectures
  • Strong understanding of pipeline performance and optimisation

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Microsoft Purview / data governance / data cataloging
  • Experience in pharma, healthcare, or regulated environments
  • Exposure to real-time / streaming pipelines
  • Experience supporting AI / ML or analytics use cases

What They’re Looking For

  • Hands-on, delivery-focused engineer
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communicator across technical and business teams
  • Experience contributing to modern data platforms end-to-end

title: Gerente de projeto de design
description:
Sobre a vaga

A Bas-Alto é um estúdio de design full-service que opera sob o modelo de fractional design team: o fundador atua como design lead embedded em empresas parceiras, integrado aos times e às decisões de produto e de marca. A Bas-Alto é a estrutura que sustenta essa atuação: um time de designers entregando produto, web e visual design em paralelo, com o Gerente de Projetos/DesignOps garantindo que tudo opere com consistência enquanto o fundador está focado na frente estratégica. Site para referência:


Estamos contratando um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Design para trabalhar como \"braço direito operacional \" do fundador do estúdio na gestão de projetos de design. O papel central é garantir que o time de designers tenha sempre briefings claros, prioridades bem definidas e entregas organizadas, mantendo múltiplos projetos simultâneos rodando com qualidade e sem perder prazo.


Responsabilidades

  • Relacionamento com os clientes no dia a dia , respondendo a dúvidas, alinhando expectativas e garantindo que estejam sempre informados sobre o andamento dos projetos (por escrito, em inglês).
  • Suporte direto ao design lead na condução dos projetos e organização de demandas
  • Criação de briefings executáveis que traduzem as necessidades e objetivos em projetos para a equipe de design
  • Gerenciar tarefas , entregas e prazos em plataformas como ClickUp, Asana, Notion ou similares
  • Acompanhar o andamento de entregas de design (produto, web e marketing), garantindo qualidade e consistência
  • Fazer o handoff das entregas finais para os clientes, garantindo clareza, organização e um padrão elevado de apresentação
  • Estruturar fluxos de trabalho, cronogramas e processos internos
  • Antecipar gargalos, resolver impedimentos e manter os projetos em movimento

Diferencial: D ireção de design dos projetos (para candidatos com background sólido em design)


Necessário

  • Experiência sólida em gestão de projetos , de preferência em estúdios de design, agências ou startups
  • Experiência sólida no setor de tecnologia e de gestão de produtos digitais
  • Familiaridade com Figma e com o universo de design: entender o que são um wireframe, um design system, uma entrega de UI ou um fluxo de UX.
  • Inglês fluente em escrita e leitura.
  • Extrema organização e atenção a detalhe para manejar múltiplas frentes ao mesmo tempo
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva, tanto com clientes quanto com a equipe
  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de projetos (ClickUp, Asana, Notion, Jira ou similares)
  • Experiência com um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico/ágil de startups


Remuneração e modelo

  • Salário a partir de R$ 3.600+, podendo ser significativamente maior para candidatos com background sólido em design (que consigam atuar também na direção de design dos projetos).
  • Contratação: CLT ou PJ, a negociar
  • Formato de trabalho: 100% remoto
  • Horário flexível. Obs.: É necessária disponibilidade para atender demandas também no período noturno, devido ao fuso horário dos clientes da Califórnia (4h antes do horário do Brasil).

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant


$3,000 - $4,500/month | Full-Time MST hours | Remote from LATAM


We are seeking a Senior Accountant who balances high-level technical precision with strategic financial vision. We do not just need someone to record what happened in the past; we need a partner who can look at the numbers and help us engineer a more profitable future.


You are a master of the \"square in the box\" fundamentals, including compliance and meticulous reconciliations, but you possess the analytical mindset to translate those numbers into actionable insights. You should be someone who thinks in systems and strategy, capable of explaining complex financial data to a non-financial founder in a way that is clear and actionable.


Key Responsibilities


  • Full-Cycle Accounting: Manage the month-end close processes, including bank reconciliations, accruals, and the preparation of all financial statements.
  • Financial Narratives: Move beyond the \"what\" to the \"why.\" You will analyze P&L trends and provide clear, strategic commentary to leadership.
  • Process Innovation: Audit our current financial workflows and tech stack to eliminate manual entry and improve data integrity.
  • Cash Flow Forecasting Support: Collaborate with the Fractional CFO to maintain forward-looking cash flow models to assist with project planning, hiring decisions, and investment timing.
  • Project Profitability Audit: Regularly review project-based margins to ensure labor and material costs align with original estimates.
  • Standard Operating Procedures: Develop and document internal financial controls to ensure the scalability of the accounting department.


Required Qualifications


  • Industry Expertise (Non-Negotiable): Must have significant experience working with accrual-based home improvement companies such as Interior Designers, General Contractors, or specialized trade firms.
  • US-Based Experience: Minimum of 3 years of accounting experience specifically for US-based companies. You must be intimately familiar with US business structures and protocols.
  • The \"Vision\" Factor: You are a strategic thinker who looks at systems, not just entries. You have a proven ability to bridge the gap between raw data and executive decision-making.
  • Tech Mastery: Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks Online (Certified) and modern receipt-capture/AP automation tools.
  • Analytical Rigor: A proven track record of identifying \"leakage\" or inefficiencies in a budget and proposing successful pivots.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance preferred.


Additional Information


  • Mindset: We value \"Financial Architects\" over historians.
  • Communication: Must be comfortable communicating financial health in a breezy, professional, and jargon-free manner.
  • Technology: We are a tech-forward company where an interest in automating manual workflows is essential.

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor .NET Pleno/Sênior
description:

title: Talent Matcher (Recruiter) - 75290
description:
About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.


About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Technical Matcher (recruiter) to manage the end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical and technical roles at Turing. You will be responsible for facilitating sourcing candidates, talent planning, capacity management, and internal supply optimization, while activating external sourcing channels where necessary. The ideal candidate has experience in client hiring setups, is highly organized, thrives in dynamic environments, and excels at stakeholder management.


Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the single point of contact between the Internal Delivery and Talent Fulfillment teams for assigned projects.
  • Manage end-to-end fulfillment for multiple client requirements concurrently (typically 3–4 at a time).
  • Activate external sourcing channels (via partnerships or talent acquisition teams) when internal supply is insufficient.
  • Oversee resource planning and capacity management, ensuring timely ramp-ups for customer-side roles.
  • Collaborate with Delivery Leads to understand project requirements and talent expectations.
  • Ensure data accuracy and visibility across systems — maintaining reports on hiring pipelines, fulfillment progress, and performance metrics.
  • Track and report fulfillment metrics, including fill rates, turnaround times, and candidate quality.
  • Partner with recruiting and sourcing teams to improve process efficiency and hiring velocity.
  • Deliver a strong stakeholder experience, maintaining proactive communication and alignment on timelines and expectations.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in talent operations, recruitment delivery, or resource planning within IT services, outsourcing, or global staffing environments.
  • Proven experience in client-side hiring setups and resource & capacity management.
  • Working knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter (good to have) and Google tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive) for tracking and reporting.
  • Data analysis and reporting skills — able to extract insights, identify trends, and drive data-backed decisions.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, and evolving environment.
  • Experience working across global time zones and in cross-cultural teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in non-technical or technical recruitment delivery or managing customer-side talent fulfillment.
  • Prior experience in startups or high-growth organizations with minimal structure.


Application process

  • Work experience based questionnaire
  • Aptitude analytical assessment
  • 2 live rounds of interview discussion
